Bava Kamma 17b:10-16: Tanu rabbanan: tarnegolin shehayu mafrichin mimmakom lemakom, veshavru kelim bechanfehen – meshallem nezek shalem. beruach shebbechanfehen – meshallemin chatzi nezek. somchos omer: nezek shalem. tanya iddach: tarnegolin shehayu mehaddesin al gabbe issa veal gabbe perot, vetinnefu o nikkeru – meshallem nezek shalem. heelu afar o tzerorot – meshallemin chatzi nezek. somchos omer: nezek shalem.
Tanya iddach: tarnegol shehaya mafriach mimmakom lemakom, veyatzta ruach mittachat kenafav veshibbera et hakkelim – meshallem chatzi nezek. setama kerabbanan.
Amar rava: bishlama somchos – kasavar: kocho kegufo dame. ella rabbanan, i kegufo dame – kulleh nezek bae leshallem; vei lav kegufo dame, chatzi nezek name la leshallem!
Hadar amar rava: leolam kegufo dame, vachatzi nezek tzerorot – hilcheta gemiri la.
Amar rava: kol shebbazzav tame – benizzakin meshallem nezek shalem. kol shebbazzav tahor – benizzakin meshallem chatzi nezek.
Verava, tzerorot ata leashmoinan?! lo; rava – egla moshechet bakkaron ka mashma lan.

Tanya kevateh derava: behema muedet leshabber bederech hilluchah. ketzad? behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak – vehizzika begufah derech hilluchah, uvisarah derech hilluchah; baukkaf shealeha, uvishlif shealeha, uvifrumebya shebbefiha, uvezog shebbetzavvarah; vachamor bemassao, veegla moshechet bekaron – meshallem nezek shalem.
Berakhot 14a:11-16b:17: Amar rav: kol hannoten shalom lachavero kodem sheyyitpallel keillu asao bama. shenneemar: "chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo ki vamme nechshav hu". al tikre, "bamme" ella "bama".
Ushemuel amar: bamme chashavto laze velo laeloah?
Metiv rav sheshet: bapperakim shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv!
Targema rabbi abba: bemashkim lefitcho.
Amar rabbi yona amar rabbi zera: kol haose chafatzav kodem sheyyitpallel — keillu bana bama. amru lo "bama" amrat? amar lehu: la, "asur" ka amena.
(Vechidrav idi bar avin deamar) rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: asur lo laadam laasot chafatzav kodem sheyyitpallel, shenneemar: "tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav".

Veamar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: kol hammitpallel veachar kach yotze ladderech, hakkadosh baruch hu ose lo chafatzav, shenneemar: "tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav".
Veamar rabbi yona amar rabbi zera: kol hallan shivat yamim belo chalom nikra "ra", shenneemar: "vesavea yalin bal yippaked ra", al tikre "savea" ella "sheva".

Amar leh rav acha bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: hachi amar rabbi chiyyay amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammasbia atzmo middivre tora velan — en mevasserin oto besorot raot, shenneemar: "vesavea yalin bal yippaked ra".
Ellu hen ben happerakim vechulei.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar ben "elohechem" leemet veyatztziv" lo yafsik. amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: may tameh derabbi yehuda — dichtiv:
"VaAdonai elohim emet".
Chozer veomer "emet", o eno chozer veomer "emet"?

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: chozer veomer "emet". rabba amar: eno chozer veomer "emet". hahu dinchet kammeh derabba. shameh rabba deamar "emet" "emet" tere zimne. amar rabba: kol "emet" "emet" tafseh lehay.
Amar rav yosef: kamma mealleya ha shemateta, dechi ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar: amri bemareva arvit — "dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem ani Adonai elohechem emet".

Amar leh abbaye: may mealleyuta? veha amar rav kahana amar rav: lo yatchil, veim hitchil — gomer. vechi tema "veamarta alehem" la have hatechala — vehaamar rav shemuel bar yitzchak amar rav: "dabber el bene yisrael" la have hatechala, "veamarta alehem" have hatechala.
Amar rav pappa: kasavri bemareva "veamarta alehem" name la havya hatechala ad deamar "veasu lahem tzitzit".
Amar abbaye: hilkach, anan atchole matchalinan, deka matchali bemareva, vechevan deatchalinan — migmar name gamrinan. deha amar rav kahana amar rav lo yatchil, veim hitchil gomer.
Chiyyay bar rav amar: amar "ani Adonai elohechem", tzarich lomar "emet". lo amar "ani Adonai elohechem" — eno tzarich lomar "emet".
Veha bae leadkore yetziat mitzrayim!
Deamar hachi: "modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu shehotzetanu meeretz mitzrayim ufeditanu mibbet avadim veasita lanu nissim ugevurot al hayyam vesharnu lach".
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: lamma kadma parashat "shema" vechulei.
Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: baddin hu sheyyakdim "shema", livhaya im shamoa" — shezze lilmod, veze lelammed. "vehaya im shamoa" levayyomer" — shezze lilmod, veze laasot.

Attu "shema" — lilmod it beh, lelammed velaasot let beh?! veha ketiv: "veshinnantam", "ukeshartam", "uchetavtam"! vetu: "vehaya im shamoa" — lelammed hu deit beh, velaasot let beh? veha ketiv: "ukeshartem", "uchetavtam"!

Ella hachi kaamar: baddin hu shettikdam "shema" livhaya im shamoa", shezze lilmod ulelammed velaasot. "vehaya im shamoa" levayyomer", shezze yesh bah lelammed velaasot, "vayyomer" en bah ella laasot bilvad.

Vetippok leh midderabbi yehoshua ben korcha! chada veod kaamar, chada: kede sheyyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim techilla veachar kach yekabbel alav ol mitzvot, veod — mishshum deit ba hane mille achranyayta.

Rav meshi yedeh, ukera keriat shema, veannach tefillin vetzalli. vehechi aved hachi? vehatanya hachofer kuch lemet bakkever — patur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. higgia zeman keriat shema — ole venotel yadav, umanniach tefillin, vekore keriat shema, umitpallel.
Ha gufa kashya, resha amar patur, vesefa chayyayv?!
Ha la kashya: sefa bitre, veresha bechad.
Mikkol makom kashya lerav. rav kerabbi yehoshua ben karcha sevira leh, deamar ol malchut shamayim techilla veachar kach ol mitzvot.
Emar daamar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha — lehakedim keria likria, keria laasiyya mi shamat leh?!

Vetu, mi savar leh kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha? vehaamar rav chiyyay bar ashe: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav, umakdem umashe yedeh, umevarech, umatne lan pirkin, umannach tefillin, vahadar kare keriat shema. vechi tema: bidla meta zeman keriat shema, im ken may ashadteh derav chiyyay bar ashe?
Leappoke mimman deamar lammishna en tzarich levarech, kamashma lan deaf lemishna name tzarich levarech.
Mikkol makom kashya lerav! shelucha hu deavvet.
Amar ulla: kol hakkore keriat shema belo tefillin, keillu meid edut sheker beatzmo. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: keillu hikriv ola belo mincha, vezevach belo nesachim.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: harotze sheyyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim shelema
Yippane, veyittol yadav, veyanniach tefillin, veyikra keriat shema, veyitpallel, vezo hi malchut shamayim shelema.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hannifne, venotel yadav, umanniach tefillin, vekore keriat shema, umitpallel — maale alav hakkatuv keillu bana mizbeach vehikriv alav korban, dichtiv: "erchatz benikkayon kappay vaasovva et mizbachacha Adonai". amar leh rava: la savar la mar keillu taval, dichtiv: "erchatz [benikkayon]" — vela katav "architz [kappay]".
Amar leh ravina lerava: chazi mar hay tzureba merabbanan daata mimmareva veamar: mi sheen lo mayim lirchotz yadav — mekanneach yadav beafar uvitzror uvekismit.
Amar leh: shappir kaamar, mi ketiv "erchatz bemayim"? "benikkayon" ketiv — kol midde dimnakke, deha rav chisda layet amman dimhaddar ammayya beiddan tzelota.
Vehane mille likriat shema, aval litfilla mehaddar. vead kamma? — ad parsa. vehane mille lekammeh, aval laachoreh — afillu mil eno chozer. [uminna] mil hu deeno chozer, ha pachot mimmil — chozer.
Mishna hakkore et shema velo hishmia leozno — yatza. rabbi yose omer: lo yatza.
Kara velo dikdek beotiyyoteha, rabbi yose omer: yatza. rabbi yehuda omer: lo yatza.
Hakkore lemafrea — lo yatza. kara vetaa — yachzor limkom shettaa.
Gemara may tama derabbi yose? mishshum dichtiv "shema" — hashema leoznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha. vetanna kamma savar, "shema" — bechol lashon sheatta shomea.
Verabbi yose, tarte shema minna.
Tenan hatam: cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea — lo yitrom. veim taram — terumato teruma.
Man tena cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea diavad — in, lechattechilla — la?
Amar rav chisda: rabbi yose hi, ditnan: hakkore et "shema" velo hishmia leozno — yatza, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: lo yatza.
Ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose lo yatza, ella gabbe keriat shema deorayyta, aval teruma — mishshum beracha hu, uveracha derabbanan vela bivracha talya milleta.
Umimmay derabbi yose hi, dilma rabbi yehuda hi? veamar gabbe keriat shema name diavad — in, lechattechilla — la. teda, dekatane: "hakkore", diavad — in, lechattechilla — la.
Amri: hay dekatane "hakkore", lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose deamar diavad name la. dei rabbi yehuda, afillu lechattechilla name yatza.
Bemay okimta — kerabbi yose? veella ha detanya: lo yevarech adam birkat hammazon belibbo, veim berach — yatza.
Manni? la rabbi yose vela rabbi yehuda. dei rabbi yehuda — ha amar, lechattechilla name yatza? i rabbi yose, diavad name la!
Ella may, rabbi yehuda. vediavad — in, lechattechilla — la.
Ella ha detane rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea — torem lechattechilla, manni?
La rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose. i rabbi yehuda — ha amar diavad in, lechattechilla la. i rabbi yose — ha amar diavad name la?

Ella, leolam rabbi yehuda, vaafillu lechattechilla name. vela kashya, ha — dideh, ha — derabbeh. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyashmia leozno, shenneemar: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". amar lo rabbi meir: hare hu omer "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha" — achar kavvanat hallev hen hen haddevarim.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema rabbi yehuda kerabbeh sevira leh. vela kashya: ha rabbi meir, ha rabbi yehuda.
Tenan hatam: hakkol kesherim likrot et hammegilla, chutz mecheresh, shote vekatan. verabbi yehuda machshir bekatan.
Man tana cheresh diavad name la? amar rav matna: rabbi yose hi. ditnan: hakkore et "shema" velo hishmia leozno — yatza, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: lo yatza.
Mimmay derabbi yose hi vediavad name la,
Dilma rabbi yehuda hi, ulechattechilla hu dela, ha diavad — shappir dame.
La salka datach, dekatane, cheresh dumeya deshote vekatan. ma shote vekatan diavad name la — af cheresh diavad name la.
Vedilma ha kidita veha kidita.
Umi matzet leokma kerabbi yehuda? veha middekatane sefa: rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan, mikkelal deresha lav rabbi yehuda hi?!

Vedilma kulla rabbi yehuda hi utere gavvne katan, vechassore mechassera, vehachi katane: hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegilla, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. bamme devarim amurim — bekatan shello higgia lechinnuch, aval katan shehiggia lechinnuch — afillu lechattechilla kasher, divre rabbi yehuda, sherabbi yehuda machshir bekatan.
Bemay okimta, kerabbi yehuda — vediavad in, lechattechilla la? ella ha detane rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi, cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea — torem lechattechilla,
Manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose. i rabbi yehuda, diavad in lechattechilla la. i rabbi yose, diavad name la!
Ella may, rabbi yehuda — vaafillu lechattechilla name? ella ha detanya: lo yevarech adam birkat hammazon belibbo, veim berech — yatza, manni?
La rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose. i rabbi yehuda, ha amar afillu lechattechilla name, vei rabbi yose, ha amar afillu diavad name la!

Leolam rabbi yehuda hi, vaafillu lechattechilla name. vela kashya ha — dideh, ha — derabbeh. detanya, amar rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyashmia leozno, shenneemar: "shema yisrael". amar lo rabbi meir: hare hu omer: "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha", achar kavvanat hallev hen hen haddevarim.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema rabbi yehuda kerabbeh sevira leh, vela kashya, ha — rabbi yehuda, ha — rabbi meir.
Amar rav chisda amar rav shela: halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya, vahalacha kerabbi yehuda.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yehuda, hava amena afillu lechattechilla, kamashma lan halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya.
Vei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya, hava amena tzarich veen lo takkana. kamashma lan halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Amar rav yosef: machaloket bikriat shema, aval bishar mitzvot — divre hakkol lo yatza, dichtiv: "haseket ushema yisrael".

Metivi: lo yevarech adam birkat hammazon belibbo, veim berech — yatza. ella i ittemar — hachi ittemar: amar rav yosef machaloket bikriat shema, dichtiv "shema yisrael", aval bishar mitzvot — divre hakkol yatza.
Vehachtiv "haseket ushema yisrael"!
Hahu bedivre tora ketiv.
"Kara velo dikdek beotiyyoteha".
Amar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya: halacha kedivre shenehem lehakel.

Veamar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya: may dichtiv "shalosh henna lo tisbana. sheol veotzer racham". vechi ma inyan sheol etzel rechem? ella lomar lach: ma rechem machnis umotzi, af sheol machnis umotzi.

Vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma rechem shemmachnisin bo bachashay, motziin mimmennu bekole kolot. sheol shemmachnisin bo bekole kolot, eno din shemmotziin mimmennu bekole kolot? mikkan teshuva laomrim en techiyyayt hammetim min hattora.
Tane rabbi oshaya kammeh derava: "uchetavtam" — hakkol bichtav, afillu tzavvaot.

Amar leh: daamar lach manni — rabbi yehuda hi, deamar gabbe sota — alot kotev, tzavvaot eno kotev. vehatam hu dichtiv: "vechatav et haalot haelle", aval hacha dichtiv: "uchetavtam" — afillu tzavvaot name.
Attu tameh derabbi yehuda mishshum dichtiv "vechatav"? tameh derabbi yehuda mishshum dichtiv "alot". alot in, tzavvaot — la.
Itzterich, salka datach amena nelaf "ketiva" "ketiva" mehatam: ma hatam — alot in, tzavvaot la. af hacha name — tzavvaot la. ketav rachamana "uchetavtam" — afillu tzavvaot.
Tane rav ovadya kammeh derava: "velimmadtem" sheyyehe limmudecha tam — sheyyitten revach ben haddevakim.
Ane rava batreh: kegon "al levavecha", "al levavchem", "bechol levavcha", "bechol levavchem", "esev besadcha", "vaavadtem mehera", "hakkanaf petil", "etchem meeretz".

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: kol hakkore keriat shema umedakdek beotiyyoteha metzannenin lo gehinnam, shenneemar: "befares shadday melachim bah tashleg betzalmon" — al tikre "befares" ella "befaresh", al tikre "betzalmon" ella "betzalmavet".
Veamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: lamma nismechu

Ohalim linchalim, dichtiv: "kinchalim nittayu kegannot ale nahar kaahalim nata vegomer" — lomar lecha: ma nechalim maalin et haadam mittumea letohora — af ohalim maalin et haadam mikkaf chova lechaf zechut.
"Hakkore lemafrea lo yatza vechulei".

Rabbi amme verabbi assi havo ka katrin leh genana lerabbi elazar. amar lehu: addehachi vehachi ezil veeshma milleta deve midresha, veete veema lechu. azal ashkecheh letanna dekatane kammeh derabbi yochanan:
Kara vetaa veeno yodea lehechan taa, beemtza happerek — yachzor larosh. ben perek leferek — yachzor leferek rishon. ben ketiva lichtiva — yachzor lichtiva rishona.
Amar leh rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shello patach bilmaan yirbu yemechem", aval patach bilmaan yirbu yemechem" — sircheh naket veate.
Ata vaamar lehu. amaru leh: illu lo banu ella lishmoa davar ze — dayyenu.
Mishna haummanin — korin berosh hailan uverosh hannidbach. ma sheenan rashshain laasot ken battefilla.

Chatan patur mikkeriat shema layla harishona vead motzae shabbat im lo asa maase. umaase berabban gamliel shennasa ishsha vekara layla harishona. amru lo talmidav: limmadtanu rabbenu shechatan patur mikkeriat shema? amar lahem eni shomea lachem levattel hemeni malchut shamayim afillu shaa achat.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: haummanin — korin berosh hailan uverosh hannidbach. umitpallelin berosh hazzayit uverosh hatteena. ushear kol hailanot — yordim lematta umitpallelin. uvaal habbayit, ben kach uven kach yored lematta umitpallel, lefi sheen dato meyushshevet alav.

Rame leh rav mari bera devat shemuel lerava, tenan: haummanin korin berosh hailan uverosh hannidbach, alma la bae kavvana. ureminhi: hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo, shenneemar: "shema yisrael", ulehallan hu omer: "haseket ushema yisrael". ma lehallan behaseket" af kan behaseket".
Ishtik. amar leh: midde shemia lach beha? amar leh: hachi amar rav sheshet — vehu shebbetelin mimmelachtan vekorin.
Vehatanya: bet hillel omrim oskim bimlachtan vekorin!
La kashya: ha beferek rishon, ha beferek sheni.

Tanu rabbanan: happoalim shehayu osin melacha etzel baal habbayit, korin keriat shema umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha. veochlin pittan umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha, umitpallelin tefilla shel shemone esre. aval en yordin lifne hatteva, veen nosin kappehem.
Vehatanya meen shemone esre! amar rav sheshet: la kashya, ha — rabban gamliel, ha — rabbi yehoshua.
I rabbi yehoshua, may irya poalim? afillu kol adam name!
Ella idde veidde rabban gamliel, vela kashya: kan, beosin bischaran. kan, beosin bisudatan.

Vehatanya: happoalim shehayu osim melacha etzel baal habbayit — korin keriat shema umitpallelin. veochlin pittan — veen mevarchim lefaneha, aval mevarchin leachareha shetayim. ketzad? beracha rishona ketikkunah, sheniyya poteach bevirkat haaretz vechollin "bone yerushalayim" bevirkat haaretz.
Bamme devarim amurim — beosin bischaran, aval osin bisudatan o shehaya baal habbayit mesev immahen — mevarchin ketikkunah.

Chatan patur mikkeriat shema. tanu rabbanan: "beshivtecha bevetecha" — perat leosek bemitzva. "uvelechtecha badderech" — perat lechatan. mikkan amru: hakkones et habbetula — patur, veet haalmana — chayyayv.
May mashma? amar rav pappa: ki derech. ma derech reshut, af hacha name reshut.
Mi la askinan dekaazel lidvar mitzva, vaafillu hachi amar rachamana: likre.
Im ken, lema kera "belechet", may "belechtecha" — shema minna: belechet didach hu dimchayyeyvat, ha demitzva — petirat.
I hachi may irya hakkones et habbetula? afillu kones et haalmana name.
Hacha — terid, vehacha — la terid.

I mishshum tirda, afillu tava sefinato bayyam name, allema amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: avel chayyayv bechol mitzvot haamurot battora, chutz min hattefillin shehare neemar bahen "peer", shenneemar "peercha chavosh alecha vegomer"!
Amri hatam tirda dirshut hacha tirda demitzva.
Mishna rachatz layla harishon shemmeta ishto. amru lo talmidav: limmadtanu rabbenu sheavel asur lirchotz? amar lahem eni kishar bene adam, istenis ani.
Ucheshemmet tavi avdo kibbel alav tanchumin. amru lo talmidav: limmadtanu rabbenu sheen mekabbelin tanchumin al haavadim? amar lahem: en tavi avdi kishar kol haavadim, kasher haya.
Chatan im rotze likrot keriat shema layla harishon — kore, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo kol harotze littol et hashshem, yittol.
Gemara may tama derabban (shimon ben) gamliel? kasavar: aninut layla — derabbanan, dichtiv: "veacharitah keyom mar". uvimkom istenis la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Ucheshemmet tavi avdo vechulei.
Tanu rabbanan: avadim ushefachot en omdin alehem beshura, veen omrim alehem birkat avelim vetanchume avelim.

Maase umeta shifchato shel rabbi eliezer. nichnesu talmidav lenachamo. kevan sheraa otam ala laaliyyay, vealu acharav. nichnas laanpilon, nichnesu acharav. nichnas latteraklin, nichnesu acharav. amar lahem: kimdumme ani sheattem nichvim befoshrim, achshav i attem nichvim afillu bechamme chammin, lo kach shaniti lachem: avadim ushefachot en omdim alehem beshura, veen omrim alehem birkat avelim velo tanchume avelim? ella ma omrim alehem? — keshem sheomrim lo leadam al shoro veal chamoro shemmetu — "hammakom yemalle lecha chesroncha", kach omrim lo al avdo veal shifchato "hammakom yemalle lecha chesroncha".
Tanya iddach: avadim ushefachot en maspidin otan. rabbi yose omer: im eved kasher hu — omrim alav: "hoy ish tov veneeman venehene migio". amru lo: im ken, ma hinnachta lakkesherim?
Tanu rabbanan: en korin "avot" ella lishlosha, veen korin "immahot" ella learba.

Avot may tama? illema mishshum dela yadinan i meruven ka atenan i mishshimon ka atenan, i hachi immahot name la yadinan i merachel ka atenan i millea ka atenan! ella, ad hacha chashivi, tefi la chashivi.
Tanya idach: avadim ushefachot en korin otam "abba peloni" veimma pelonit". veshel rabban gamliel hayu korim otam "abba peloni" veimma pelonit".
Maase listor?! mishshum dachashivi.

Mishnah Berakhot 4:7-5:4:
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, en tefillat hammusafin ella bechever ir. vachachamim omrim, bechever ir veshello vechever ir. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo, kol makom sheyyesh chever ir, hayyachid patur mittefillat hammusafin:  
En omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch koved rosh. chasidim harishonim hayu shohim shaa achat umitpallelim, kede sheyyechavvenu et libbam lammakom. afillu hammelech shoel bishlomo, lo yeshivennu. vaafillu nachash karuch al akevo, lo yafsik: 
Mazkirin gevurot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim, veshoalin haggeshamim bevirkat hashshanim, vehavedala bechonen haddaat. rabbi akiva omer, omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah. rabbi eliezer omer, behodaa: 
Haomer al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha, veal tov yizzacher shemecha, modim modim, meshattekin oto. haover lifne hatteva vetaa, yaavor acher tachtav, velo yehe sarvan beotah shaa. minnayin hu matchil, mittechillat habberacha shettaa vah: 
Haover lifne hatteva, lo yaane achar hakkohanim amen, mippene hatteruf. veim en sham kohen ella hu, lo yissa et kappav. veim havetachato shehu nose et kappav vechozer litfillato, rashshay:
Mishnah Berakhot 5:5-6:3:
Hammitpallel vetaa, siman ra lo. veim sheliach tzibbur hu, siman ra lesholchav, mippene sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto. amru alav al rabbi chanina ven dosa, keshehaya mitpallel al hacholim veomer, ze chay veze met. amru lo, minnayin atta yodea. amar lahem, im shegura tefillati befi, yodea ani shehu mekubbal. veim lav, yodea ani shehu metoraf: 
Ketzad mevarchin al happerot. al perot hailan omer, bore peri haetz, chutz min hayyayin, sheal hayyayin omer bore peri haggafen. veal perot haaretz omer bore peri haadama, chutz min happat, sheal happat hu omer hammotzi lechem min haaretz. veal hayerakot omer bore peri haadama. rabbi yehuda omer, bore mine deshaim: 
Berach al perot hailan bore peri haadama, yatza. veal perot haaretz bore peri haetz, lo yatza. al kullam im amar shehakkol nihya, yatza: 
Al davar sheen giddulo min haaretz omer shehakkol. al hachometz veal hannovlot veal haggovay omer shehakkol. al hechalav veal haggevina veal habbetzim omer shehakkol. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shehu min kelala en mevarchin alav:
Mishnah Berakhot 6:4-7:
Hayu lefanav minim harebe, rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh benehem mimmin shiva, mevarech alav. vachachamim omrim, mevarech al eze mehem sheyyirtze: 
Berach al hayyayin shellifne hammazon, patar et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon. berach al happarperet shellifne hammazon, patar et happarperet shelleachar hammazon. berach al happat, patar et happarperet. al happarperet, lo fatar et happat. bet shammay omrim, af lo maase kedera: 
Hayu yoshvin leechol, kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. hesebbu, echad mevarech lechullan. ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon, kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. leachar hammazon, echad mevarech lechullam. vehu omer al hammugmar, af al pi sheen meviin et hammugmar ella leachar hasseudda: 
Heviu lefanav maliach battechilla ufat immo, mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat, shehappat tefela lo. ze hakkelal, kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela, mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela:
Mishnah Berakhot 6:8-7:4:
Achal teenim anavim verimmonim, mevarech acharehen shalosh berachot, divre rabban gamliel. vachachamim omrim, beracha achat meen shalosh. rabbi akiva omer, afillu achal shelek vehu mezono, mevarech acharav shalosh berachot. hashshote mayim litzmao, omer shehakkol nihye bidvaro. rabbi tarfon omer, bore nefashot rabbot: 
Shelosha sheachlu cheechad, chayyavin lezammen. achal demay, umaaser rishon shennittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehashshammash sheachal kazzayit, vehakkuti, mezammenin alehem. aval achal tevel, umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, vehashshammash sheachal pachot mikkazzayit, vehannachri, en mezammenin alehem: 
Nashim vaavadim uketannim, en mezammenin alehem. ad kamma mezammenin, ad kazzayit. rabbi yehuda omer, ad kabbetza: 
Ketzad mezammenin, bishlosha omer nevarech. bishlosha vehu, omer barchu. baasara, omer nevarech lelohenu. baasara vahu, omer barchu. echad asara veechad asara ribbo. bemea omer, nevarech layya elohenu. bemea vehu, omer barchu. beelef, omer nevarech layya elohenu elohe yisrael. beelef vehu, omer barchu. beribbo, omer, nevarech layya elohenu elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu. beribbo vehu, omer barchu. keinyan shehu mevarech, kach onin acharav, baruch Adonai elohenu elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu. rabbi yose haggelili omer, lefi rov hakkahal hen mevarchin, shenneemar bemakhelot barchu elohim, Adonai mimmekor yisrael (tehillim sach). amar rabbi akiva, ma matzinu bevet hakkeneset, echad merubbin veechad muatin omer, barchu et Adonai. rabbi yishmael omer, barchu et Adonai hamevorach: 
Shelosha sheachlu cheechad, enan rashshain lechalek, vechen arbaa, vechen chamishsha. shishsha nechelakin, ad asara. vaasara enan nechelakin, ad sheyyihyu esrim:
Mishnah Berakhot 7:5-8:3:
Shete chavurot shehayu ochlot bevayit echad, bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu, hare ellu mitztarfim lezimmun. veim lav, ellu mezammenin leatzman, veellu mezammenin leatzman. en mevarchin al hayyayin ad sheyyitten letocho mayim, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, mevarchin: 
Ellu devarim shebben bet shammay uvet hillel basseudda. bet shammay omrim, mevarech al hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. uvet hillel omrim, mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom: 
Bet shammay omrim, notlin layyadayim, veachar kach mozgin et hakkos. uvet hillel omrim, mozgin et hakkos veachar kach notlin layyadayim: 
Bet shammay omrim, mekanneach yadav bammappa umannichah al hashshulchan. uvet hillel omrim, al hakkeset:
Mishnah Berakhot 8:4-7:
Bet shammay omrim, mechabbedin et habbayit veachar kach notlin layyadayim. uvet hillel omrim, notlin layyadayim veachar kach mechabbedin et habbayit: 
Bet shammay omrim, ner umazon uvesamim vehavedala. uvet hillel omrim, ner uvesamim umazon vehavedala. bet shammay omrim, shebbara meor haesh. uvet hillel omrim, bore meore haesh: 
En mevarchin lo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel ovde chochavim, velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel metim, velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shellifne avoda zara. en mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu leoro: 
Mi sheachal veshachach velo verach, bet shammay omrim, yachazor limkomo vivarech. uvet hillel omrim, yevarech bammakom shennizkar. ad ematay hu mevarech. ad kede sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav:
Mishnah Chullin 4:4-7:
Behema hammaksha leled, vehotzi ubbar et yado vachatachah veachar kach shachat et immo, habbasar tahor. shachat et immo veachar kach chatachah, habbasar magga nevela, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, magga terefa shechuta. ma matzinu vatterefa sheshshechitatah metahartah, af shechitat behema tetaher et haevar. amar lahem rabbi meir, lo, im tihara shechitat terefa otah, davar sheggufah, tetaher et haevar, davar sheeno gufah. minnayin latterefa sheshshechitatah metahartah. behema temea asura vaachila, af terefa asura vaachila. ma behema temea en shechitatah metahartah, af terefa lo tetaharenna shechitatah. lo, im amarta bivhema temea shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher, tomar bitrefa shehayta lah sheat hakkosher. tol lecha ma sheheveta, hare shennolda terefa min habbeten minnayin. lo, im amarta bivhema temea shekken en beminah shechita, tomar bitrefa sheyyesh beminah shechita. ben shemona chay, en shechitato metaharto, lefi sheen bemino shechita: 
Hashshochet et habbehema umatza vah ben shemona chay o met, o ven tisha met, koro umotzi et damo. matza ven tisha chay, taun shechita, vechayyav beoto veet beno, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, shechitat immo metaharto. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, afillu ven shemone shanim vechoresh bassade, shechitat immo metaharto. keraah umatza vah ben tisha chay, taun shechita, lefi shello nishchata immo: 
Behema shennechtechu ragleha min haarkubba ulematta, keshera. min haarkubba ulemala, pesula. vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin. nishbar haetzem, im rov habbasar kayyam, shechitato metaharto. veim lav, en shechitato metaharto: 
Hashshochet et habbehema umatza vah shilya, nefesh hayyafa tochlenna, veenah metammea lo tumat ochalin velo tumat nevelot. chishshev aleha, metammea tumat ochalin aval lo tumat nevelot. shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah, asura vaachila. siman valad baishsha, vesiman valad babbehema. hamevakkeret shehippila shilya, yashlichenna lichlavim. uvammukdashin, tikkaver. veen kovrin otah befarashat derachim, veen tolin otah beilan, mifne darche haemori:
Mishnah Chullin 5:1-5:
Oto veet beno, noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin uvemukdashin. ketzad. hashshochet oto veet beno chullin bachutz, shenehem kesherim, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. kadashim bachutz, harishon chayyav karet, ushenehem pesulim, ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim. chullin bifnim, shenehem pesulim, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. kadashim bifnim, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul: 
Chullin vekadashim bachutz, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul. kadashim vechullin bachutz, harishon chayyav karet ufasul, vehashsheni kasher, ushenehem sofgin et haarbaim. chullin vekadashim bifnim, shenehem pesulim, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. kadashim vechullin bifnim, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul. chullin bachutz uvifnim, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul. kadashim bachutz uvifnim, harishon chayyav karet, ushenehem pesulim, ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim. chullin bifnim uvachutz, harishon pasul ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim vechasher. kadashim bifnim uvachutz, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul: 
Hashshochet venimtza terefa, hashshochet laavoda zara, vehashshochet parat chattat, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa, rabbi shimon poter, vachachamim mechayyevin. hashshochet venitnabbela veyado, vehannocher, vehammeakker, patur mishshum oto veet beno. shenayim shellakchu fara uvenah, eze shellakach rishon, yishchot rishon. veim kadam hashsheni, zacha. shachat para veachar kach shene vaneha, sofeg shemonim. shachat shene vaneha veachar kach shechatah, sofeg et haarbaim. shechatah veet bittah veet bat bittah, sofeg shemonim. shechatah veet bat bittah veachar kach shachat et bittah, sofeg et haarbaim. sumechos omer mishshum rabbi meir, sofeg shemonim. bearbaa ferakim bashshana hammocher behema lachavero tzarich lehodio, immah macharti lishchot, bittah macharti lishchot. veellu hen, erev yom tov haacharon shel chag, veerev yom tov harishon shel pesach, veerev atzeret, veerev rosh hashshana, uchedivre rabbi yose haggelili, af erev yom hakkippurim baggalil. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman sheen lo revach. aval yesh lo revach, en tzarich lehodio. umode rabbi yehuda bemocher et haem lechatan veet habbat lakkalla, shetztzarich lehodia, beyadua sheshshenehem shochatin beyom echad: 
Bearbaa ferakim ellu mashchitin et hattabbach beal karcho. afillu shor shave elef dinarin veen lo lallokeach ella dinar, kofin oto lishchot, lefichach, im met, met lallokeach. aval bishar yemot hashshana, eno chen. lefichach, im met, met lammocher: 
Yom echad haamur beoto veet beno, hayyom holech achar hallayla. et zo darash shimon ben zoma. neemar bemaase vereshit (Bereshit 1), yom echad, veneemar beoto veet beno (Vayikra 22), yom echad. ma yom echad haamur bemaase vereshit hayyom holech achar hallayla, af yom echad haamur beoto veet beno, hayom holech achar hallayla:
Mishnah Chullin 6:1-4:
Kissuy haddam noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo vemukdashim. venoheg bechayya uveof, bimzumman uvesheeno mezumman. venoheg bechoy, mippene shehu safek. veen shochatin oto veyom tov. veim shechato, en mechassin et damo: 
Hashshochet venimtza terefa, vehashshochet laavoda zara, vehashshochet chullin bifnim, vekadashim bachutz, chayya vaof hanniskalim, rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. hashochet venitnabbela veyado, hannocher, vehameakker, patur millechassot: 
Cheresh, shote vekatan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan, chayyav lechassot. benan leven atzmam, patur millechassot. vechen leinyan oto veet beno, sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan, asur lishchot acharehem. benan leven atzman, rabbi meir mattir lishchot acharehen, vachachamim osrim. umodim sheim shachat, sheeno sofeg et haarbaim: 
Shachat mea chayyot bemakom echad, kissuy echad lechullan. mea ofot bemakom echad, kissuy echad lechullan. chayya vaof bemakom echad, kissuy echad lechullan. rabbi yehuda omer, shachat chayya, yechassenna, veachar kach yishchot et haof. shachat velo chissa veraahu acher, chayyav lechassot. kissahu venitgalla, patur millechassot. kissahu haruach, chayyav lechassot:
Mishnah Chullin 6:5-7:1:
Dam shennitarev bemayim, im yesh bo marit dam, chayyav lechassot. nitarev beyayin, roin oto cheillu hu mayim. nitarev bedam habbehema o vedam hachayya, roin oto cheillu hu mayim. rabbi yehuda omer, en dam mevattel dam: 
Dam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin, chayyav lechassot. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman sheen sham dam ella hu. aval yesh sham dam shello hu, patur millechassot: 
Bamme mechassin, uvamma en mechassin. mechassin bezevel haddak, uvechol haddak, besid, uvecharsit, uvilvena uvimgufa shekketashan. aval en mechassin lo vezevel haggas, velo vechol haggas, velo vilvena umegufa shelo chetashan, velo yichpe alav et hakkeli. kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, davar shemmegaddel bo tzemachin, mechassin bo. vesheeno megaddel tzemachin, en mechassin bo: 
Gid hannashe noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin uvemukdashim. venoheg bivhema uvechayya, beyarech shel yamin uveyarech shel semol. veeno noheg beof, mippene sheen lo chaf. venoheg beshalil. rabbi yehuda omer, eno noheg beshalil. vechelbo muttar. veen hattabbachin neemanin al gid hannashe, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, neemanin alav veal hachelev:
Mishnah Chullin 7:2-6:
Sholeach adam yarech lenachri sheggid hannashe vetochah, mippene shemmekomo nikkar. hannotel gid hannashe, tzarich sheyyittol et kullo. rabbi yehuda omer, kede lekayyem bo mitzvat netila: 
Haochel miggid hannashe chazzayit, sofeg arbaim. achalo veen bo chazzayit, chayyav. achal mizze chazzayit umizze chazzayit, sofeg shemonim. rabbi yehuda omer, eno sofeg ella arbaim: 
Yarech shennitbashshel bah gid hannashe, im yesh bah benoten taam, hare zo asura. ketzad meshaarin otah. kevasar belafet: 
Gid hannashe shennitbashshel im haggidim, bizman shemmakkiro, benoten taam, veim lav, kullan asurin. veharotev, benoten taam. vechen chaticha shel nevela, vechen chaticha shel dag tame, shennitbashshelu im hachatichot, bizman shemmakkiran, benoten taam. veim lav, kullan asurot. veharotev, benoten taam: 
Noheg bithora, veeno noheg bitmea. rabbi yehuda omer, af bitmea. amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo mibbene yaakov neesar gid hannashe, vaadayin behema temea mutteret lahen. amru lo, besinay neemar, ella shennichtav bimkomo:
Mishnah Chullin 8:1-4:
Kol habbasar asur levashshel bechalav, chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim. veasur lehaaloto im haggevina al hashshulchan, chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim. hannoder min habbasar, muttar bivsar dagim vachagavim. haof ole im haggevina al hashshulchan veeno neechol, divre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, lo ole velo neechol. amar rabbi yose, zo mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. beeze shulchan amru, bashshulchan sheochel alav. aval bashshulchan shessoder alav et hattavshil, noten ze vetzad ze veeno choshesh: 
Tzorer adam basar ugevina bemitpachat achat, uvilvad shello yehu nogin ze vaze. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, shene achsenain ochlin al shulchan echad, ze basar vaze gevina, veen choshshin: 
Tippat chalav shennafla al hachaticha, im yesh bah benoten taam beotah chaticha, asur. nier et hakkedera, im yesh bah benoten taam beotah kedera, asur. hakkechal, koro umotzi et chalavo. lo kerao, eno over alav. hallev, koro umotzi et damo. lo kerao, eno over alav. hammaale et haof im haggevina al hashshulchan, eno over belo taase: 
Besar behema tehora bachalev behema tehora, asur levashshel veasur bahanaa. besar behema tehora bachalev behema temea, besar behema temea bachalev behema tehora, muttar levashshel umuttar bahanaa. rabbi akiva omer, chayya vaof enam min hattora, shenneemar, lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo, shalosh peamim, perat lechayya uleof velivhema temea. rabbi yose haggelili omer, neemar (Devarim 14), lo tochlu chol nevela, veneemar (sham), lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo. et sheasur mishshum nevela, asur levashshel bechalav. of, sheasur mishshum nevela, yachol yehe asur levashshel bechalav, talmud lomar bachalev immo, yatza of, sheen lo chalev em:
Mishnah Yevamot 12:5-13:2:

Issur kedushsha — almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. veammay kare lehu issur kedushsha — dichtiv: "kedoshim yihyu lelohehem".
Tanya, rabbi yehuda machlif: issur mitzva — almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. veammay kare leh issur mitzva — dichtiv: "elle hammitzvot".

Issur kedushsha — sheniyyot middivre sofrim, veammay kare leh issur kedushsha? amar abbaye: kol hamekayyem divre chachamim nikra kadosh. amar leh rava: vechol sheeno mekayyem divre chachamim, kadosh hu dela mikkere, rasha name la mikkere! ella amar rava: kaddesh atzmecha bammuttar lach.
Almana lechohen gadol. kafasek vetane, la shena min hannissuin vela shena min haerusin.
Bishlama min hannissuin — ase velo taase, veen ase doche lo taase vaase. ella min haerusin — lo taase gereda hu, yavo ase veyidche lo taase!

Amar rav giddel amar rav, amar kera: "vealta yevimto hashshara", sheen talmud lomar "yevimto", ma talmud lomar "yevimto" — yesh lecha yevama achat sheola lachalitza veenah ola leyibbum, veezo zo chayyayve lavin.
Veema chayyayve karetot! amar kera: "veim lo yachpotz haish lakachat", ha chafetz — meyaybem. kol haole leyibbum — ole lachalitza, vechol sheen ole leyibbum — eno ole lachalitza.
I hachi, chayyayve lavin name! ha rabbi rachamana "yevimto". uma raita?
Mistabbera: chayyayve lavin — tafsi behu kiddushin. chayyayve karetot — la tafsi behu kiddushin.

Metiv rava: issur mitzva veissur kedushsha, ba aleha o chalatz lah — niftera tzaratah. vei salka datach chayyayve lavin middeorayyta lachalitza ramya, leyibbum la ramya, ki ba aleha — ammay niftera tzaratah?
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: litzdadin katane. ba aleha — aissur mitzva. chalatz lah — aissur kedushsha.

Metiv rava: petzua dakka, ucherut shofcha, seris adam, vehazzaken — o choltzin o meyaybmin. ketzad? metu, velahem achim velahem nashim, veamdu achin veasu maamar binshotehen, venatnu get, vechaltzu — ma sheasu asu. veim baalu — kanu.

Metu achim, veamdu hem, veasu maamar binshotehen, venatnu get o shechaltzu — ma sheasu asu. veim baalu — kanu, veasur lekayyeyman, mishshum shenneemar: "lo yavo fetzua dakka". vei salka datach chayyayve lavin middeorayyta lachalitza ramya, leyibbum la ramya, im baalu — ammay kanu?
Ella amar rava: almana min haerusin name, ase velo taase hu — dichtiv: "kedoshim yihyu lelohehem".
Mamzeret unetina — may ikka lememar? ketiv: "vehitkaddishtem".
I hachi, kol hattora kullah name ase velo taase hu, dichtiv: "vehitkaddishtem"! ella amar rava: gezera almana min haerusin attu almana min hannissuin.
Mamzeret unetina may ikka lememar! gezera bimkom mitzva attu shello bimkom mitzva.
Ella meatta, eshet achiv meaviv lo tityaybem, gezera mishshum eshet achiv meimmo! yibbum benachala tela rachmana, midda yedia.
Ishsha sheen lah banim lo tityaybem, gezera mishshum ishsha sheyyesh lah banim! bevanim tela rachmana, midda yedia.
Eshet achiv shehaya beolamo lo tityaybem, gezera mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo! bishiva tela rachmana, midda yedia.
Kol hannashim lo tityaybemna, gezera mishshum aylonit! la shechicha. mamzeret unetina name la shechicha!
Ella amar rava: gezera bia rishona attu bia sheniyya.
Tanya name hachi: im baalu — kanu bevia rishona, veasur lekayyeyman bevia sheniyya.

Hadar amar rava, veittema rav ashe: lav milleta hi daamari, deamar resh lakish: kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase, im atta yachol lekayyem shenehem — mutav, veim lav, yavo ase veyidche et lo taase. hacha name efshar bachalitza, dimkayyem ase velo taase.
Metivi: veim baalu kanu. teyuveta.
Ittemar: biat kohen gadol bealmana. rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: enah poteret tzaratah, vechad amar: poteret tzaratah.

Bealmana min hannissuin — kulle alma la peligi dela patra, deen ase doche lo taase vaase. ki peligi bealmana min haerusin. man deamar poteret — ate ase vedache et lo taase. uman deamar enah poteret — la ate ase vedache et lo taase, kevan deefshar bachalitza.
Metivi: veim baalu kanu! teyuveta.
Lema tihve name teyuveta deresh lakish?! amar lach resh lakish: ki amena ana — hecha dimkayyeymi mitzva, aval hacha, chalitza bimkom yibbum — lav mitzva hi.
Amar rava: remez lishniyyot min hattora minnayin — shenneemar: "ki et kol hattoevot hael asu anshe haaretz", "hael" — kashot, mikkelal deikka rakkot, umay ninhu — sheniyyot.
Umay mashma dehael" lishshana dekashe hu — dichtiv: "veet ele haaretz lakach".
Lema peliga derabbi levi, deamar rabbi levi: kashe onshan shel middot yoter meonshan shel arayot, shezze neemar bahen "el", veze neemar bahen "elle"! "el" kashe, veelle" kashe meel".
Gabbe arayot name ha ketiv "elle"! hahu lemaote middot mikkaret.
Ella may chumerayyhu? hane — efshar bitshuva, hane — la efshar bitshuva.

Rav yehuda amar mehacha: "veizzen vechikker tikken meshalim harebe", veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar: kodem shebba shelomo, hayta tora doma lichfifa sheen lah oznayim, ad shebba shelomo veasa lah oznayim.
Rabbi oshaya amar mehacha: "peraehu al taavor bo sete mealav vaavor".

Amar rav ashe: mashal derabbi oshaya lema haddavar dome — leadam meshammer pardes, meshammero mibbachutz — kullo mishtammer. meshammero mibbifnim, shellefanav — mishtammer, shelleacharav — eno mishtammer. veha derav ashe beduta hi. hatam, shellefanav miha mishtammer. hacha, i lav sheniyyot, paga beerva gufa.
Rav kahana amar mehacha: "ushemartem et mishmarti" — asu mishmeret lemishmarti.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha deorayyta hi! deorayyta, ufershu rabbanan. kol hattora name pershu rabbanan! ella: midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
Zevachim 19b:3-11: Veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim. atya "chukka"–"chukka" mimmechussar begadim.

Tanu rabbanan: kohen gadol shello taval veshello kiddesh ben beged leveged uven avoda laavoda, veavad – avodato keshera. veechad kohen gadol veechad kohen hedyot shello kiddesh yadav veraglav shacharit, veavad – avodato pesula.
Amar leh rav assi lerabbi yochanan: mikkedi chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin deorayyta, vechukka" ketiv behu – liakkevu!
Amar leh, amar kera: "ulevesham" – levisha meakkevet, veen davar acher meakkev.
Tzahavu panav, amar leh: vav aufeta ketavi lach – i hachi, detzafra name.
Amar chizkiyya, amar kera: "vehayta lahem chok olam lo ulezaro ledorotam" – davar hameakkev bezaro, meakkev bo; davar sheeno meakkev bezaro, en meakkev bo.
Rabbi yonatan amar mehacha: "verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav" – davar hameakkev bevanav meakkev bo, davar sheeno meakkev bevanav en meakkev bo.
Rabbi yonatan may tama la amar middechizkiyya? amar lach: hahu ledorot hu dichtiv.

Veiddach – may tama la amar mehay? mibbee leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina – deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kol kiyyor sheen bo kede lekaddesh arbaa kohanim mimmennu – en mekaddeshin bo, shenneemar: "verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav".
Zohar, Addenda, Volume I 29:280-30:297: Vehaaretz hayta tohu. bezimna dekudesha berich hu hava beillen kelippin hava bone almin umacharivan veha ukemuha delet hashepaa bechol almin, venahar deihu tzaddik yechorav veyavesh bitren almin, bealma den uvealma deate.

Veit man deamar desalik bemachshavteh lemivni almin ulehacharivan. veamar den mehaneyayn li veden la mehaneyayn li. illen deittemar behon et hashamayim veet haaretz mehaneyayn li. veacharanin deittemar behon vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu deachze al almin desalik biruteh lemivni lon vela avid lon alayhu ittemar tohu vavohu.

Uvezimna dekudesha berich hu beillen kelippin ittemar beh (Eicha 3:44) sakkota beanan lach meavor tefilla. tohu vechoshech alayhu ittemar (Shemot 14:20) vayhi heanan vehachoshech veillen kelippin deegoza, mocha milgav detalya (ditlat) 34 sitrin da Adonai deihu la kabbil mesaavu, kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 23:29) halo ko devaray kaesh neum Adonai. ma esha la mekabbel tumea hachi shemeh la mekabbel tumea.

Uvizmena demitgabberin illen kelippin veitbarun meegoza, tzelota deihi shechinta 65, salka legabbe balah deihu Adonai uselikat chulla, dibbezimna deihu mitkase minah beillen kelippin, ihi itkeriat aniyya yevesha velet lah ella ma deyahavin avadin bachashay.

Uvehahu zimna dekudesha berich hu itpeshat meillen kelippin ittemar (Yeshayahu 30:20) velo yikkanef od morecha vehayu enycha root et morecha. uma dahava yevesha ittemar bah, melo kol haaretz kevodo. veitkeriat beracha dileh, karbana dileh, ola dileh, deokid kol illen kelippin.

Uselikat legabbeh ketoret. kishura dileh, ola dileh, dichtiv (Vayikra 6:18) zot torat haola, hi haola bitzlota deshacharit, hi haola legabbeh bitzlota demincha bechamma rechin uvusemin degan eden deihi gan deorayyta. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 4:12) gan naul achoti challa, setima dela itpattechat ella legabbe balah.

Vechad yete balah (Tehillim 51:17) adonay sefatay tiftach deihi bava illaa itpattechat legabbeh kitrin (bitren) samchen keshot vekabbilat leh bitren deroin, hada hu dichtiv (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni.
Adonai nachit legabbah veda hu raza amen (95) gimatriyya 91 deihu chibbura ditteren shemahan beatvavn. uvegin da gadol haone amen yoter min hamevarech bezimna deinun teren beresha detzaddikayya.

Aval kad inun beresha dechayyayvayyay keneset yisrael amarat legabbayyhu (Shir hashshirim 1:6) al tiruni sheani shecharchoret meillen desharyayn lefattaa livni nasha kema dahavu mefatin leyisrael vaagala beshit shatin, hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 32:1) vayyar haam ki boshesh moshe laredet min hahar. veukemuha may ki boshesh, ella beshit shatin avadu yat egla begin leafrasha lon misheva. hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 12:15) ach bayom harishon tashbitu sheor, ach chilek ben shesh lesheva.

Uvegin da amra keneset leyisrael sheshzafatni hashamesh garmu deistallak minni 6 deihu hashesh veor hashesh dahava nahir besitra deshit tevin deinun (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad, bene immi nicharu bi, nichar geronam devattilu keriyat shema deittemar beh (Tehillim 149:6) rommot el bigronam, uvegin da samuni notera et hakkeramim, deinun shear umin erev rav. uvegin da karmi sheli lo natarti uvegin da inun erev rav matzlichin becholla.

Katnot or chashochin deayynin deittemar behon (Bereshit 27:1) vattichhena enav merot, leistakkela leillen deittemar behon (yechezkel 1:1-2) niftechu hashamayim vaere marot elohim deinun chamesh or deovada dibbereshit katnot or inun.

Vehaaretz hayta tohu. vehaaretz hu chad. tohu teren. behu telat. choshech arba. tehom chamesh. vearba inun dichlilan begufa veinun arba yesodin deinun kelippin deegoza, uvegin da vehaaretz hayta tohu. veukemuha hayta mikkadmat dena, dehachi archa diklippin demkadmin lemocha. veruach elohim da rucha dimshicha, demiyyad diyhe merachefet al anpe maya deorayyta miyad yehe purekana, hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 1:3) vayyomer elohim yehi or.

Sefer habbahir amar ribbi berachya may dichtiv vehaaretz hayta tohu, may mashma hayta, shekkevar hayta. umay tohu, davar hamattehe et bene adam. umay boho, davar sheyyesh bo mammash, dichtiv boho, bo hu. al shem may dichtiv (Kohelet 7:14) gam et ze leummat ze asa haelohim. bara boho vesam mekomo beshalom. bara tohu vesam mekomo bera. boho beshalom dichtiv (iyyov 25:2) ose shalom bimromav. melammed shemichael sar yemino shel hakkadosh baruch hu, mayim uvarad. vegavriel sar semolo, esh. vesar shalom benehem machria vehayeynu dichtiv ose shalom bimromav.

Umenalan deboho shalom, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 45:7) ose shalom uvore ra, ha ketzad ra mittohu veshalom mibboho, bara tohu vesam mekomo bara, shenneemar ose shalom uvore ra. bara boho vesam mekomo beshalom shenneemar ose shalom bimromav. ad kan:

Vayshallechehu Adonai elohim, miyad (lameshaychaa) meshicha dehu beginta deeden bema deittemar beh vayshallechehu miggan eden meiddun dileh. veammay laavod et haadama deihi shechinta begin da vayshallechehu miyad, deyippuk mittamman. vayyashken mikkedem legan eden et hakkeruvim deinun mashiach ben david umashiach ben yosef demashcha rucha dimshicha deittemar beh, veruach elohim da shilo hahu deittemar beh veatzalti min haruach, dehachi salik shilo moshe bechushebana. vayyashken mikkedem, deakdim shilo litravavyhu begin diyhe merachefet al anpoy deorayyta ufurekana beh talyyay veha ukemuha.

Veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet miyad yehe bideh. umay nihu, mate metatron deithappach mimmatte lenachash uminnachash lematte. veod matte da shechinta tattaa veim zachu yisrael kelappe chesed limina veyifkun berachame. veim lav mate kelappe chova lesitra digvura detamman nachash, el acher. detava lishpoch dama veitketil mashiach vesaggiin miyyisrael.

Uvegin da ittemar (Rut 3:13) shichvi ad habboker deihu voker deavraham diyhe mate kelappe chesed uvegin da veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet vechola lishmor et derech etz hachayyim deihi orayyta deittemar bah etz chayyim hi

Veihi orayyta deval pe. im zacha bar nash, ihi sam chayyim dileh. veim lav, hi mithappechet leh lesam hammavet. veha ukemuha mare matnitin hachi, kegoona dematte deithappach lenachash uminnachash lematte. uvezimna hahu yitmachun min alma kol inun deittemar behon (Shemot 7:22) vayyaaso ken chartume mitzrayim belatehem:
Zohar, Noach 25: Rabbi yitzchak patach (Yeshayahu 63:12) molich limin moshe zeroa tifarto bokea mayim mippenehem laasot lo shem olam. (nusach acher zeroa tifarto) da zechuta deavraham deihu yamina mimmoshe. tiferet demoshe. uvegin kach bokea mayim mippenehem. deha zechuta deavraham bokea mayim ihu. vechol da lama laasot lo shem olam.

Ta chaze, ma ben moshe lishar bene alma. beshaata deamar lah kudesha berich hu lemoshe (Shemot 32:10) veatta hannicha li vegomer. veeese otcha legoy gadol vegomer. miyyad amar moshe vechi eshbok dinhon deyisrael begini. hasheta yemrun kol innun bene alma deana katlit lon leyisrael. kema deavad noach.

Dechevan deamar leh kudesha berich hu disheziv leh betevuta (kema deittemar) dichtiv vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim vegomer. uchetiv umachiti et kol hayekum asher asiti meal pene haadama vaani hinni mekim et beriti vegomer uvata el hatteva kevan deamar leh deyishteziv hu uvenoy la baa rachamin al alma veitavidu. uvegin kach ikrun me hammabbul al shemeh kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 54:9) ki me noach zot li shor noshobbaatti moavor me noach.

Amar moshe hasheta yemrun beni alma deana ketilat lon begin deamar li veeese otcha legoy gadol. hasheta tav li deemut vela yishtetzun yisrael. miyyad vaychal moshe et pene Adonai elohav. baa rachamin alayyhu veitar rachame al alma.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak sheruta devaa rachame alayyhu may kaamar. lamma Adonai yechore appecha beammecha. vechi milla da ech amar leh moshe lamma. veha avadu kochavim umazzalot kema deat amer asu lahem egel masseche vayyishtachavu lo vayyomru elle vegomer. umoshe amar lamma. ella hachi olifna man dimratztze leochora la bae lemebad hahu chova (deihu) rav, ella yazir leh kammeh. ulevatar yasge leh kammeh ochora (davar acher 33 chayyayva) dichtiv attem chatatem chataa gedola.

Vela shavik leh lekudesha berich hu ad demasar garmeh lemota dichtiv veatta im tissa chatatam veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta. vekudesha berich hu machil lon dichtiv vayyinnachem Adonai al haraa vegomer. venoach la avad ken ella baa leishtezava veshavik kol alma.

Uvechol zimna dedina sharya al alma, ruach kudesha amar vavy dela ishtechach kemoshe dichtiv (Yeshayahu 63:11) vayyizkor (yeme olam moshe immo) (vego) ayye hammaalem miyyam vegomer. dichtiv (Shemot 14:15) vayyomer Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay. deha ihu bitzlota salik lon min yamma. uvegin deshavve garmeh bitzlota alayyhu deyisrael beyamma. ikre (al shemeh) hammaalem miyyam. deihu assik lon min yamma.

Ayye hassam bekirbo et ruach kadsho da ihu moshe deashre shechinta benayyhu deyisrael. molicham battehomot kad itbaku maya veazlu bego tehome beyabbeshta diglidu maya (vecholla ittemar al moshe). (nusach acher veal da ikre moshe immo) begin deamsar garmeh al yisrael.

Amar rabbi yehuda af al gav dezakkaa hava noach lav ihu keday (begin) dekudesha berich hu yagin al alma begineh. ta chaze, moshe la tala milla bizchuteh ella bizchut avahan kadmae. aval noach la hava leh beman deyitle bizchuta kemoshe.

Amar rabbi yitzchak veim kol da kevan deamar leh kudesha berich hu vahakimoti et beriti ittach hava leh lemive rachame alayyhu. vekarbana deakriv levatar, deyakriv leh min kadmat dena dilma yishshachech rugeza mealma.

Amar rabbi yehuda may hava leh lemebad deha chayyayve alma havu margizin kamme kudesha berich hu veihu yakriv karbana. ella vadday noach dachil al garmeh hava, begin dela yeera beh mota bego chayyayve alma dehava chame ovadehon bisha kol yoma, vehech margezan kamme kudesha berich hu kol yoma.

Rabbi (elazar patach) yitzchak amar kol zimna dechayyayve alma asgiu, zakkaa deishtechach benayyhu hu itpas bekadmita. dichtiv, (yechezkel 9:6) umimmikdashi tachellu. vetaninan al tikre mimmikdashi ella mimmekudashi. venoach hech sheziv leh kudesha berich hu ben kol innun chayyayvaya. ella begin deyifkun minneh toladin bealma dehava tzaddik kedka yeut.

Vetu deihu atre behu kol yoma veyoma vela kabbilu minneh, vekiyyem benafsheh kera dichtiv, (yechezkel 3:19) veatta ki hizharta rasha vegomer. uchetiv veatta et nafshecha hitztzalta. mikkan kol man deazhar lechayyayva af al gav dela kabbil minneh hu sheziv leh legarmeh vehahu chayyayva itpas bechoveh. vead kamma yazhar leh ad deyimche leh ha ukemuha chavraya.

Rabbi yose hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon yoma chad, amar leh may chama kudesha berich hu leshetzaa kol chevat bera veof shemaya immehon dechayayvaya. i bene nasha chatan beire veofe shemaya ushear beriyayn ma chatu. amar leh begin dichtiv ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz. kulhu havu mechabbele archayyhu. shavke zinayhu vedavku bezina ochora.

Ta chaze, innun chayyayve alma garmu hachi lechol biryayn. uvaon (leashkecha) leakkechasha ovada divreshit. veinnun garmu lechol biryayn lechabbela archayyhu kema deinnun mechabbelan. amar kudesha berich hu attun beitu (leashkecha) leakkechasha ovade yeday, ana ashlim reuta dilchon umachiti et kol hayekum asher asiti meal peni haadama. ahadar alma lemayin kema dehava bekadmita mayin bemayin veha ittemar. mikkan ulehala aavid biryayn ochoranin bealma kedka yeut:
Zohar, Noach 3: Elle toldot noach vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach (Tehillim 112:5) tov ish chonen umalve yechalkel devarav bemishpat. tov ish, da kudesha berich hu deikre tov. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:9) tov Adonai lakkol. uchetiv, (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama. lehay kol chonen umalve. leatar delet leh middileh. vehahu atar minneh ittezan yechalkel devarav bemishpat, deha hahu davar la ittezan ella bemishpat kema deat amer (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha.

Davar acher tov ish, da tzaddik dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov ki peri maallehem yochelu. rabbi yose amar da noach dichtiv noach ish tzaddik. rabbi yitzchak amar da shevacha deshabbat, deveh patach tov, dichtiv, (Tehillim 92:2) tov lehodot laAdonai.
Rabbi chiyyay amar kolla chad vechulhu milla chada amru. veda avid toldot bealma. toldot dealma man innun. illen nishmathon detzaddikaya deinnun ibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu.

Rabbi shimon amar beshaata dekudesha berich hu mitatter beitroy, mitatter meela umittatta. meela meatar deamika decholla. mitatter mittatta bamme. benishmathon detzaddikaya. keden ittosaf chayyim meela umittatta. veitkelil atar makdesha mikkol sitrin uvera itmalyay veyamma ishtelim, ucheden yahav lecholla.
Zohar, Noach 33: Umoraachem vechittechem yihye. mikkan ulehala yehe lechon deyyoknin divne nasha deha bekadmita la havu diukenin divne nasha. ta chaze, bekadmita ketiv, (Bereshit 9:6) betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uchetiv, (Bereshit Adonai:1) bidmut elohim asa oto. kevan dechatu ishtannu deyukenayyhu mehahu diukena illaa veithappachu inun lemidchal mikkamme chevavn bera.

Bekadmita kol beriyyayn dealma zakfan ayynin vechaman diukena kaddisha illaa vezaan vedachalin mikkammeh. kevan dechatu ithappach deyukenayyhu meenayyhu lidyukena ochora. veithappach divne nasha zain vedachalin kamme shear beriyyayn.

Ta chaze, kol inun bene nasha dela chatan kamme marehon vela avrin al pikkude orayyta. ziv diukena dilhon la ishtanne mechezu didyukena illaa. vechol beriyyayn dealma zain vedachalin kammeh. uveshaata divni nasha avrin al pitgame orayyta, itchallaf diukena dilhon vechulhu zain vedachalin mikkamme beriyayn ochoranin, begin deitchallaf diukena illaa veitavar minnayyhu, ucheden shalte behu chevat bera, deha la chamu behu hahu diukena ilaa kidkachaze.

Veal kach hasheta kevan dealma itchaddash kemillekaddemin, barich lon beracha da veshallit lon al kolla, kema deat amer vechol dege hayyam beyedchem nittanu. veafillu nune yamma. rabbi chiyyay amar beyedchem nittanu. mikkadmat dena. dechad bera kudesha berich hu alma mesar kolla bidehon dichtiv uredu vidgat hayyam uveof hashshamayim vegomer.

Vayvarecha elohim et noach. rabbi chizkiyya patach (tehillim lak) ledavid maskil ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa. hay kera ukemuha, aval kera da beraza dechachmeta ittemar. deha taninan baasara zine shevacha shabbach david lekudesha berich hu vechad minnayyhu maskil. vehu darga chad meinun asara. vedavid atkin garmeh ad la yishre aloy hay darga.

Ashre nesuy pesha, deha beshaata dekudesha berich hu atkil chove vezachvavn divne nasha dehahu (davar acher kad hahu) tikla devistar chovin mistallekin veinun ochoranin zachyayn deinun betikla ochora machriin letatta da hu nesuy pesha.

Kesuy chataa beshaata dedina sharya bealma dihe mechafya dela yishlot aloy mechabbela, kema dehava lenoach dechasse leh kudesha berich hu mehahu chataa deamshich aleh adam al alma. dechevan dechataa da angid adam al alma, shear beriyyayn shaltan uvar nash dachil minnayyhu vealma la atkin betikkunih. uvegin kach kad nafak noach mittevuta kudesha berich hu barcheh. dichtiv vayvarech elohim et noach veet banav vegomer:

Veattem peru urevu. behanne birchan la ishtakkachu nukeve, ella et noach veet banav, aval nukeve la amar kera. amar rabbi shimon veattem kelala didchure venukeve kechada. vetu et noach leasgaa nukeveh. veet banav leasgaa nukeve dilhon.

Uvegin kach ketiv attem peru urevu lemebad toldot mikkan ulehala shirtzu vaaretz. vehacha yahiv lon kudesha berich hu sheva pikkude orayyta lon ulechol deatu abbatrayyhu, ad dekayymu yisrael betura desinay veityeyhav lon kol pikkude orayyta kechada:
Zohar, Noach 7: Vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinni nishchata. ammay nishchata. begin ki hishchit kol basar et darko, kema deittemar. rabbi chiyyay patach kera veamar (Yona 3:10) vayyar elohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa. ta chaze, beshaata divne nasha zachan venatre pikkude deorayyta, keden ara ittakfat, vechol chedu ishtakkechat bah. may tama begin dishchinta sharya al ara. ucheden kolla illae vetattae bechedva. vechad bene nasha mechabbelan archayyhu vela natre pekude orayyta vechatan kamme marihon, ucheden kivyachol dachyayn lah lishchinta mealma veishtearat ara mechabbela. deha shechinta itdachyay vela sharya alah ucheden itchabbelat. may taama itchabbelat. begin desharya rucha ochora alah dimchabbela alma. veal da amrinan deyisrael yahave oz lelohim dimkayymin alma. elohim da shechinta.

Veim chas veshalom i yisrael yishtakkechu chayyayvin ma ketiv, (tehillim 6) ruma al hashshamayim elohim vegomer mishshum dereshet hechinu lifamay. kafaf nafshi besivat chamas vesinat chinnam. karu lefanay shucha vegomer kegavvna dedor hammabbul divgin chamas dehavat benehon hava benehon sina udevavu.

Yachol af veara deyisrael ken. veha taninan ara deyisrael la sharya alah rucha ochora vela memanna ochora bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy. ta chaze, deara deyisrael hachi hu dela sharya alah (84 amud bet) memanna vela shelicha ochora bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy. aval shaata chada sharya alah lechabbela beni nasha. menalan middavid dichtiv, (divre hayamim 1 21:16) vayyar david et malach Adonai vecharbo shelufa beyado netuya al yerushala 40 ucheden itchabbalat ara.

Amar rabbi elazar afillu behahi shaata kudesha berich hu hava. ketiv hacha malach Adonai. uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 48:16) hammalach haggoel oti. uchetiv (Shemot 14:19) vayyissa malach haelohim. hen letav vehen levish kudesha berich hu shallit alah. letav begin dela itmassera techot shear memannan, vechol dayyre alma yichsefun min ovadayyhu. levish begin dela yechodun innun leshaltaa alah.

Vei tema (davar acher 33 lo) veha ketiv, (Eicha 1:10) ki raata goyim bau mikdashah vecharivu beta vei lav shaltin innun memannan la itcharav makdesha. ta chaze, ketiv ki atta asita uchetiv asa Adonai et asher zamam.

Ta chaze, ketiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata. nishchata vadday kema deittemar. hachi name (Yona 3:10) vayyar elohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa. deha keden ara karat leela vesalka bisliku illaa umekashta anpaha. kenukeva dimkashta legabbe dechura. hachi name ara. deha gedilat benin zakkain lemalka.

Vehacha dela tavu dara detofana ma ketiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata vegomer keitteta deistaavat veastirat anpaha mibbaalah. uvezimna deasgiu chove beni nasha beitgalleya, ara shavvita anpaha kenukeva delet lah kissufa mikkolla kema deat amer, (yeshaya 22) vehaaretz chanfa tachat yoshveha. veal da vayyar ki nishchata vadday. may taama begin ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz.
Zohar, Noach 9: Ki leyamim od shiva anochi mamtir al haaretz arbaim yom vearbaim layla vegomer. rabbi yehuda amar hani arbaim yom vearbaim layla may avidtayyhu. ella arbaim yom lealkaa chayyayve alma uchetiv, (Devarim 25:3) arbaim yakkennu lo yosif, lokovel arba sitre alma lechol chad asara. begin debar nash mearba sitre alma itbere. veal da umachiti et kol hayekum. veitzterich arbaim lealkaa uleitmeche alma.

Rabbi yitzchak hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon amar leh hay kera (dekamre) dichtiv vattishshachet haaretz lifni haelohim. i bene nasha chatan ara bemma. amar leh begin dichtiv ki hishchit kol basar et darko kema deittemar. kegavvna da (Vayikra 18:25) vattitma haaretz vaefkod avonah aleha. ella bene nasha chatan vei tema ara bemma, ella ikkera deara bene nasha innun. veinnun mechabbelin ara vehi itchabbalat. ukera ochach dichtiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz.

Ta chaze, kol chetoy devar nash kulhu chabbaluta dileh talyayn bitshuva. vecheta deoshid zara al ara umechabbela archeh veappik zara al ara, mechabbil leh umechabbil ara. vealeh ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:22) nichtam avonich lefanay. uchetiv beh (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra. bar bitshuva sagge. uchetiv, (Bereshit 38:7) vayhi er bechor yehuda ra beene Adonai vaymitehu Adonai veha ittemar.

Amar leh ammay dain kudesha berich hu alma bemaya vela beesha vela bemilla ochora. amar leh raza hu deha innun chabbilu archayyhu begin demayin ilain umayin tattain la itchabbaru dechar venukeva kedka yeut. uman illen mayyin illain bina. umayyin tattain malchut. hei illaa hei tattaa. vechad innun mechabbelin, istalak 16 dehu dechar, veishtaar hei beHei (umayin bemayin. man innun dechabbilu archayyhu, kegavvna da mayin dechurin venukeve. veal da itdanu bemayya bema deinnun chavu.

Umayin havo retichan ufashtu mashka minnayyhu kema dechabbilu archayyhu bemayin retichan. dina lekabbel dina. hada hu dichtiv) nivkeu kol mayeynot tehom rabba, ha mayin tattain. vaarubbot hashshamayim niftachu da mayin illain. mayin illain vetattain.

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yehuda havu azle bearcha. umatu legabbe turin ravrevan veashkachu bene turaya garme bene nasha dehavu meinnun beni tofana. ufasu telat mea pesian begarma chada. tevavhu. amru hayeynu deamru chavrana deinnun la havu missetafe middina dekudesha berich hu kema dichtiv, (iyyov 21:14-15) vayyomru lael sur mimmennu vedaat derachecha lo chafatznu. ma avdu. havu setimin beraglayyhu mabbue tehoma. umayin nafkin retichan vela yachilu lemekam behu, ad dehavu nishmatin unefalu beara umayytin:

rashi: Vahakimoti et beriti. berit haya tzarich al happerot shello yirkevu viappeshu veshello yaharguhu reshaim shebbaddor (202):
Atta uvanecha veishtecha. haanashim levad vehannashim levad; mikkan shenneesru betashmish hammitta: (sham):
ohc: Vahakimoti et beriti vegomer. haya tzarich lehakedim lomar "uvata el hatteva" ad sof, veachar kach yomar "vahakimoti et beriti". verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Bereshit Rabba 31:12) berit shello yaharguhu reshaim shebbaddor, ad kan. ulederech ze tzarich lehakedim "vahakimoti" vegomer kodem "uvata".

Od nire shekkavvanat Adonai hi, leheyot shehechlit lo haggezera al bene doro veamar lo kol asher baaretz yigva, chash ki yachshov noach ki keshem sheherahu barishonim ken yikker mikrehu umikre zaro lehimmachot bedor acher, vezo hatztzala sheen tachlitah hatztzala kayyemet. laze techef umiyyad ramaz lo ma sheasa levassof, shekkarat immo berit leval yavi od mabbul velo yikkaret od kol basar. veze hu shiur hakkatuv kol asher baaretz yigva vahakimoti et beriti ittach shello yeera lecha kaddavar hazze ulehimmalet meharaa hammetzuya "uvata el hatteva" vegomer.

Od yechavven lomar shekkiyyem immo berit shello yishkachehu batteva vahare hu avud meatzmo. vehi sheamda lo, shenneemar (Bereshit 8:1): "vayyizkor elohim et noach vegomer vayyaaver vegomer ruach al haaretz" vegomer, veachare chen tzivva lo likkanes latteva bekiyyum berit ze. vahagam shello huzekar sham berit, samach al ma shehuzekar kan. veefshar sheramaz beamro "vayyizkor elohim", ki shem ze yikkare al hammishpat uvaddin zachar et habberit. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (Bereshit Rabba 113) ki hafach haddin lerachamim letzad tzidkato, veze derech derash.

rashi: Az tavin yirat Adonai. musav al inyan shellemala, sheamar ki im labbina tikra:
targum: Heden titbayen dechalteh deelaha vidiata min kodam elaha tishkach:

rashi: Atta veishtecha vegomer. ish veishto, kan hittir lahem tashmish hammitta:
ohc: Tze min hatteva atta veishtecha vegomer. nitkavven lehattir lo davar sheasar lo beet kenisato latteva, vegam bishar mine nivraim tzivva Adonai lahem veshartzu veravu. vedikdek lomar tze vegomer veachar kach hizkir yichud hazzecharim vehannekevot, lomar shekkol od shehem batteva, hagam sheshshalmu yeme hatztzara, hem beissur hazziuug ad achar yetzia. vechen timtza sheamar hakkatuv achar ze: "vayyetze noach uvanav veishto" vegomer – zecharim levad unekevot levad ad zeman hayyetzia, sheddiyyek divre Adonai kemo sheddiyyaknu. gam mimmotza davar atta yodea ki shamru mitzvat Adonai vehayu perushim minneshotehem kidvar melech kol zeman heyotam batteva ad sheyyatzu, vehu amro vayyetze noach uvanav hare ze more beetzba shead zeman hayyetzia hem perushim, veayyen ma shekkatavnu befasuk (Bereshit 9:7) "veattem peru urevu":

rashi: Vaani hinni. maskim ani immecha, shehaya noach doeg laasok bifriyya ureviyya ad shehivticho hakkabba shello leshachet haolam od, vechen asa uvaacharona amar lo hinni maskim laasot kiyyum vechizzuk berit lehavetachati veetten lecha ot:
Basar benafsho. asar lahem ever min hachay, kelomar kol zeman shennafsho bo, lo tochlu habbasar:
Benafsho damo. veod nafsho bo
Basar benafsho lo tochelu. hare ever min hachay, veaf benafsho damo lo tochelu, hare dam min hachay:

Baasiri niru rashe heharim. ze av, shehu asiri lemarcheshvan shehitchil haggeshem. veim tomar hu elul, vaasiri lechislev sheppasak haggeshem, keshem sheatta omer bachodesh hashshevii sivan, vehu shevii lahafesaka – i efshar lomar ken, al karchacha shevii i atta mone ella lahafesaka, shehare lo chalu arbaim yom shel yeridat geshamim, umea vachamishshim shel tigboret hammayim ad echad besivan; veim atta omer shevii layrida, en ze sivan, vehaasiri i efshar limnot ella layrida, sheim atta omer lahafesaka vehu elul, i atta motze barishon beechad lachodesh charvu hammayim meal haaretz; shehare mikketz arbaim yom mishenniru rashe heharim shillach et haorev vech yom hochil bishlichut hayyona, hare shishshim yom mishshenniru rashe heharim ad shecharvu fene haadama. veim tomar beelul niru, nimtza shecharvu bemarcheshvan vehu kore oto rishon, veen ze ella tishre, shehu rishon livriat olam, velrabbi yehoshua hu nisan:
ohc: Vehammayim hayu haloch vechasor. perush: chelek mehem haloch vechelek mehem chasor ad vegomer, veayyen ma shekkatavti bappasuk shellifne ze.

rashi: Vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham. baolam hazze; ma sheamru pen nafutz, nitkayyem alehem, hu sheamar shelomo megorat rasha hi tevoennu (Mishlei 10):
Noach uvanav. haanashim levad vehannashim levad, lefi shenneesru betashmish hammitta mippene shehaolam sharuy betzaar:
Mippene me hammabbul. af noach mikketanne amana haya, maamin veeno maamin sheyavo hammabbul, velo nichnas latteva ad sheddechakuhu hammayim:
Gam meof hashshamayim vegomer. bithorim hakkatuv medabber, velamad satum min hameforash:

Al pene terach aviv. bechaye aviv. umidrash aggada omer sheal yede aviv met; shekkaval terach al avram beno lifne nimrod al shekkittet et tzelamav, vehishlicho lechivshan haesh, veharan yoshev veomer belibbo im avram notzeach ani mishshello, veim nimrod notzeach ani mishshello; ucheshennitztzal avram, amru lo leharan mishshel mi atta? amar lahem haran mishshel avram ani, hishlichuhu lechivshan haesh venisraf, vezehu ur kasdim (202). umenachem peresh ur – bika; vechen baurim kabbedu Adonai (yeshaya 24), vechen meurat tzifoni (sham 11) kol chor uveka amok karuy ur:
Zot ot habberit. herahu hakkeshet veamar lo hare haot sheamarti:
Ki timmaes. keshettimmaes, peamim shekkoes aleha meat:
targum: Are cheitta shevika veaykat ruach arach shechinta dayya ucheittat ulemin deitrachakat amar elahayich:

rashi: Beetzem hayyom hazze. limmedcha hakkatuv shehayu vene doro omrim illu anu roim oto nichnas latteva, anu shovrin otah vehorgin oto, amar hakkabba ani machniso leene chullam venire devar mi yakum:
Ki hishchit kol basar. afillu vehema chayya vaof nizkakin lesheenan minan:

Vaysagevar Adonai baado. hegen alav shello yishberuha, hikkif hatteva dubbim vaarayot vehayu horgim bahem; ufeshuto shel mikra sagar kenegedo min hammayim, vechen kol bead shebbammikra leshon keneged hu, bead kol rechem (Bereshit 20:18), baadech uvead banayich (42 4), or bead or (Iyov 2), magen baadi (tehillim 3), hitpallel bead avadecha (Shmuel 1 12) – keneged avadecha:
Min haaretz vegomer. kevan sheraa ashshur et banav shomin lenimrod umordin bamakom livnot hammigdal yatza mittocham:
Shem ben meet shana. kesheholid et arpachshad shenatayim achar hammabbul:
Lintzor archot mishpat. sheal yadah yintzeru archot mishpat, vehu derech chasidav yishmor. shello yikkashlu:
targum: Lemintor archata dedina vearchata detzadikin nintar:

rashi: Hen am echad. kol tova zo yesh immahen, sheam echad hem, vesafa achat lechullan vedavar ze hechellu laasot:
Hachillam. kemo amram, asotam – lehatechil hem laasot:
Lo yibbatzer mehem vegomer laasot. bitmiha. yibbatzer leshon menia, chetargumo; vedome lo yivtzor ruach negidim (405 76):
Ki Adonai yitten chachma. ha lamadta sheggedola hi, shehare nittena mippi hakkadosh baruch hu, lechach atta tzarich liknotah:
targum: Metul deelaha yahav chachmeta min pumeh yediata uveyuna:

rashi: Vayyissachru mayanot. keshenniftechu ketiv kol mayenot; vechan en ketiv kol, lefi shennishtayyeru mehem otan sheyyesh bahem tzorech laolam, kegon chamme teverya vechayotze vahen:
Vayyikkale. vayimmana kemo lo tichla rachamecha (tehillim 40), lo yichle mimmecha (203 23):
ohc: Vayyissachru mayenot vegomer. ramaz hakkatuv derech haggeshamim vetigbortam, ki keshehammayim yordim lematta behechreach hammayim hattachtonim olim kenegdam, velo yimmatze ze belo ze. vehu sheamar hakkatuv vayyissachru vegomer vayyikkale haggeshem, ki 2 memot ellu meshammeshim keechad, vechen hu bedivrehem zichronam livracha (taanit ko:) en tippa yoredet millemala ella im ken tippayim olim kenegdah milmatta vechulei:

rashi: Meotzer umimmishpat lukkach. hannavi mevasser veomer, ki zot yomru haovde kochavim umazalot beacharit hayyamim, kesheyyiru keshennilkach min haotzer shehaya atzur beyadam, umimmishpat hayyissurin shessaval ad atta:
Veet doro. shanim sheavru alav:
Mi yesocheach et hattelaot asher metzauhu? ki nigzar haya mittechilla vegole meeretz chayyim, hi eretz yisrael, asher mippesha ammi ba hanega hazze latztzaddikim shebbahem:
targum: Misurin umippureanut yekarev galvatana uferishan deyitavdan lana beyomohi man yikkul leishteaa are yade shuletan ammaya meara deyisrael chovin dechavu ami ad levathon yimto:

rashi: Beno hakkatan. happasul vehabbazuy, kemo hinne katon netatticha baggoyim bazuy baadam (yirmeya 49):
Vayyaal kayyonek lefanav. haam hazze, lifne ba lo haggedulla hazzot, am shafal haya meod, veala meelav keyonek miyyoneket hailanot:
Vechashshoresh. ala meeretz tziyya:
Lo toar. haya lo mittechilla velo hadar:
Venirehu velo mare venechmedehu. uchesherinuhu mittechilla been mare, heach nechmedehu? venechmedehu tamuah hu:
targum: Veyitreva tzadika kodamohi ha chelavlevin defarchin ucheilan dimshalach shorshohi al nagdin demayin ken yisgon tuledat kudesha beara dahavat tzericha leh la chizu chula chezveh vela emte emat hedyot vihe ziv kudesha ziveh dechol deyachzineh yistakkel beh:

rashi: Tzohar. yeo challon veyeo even tova hammeira lahem (202 sham):
Veel amma techallenna milmala. kissuyah meshuppa veole ad shehu katzar milmala veomed al amma kede sheyyazuvu hammayim lematta mikkan umikkan:
Betziddah tasim. shello yippelu haggeshamim bah:
Tachtiyyim sheniyyim ushelishim. 3 aliot zo al gav zo, elyonim laadam, emtzaim lemador, tachtiyyim lezevel (sham):
Hattehora. haatida lihyot tehora leyisrael; lamadnu shellamad noach tora (sham 80 26):
Shiva shiva. kede sheyyakriv mehem karban betzeto:
ohc: Mikkol habbehema hattehora tikkach lecha vegomer. amro tikkach lecha, nitkavven lomar shene devarim: ha shehu yitrach lakachat tashlum hashshiva, veamar hattaam ki hem letzarche atzmo, vehu amro lecha letzarkecha. uvaze lo yikshe mi hittir lenoach lehakeriv karban mehabbehemot belo reshut haadon, ki elle tzivva Adonai lekiyyum hammin. veulay ki tamo leheyot shehaolam tzarich lahem beyoter yetzav Adonai lehasheir mehem shiva velo lekarban. ella bema sherasham Adonai veamar tikkach lecha herahu ki hem tzarche atzmo, velaze asa bahem kecheftzo vehikrivam laAdonai, vehitzliach bekarbano venirtza lo. veim yirtze gam leechol mehem yishchot veyochal, ki huttar lo habbasar mittaam asher avaer beezrat hashshem (Bereshit 9:3).

rashi: Minneurav. minneurav ketiv, mishshenninar latzet mimmee immo nittan bo yetzer hara:
Lo osif velo osif. kafal haddavar lishvua; hu shekkatuv asher nishbati meavor me noach, velo matzinu vah shevua, ella zo shekkafal devarav vehi shevua vechen darshu chachamim bems shevuot:
ohc: Vayyarach Adonai vegomer. kavvanat hahodaa lomar shehagam shehakkarban shehikriv noach minnechasav hem nichse shamayim asher bara Adonai beolamo, af al pi chen nitratztza bahem, uveemtzaut hakeravatam nadav lehetiv venishba shello yachrit od kol basar mibbeli sheelat davar mimmennu, ella kivyachol meatzmo nitratztza keillu ma shekkibbel hu shel hammakriv veeno shello. veal pi derech ze haya mefaresh mori verabbi adoni zekeni zatzal maamar echad (eruvin 65:) veze leshonam: kol hammitpatte miyyeno yesh bo middaat kono, shenneemar: "vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach", ad kan. peresh hu zichrono livracha: kol hammitpatte miyyayin shello ki yaggish elav oreach kos shel yayin miyyeno shel baal habbayit, uveemtzauto yaase lo mevukkasho mimmennu meatzmo, yesh bo middaat kono, ki chen asa Adonai kemo shepperashti besamuch. vedikdek lomar "mitpatte" lomar shennitpatta beemtzaut hammugash elav mibbeli sheyyitztarech elav davar. uchefi ze baa hodaat hakkatuv davar ze lemi sheyyirtze lalechet bedarche kono, gam lehakkarato etzlenu sheyyesh bo middaat kono. vahagam shemmatzinu bechamma mekomot sheamar hakkatuv "reach nichoach", lo matzinu shennitnaddev laasot tova meatzmo kaze ella sheyyitratztze bo o yimchol lo cheto.

Vayyomer Adonai vegomer lo osif vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar lo osif velo osif. verashi zichrono livracha peresh kafal haddavar lishvua vechulei, vechen darshu bemassechet shevuot (36:) ad kan. vekashe ki divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha lo kach hem, veze leshonam: amar rabbi elazar "lav lav" shevua vechulei, amar rava vehu deamar "lav lav" tere zimne, dichtiv "velo yikkaret od kol basar od mimme hammabbul velo yihye" vegomer, uchetiv (Bereshit 9:15) "velo yihye od hammayim lemabbul" ad kan. vehem 2 ketuvim habbaim bedivre Adonai lenoach besamuch, velo hochiach mippasuk ze kedivre Rashi.

Vetaam hashshas shello hochichu hashshevua mikkefel "lo osif" velo osif" haamurim befasuk rishon sheamar Adonai el libbo, yesh taam nachon baddavar, ki lo neemru shenehem bifrat echad sheyyihye nechshav kaful, ki "lo osif" rishona haya al perate haadama, veleheyot shellakta 2 o 3 peamim lesibbat bene adam: chata adam lakta adama, chata kayin lakta adama mibbeli tet kochah, chatu dor hammabbul lakta haadama. laze bitchillat retzono yitbarach amar "lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam" vaafillu lechelek echad mehaadama velo perat mipperateha. veod ratza Adonai benachat ruach shehayta az lefanav veamar "velo osif od lehakkot et kol chay" kaasher asa gam mibbeli hashechatat haaretz kelal. uchefi ze ayye mekom hakkefel lomar shehi hashshevua? laze darash rava mishshene pesukim vehem "lo yikkaret kol basar... velo yihye od mabbul" velo yihye od hammayim lemabbul" (Bereshit 9:11). veayyen kavvanat hakkatuv uderashatam zichronam livracha bimkomo beezrat hashshem. umeatta alu divre Rashi betzarich iyyun. veulay shehayta lo girsa acheret bashshas uchemo shekkatav harosh sham bishvuot. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk "velo yikkaret" vegomer.

Venishar lanu latet taam lamma shinna hakkatuv bemaamarav, paam hikdim "lekallel" kodem amro tevat "od", ufaam hikdim tevat "od" letevat "lekallel", velo hishva shiur devarav. hattaam hu leheyot ki hakkelalot shennitkallela haadama yeshnam lesheavar ulehabba shello yatzta mehem, ma sheen ken killat kol chay – hammetim kevar metu vehayu kelo hayu, vehachayyim en hekker bahem lema sheavar. laze diyyek Adonai bidvarav veamar lo osif lekallel od haadama yoter kelala al killatah shehi bah. vesamach tevat "od" achar sheamar "lekallel" lomar lo osif kelala beyoter mimma shehi. veze yaggid ki odenna biklala rishona, aval behakkaat kol basar hikdim "od" lahakkaa ki en betosefet hakkaa zo chelek meharishona, vedok.

Ki yetzer lev vegomer. perush al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet bava kamma (39:) shor haitztadin shennagach patur, dichtiv (Shemot 21:28) "ki yiggach" velo sheyyaggichuhu, ad kan. vehen haadam minneurav, kodem sheyyavchin limos bara velivchor battov, yekaddemennu hara mishshenninar mimmee immo, vehara madricho bivchinato. vehaya ki yigdal kevar hitbia bo hara kemo shehitbiu hannegicha beshor haitztadin. vetaam ze yoil leval dano behikkaret, aval al kol panim anosh yeanesh al asher enennu shomea bekol haelohim, veyishtanne mishshor hammitlammed ki hu motar haadam min habbehema limos bara behakkiro velivchor battov. vehoil taanat "ra minneurav" shello yitkaes Adonai alav kol kach, shennire shehifli laasot ki yesh lo sibba lehareshia letzad limmudo minneurav:

rashi: Elle toldot noach noach ish tzaddik. hoil vehizkiro sipper beshivcho, shenneemar zecher tzaddik livracha (Mishlei 10). davar acher limmedcha sheikkar toldotehem shel tzaddikim maasim tovim:
