Baderavetayv. yesh merabbotenu dorshim oto leshevach, kol shekken illu haya vedor tzaddikim haya tzaddik yoter; veyesh sheddorshim oto lignay, lefi doro haya tzaddik veillu haya vedoro shel avraham lo haya nechshav lichlum (115 108):
Et haelohim hithallech noach. uveavraham hu omer asher hithallachti lefanav? (203 24), noach haya tzarich saad letamcho, aval avraham haya mitchazzek umehallech vetzidko meelav:

Hithallech. leshon avar, vezehu shimmusho shel lashon, belashon kaved meshammeshet lehabba ulesheavar belashon 1, kum hithallech (sham 13) lehabba, hithallech noach lesheavar; hitpallel bead avadecha (Shmuel 1 12) lehabba, uva vehitpallel el habbayit hazze (41 8) leshon avar, ella shehavvav shebberosho hafacho lehabba:
ohc: Elle toldot noach. amro elle sheyyore al pissul zulatam. yesh makom lomar shennitkavven lifsol doro, ella shello haya tzarich lehodia ze shekkevar nifselu venechtemu limmachot. achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 30:6) ikkar toldotehem shel tzaddikim mitzvot umaasim tovim, ad kan. dikdeku lomar "ikkar" velo hispik lahem lomar sheggam maasim tovim yityaches lahem shem toladot, ledayyek tevat "elle", perush elle hem haikkar latztzaddikim, ufasal beerkam habbanim hammuzkarim bapparasha hakkodemet dichtiv "vayyoled noach" vegomer.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 11:3) veze leshonam: noach omer lemoshe ani gadol mimmecha, umoshe omer lo atta hitztzalta atzmecha velo haya becha koach lehatztzil et dorcha, ad kan. vehu amro elle toldot noach, noach levad, veshalal zulato ki lo haya bo toelet livne doro velo hoilu zechuyyotav ella lo leatzmo, uvaze mityashshev kefel noach. gam amro bedorotav, lomar shello hoil kelum lehetiv ledorotav lehacheziram lammutav ki im hu levaddo uvanav shehem anaf mimmennu uvishmo nichlalim. od yirtze lehagedil shevach noach, ki yachid hu beshevach ze mimma shellefanav, ki hagam shekkedamuhu tzaddikim, hayu lomdim musar hasekel mibbene haddor hatztzaddikim, ma sheen ken noach shekkol dorotav hagam shehayu reshaim haya tzaddik, ucheneged perat ze amar elle lishlol ma shellefanav sheenam beerko.

Od yitbaer kol hakkatuv al ze hadderech, elle toldot noach vegomer, perush elle seder toldotav ma sheholid mehattovot beemtzauto. 1, noach, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha bivreshit rabba (Bereshit Rabba 25,2) veze leshonam: beshaa shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu haadam hishlito al hakkol, para hayta nishmaat lachoresh telem vechulei, mardu bo vechulei, kevan shebba noach vechulei, resh lakish amar kodem noach hayu hammayim olim umetzifin otam mikkivrehen kevan shebba noach nachu vechulei, ad kan. ze hu shemmone beseder toldotav beamro paam 2 noach. toledet shenit – ish, perush heyoto ish adama, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, Bereshit 11): "umeitztzevon yadenu" – ad shello ba noach lo haya lahem kele machresha vehu hechin lahem vechulei, ad kan. vehu sheramaz betevat ish. 3, tzaddik, ramaz ki hu yesod haolam al derech amro (Mishlei 10:25): "vetzaddik yesod olam", sheillu lo haya hu lo haya haolam bammetziut vehaya hakkol kelo haya bammabbul, uvo yasad Adonai olamo. 4, tamim, al derech amram zichronam livracha bechullin daf 6 (zevachim 116, avoda zara 10) veze leshonam: tzaddik bemaasav tamim bidrachav, uferesh Rashi veze leshono: bidrachav – anav ushefal ruach, ad kan. ze yaggid otzem ishshuro sheafillu bedorotav haraim et kullam haya anav vechulei, vehu lifnim mishshurat haddin, ki shurat haddin notenet "im chasid vegomer veim ikkesh" vegomer, vehu lo chen asa. veod sheafillu beene dorotav hukkar heyoto anav, vehu amro tamim bedorotav. veamar leshon rabbim lehaggid maalato. vehinne kol adam yassig hakkarat 3 dorot: ha dor aviv, vev doro, ug dor banav, vehiggid hakkatuv ki bechullam haya hu mesuyyam. vahagam shehaya metushelach ze hu levaddo nishar miyyeter harishonim shellifne fanav. Adonai, et haelohim vegomer, perush sheggam im Adonai hinhig naycha umenucha, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 105) veze leshonam: rabbi eliezer omer al shem karbano nikra, shenneemar "vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach", ad kan. velaze chazar lomar paam 2 "noach", velo hispik bema shehizkiro bitchillat happasuk. veamar leshon halicha ki chen yeamer gam al hahanhaga hattova, kederech amro (Devarim 28 9) "vehalachta bidrachav". vedikdek lomar hithallech lomar bitmidut haya meratztze kono yitbarach, vekarbano yochiach al hakkelal. uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim. gam amro "elle" ki en bakkodmim kayyotze betoldotav:

rashi: Niflega. nitbalbelu halleshonot venafotzu min habbika venitpallegu vechol haolam. lamadnu shehaya ever navi, shekkara shem beno al shem heatid; veshaninu veseder olam shebbesof yamav nitpallegu, sheitto bitchillat yamav, hare yaktan achiv tzair mimmennu veholid kamma mishpachot kodem lachen, shenneemar veyaktan yalad vegomer veachar kach vayhi chol haaretz vegomer; veitto beemtza yamav, lo va hakkatuv listom ella lefaresh, ha lamadta shebbishnat mot peleg nitpallegu:
Veyaktan. shehaya anav umaktin atzmo, lechach zacha lehaamid kol hammishpachot hallalu:

Umishsham hefitzam. limmed sheen lahem chelek laolam habba; vechi ezo kasha, shel dor hammabbul o shel dor happallaga? ellu lo fashtu yad baikkar veellu fashtu yad baikkar lehillachem bo, veellu nishtefu veellu lo neevdu min haolam? ella sheddor hammabbul hayu gazlanim vehayta meriva venehem, lechach neevdu; veellu hayu nohagim ahava vereut benehem, shenne safa echat udevarim achadim, lamadta shessanuy hammachaloket vegadol hashshalom:
Yeshacharuneni. yevakshuni:
targum: Heden yikruni vela eene nikreyan vela tishkechinani:

rashi: Vattarom meal haaretz. meshukkaat hayta bammayim 11 amma chisfina teuna hameshukkaat miktzatah bammayim; umikraot shellefanenu yochichu:
Tzippor kol kanaf. davuk hu, tzippor shel kol min kanaf, lerabbot chagavim (kanaf leshon notza, kemo veshissa oto vichnafav, sheafillu notzatah ola, af kan tzippor kol min marit notza):
Vayyaas noach. ze viato latteva:
ohc: Vayyaas noach kechol vegomer. Rashi peresh: "zo biato latteva", ad kan. veim laze nitkavven, lo haya tzarich lomar, ki mikra male dibber hakkatuv (Bereshit 7:7): "vayyavo noach vegomer el hatteva" vegomer, uchetiv (Bereshit 7:13): "beetzem hayyom hazze ba noach".

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu shellakach mikkol habbehema hattehora shiva shiva, umehaof hattahor shiva shiva, vehu asher tzivvahu Adonai besamuch. gam diyyek lomar kechol lirmoz al tevat kol haamur bemitzvat Adonai. vearev amud leferush ze shettimtza shebbechol hannichnasim latteva lo hizkir shiva shiva mibbehema hattehora velo meof hashshamayim ella shenayim shenayim, ulefi hannire ki lo kiyyem mitzvat Adonai sheamar lo shiva shiva. laze ba hakkatuv lehodienu ki asa kechol asher tzivvahu velakach shiva shiva vechulei:

rashi: Shenayim shenayim. kulam hushvu beminyan ze – min happachut hayu shenayim:
Bau el noach. meelehen:
ohc: Shenayim shenayim bau. dikdek lomar bau ki lo hutzrechu lechazzer acharehem ella meatzman bau. veamar shenayim shenayim al kol perate habbaim, vechalal baze behema tehora veof, hagam shetztzivva alehem shiva, lefi ma shepperashti lemala yeduyyak hakkatuv al nachon, ki ma shehu lekiyyum hammin enam ella shenayim, veotam hevi Adonai ad hatteva vehu kibbelan, aval tashlum hashshiva hu noach tarach beatzmo lakachat otam kemo shetztzivva Adonai elav "tikkach lecha" sheeno lekiyyum hammin hu yitrach beshello velo yatrichu min hashshamayim alav. vechen timtza od befasuk achar ze (Bereshit 7:15): "vayyavou el noach el hatteva shenayim shenayim", perush: ma shebbau meatzman hayu shenayim shenayim.

rashi: Lo yeshuvun. yikshe beenehem lifrosh mimmenna velachazor bahem:
targum: Kol deaylan la chazrin bishlam vela tzaydin archata dechaye:

rashi: Kullanu katztzon tainu. atta nigla:
Hifgia bo. netar al yado venitratztza al avon kullanu, shello hechriv olamo. hifgia 802 109, leshon 'techinna:
targum: Kulana keana itbadarna gevar lokovel orche gelena umin kodam Adonai havat raava lemishbak chove chulana vedileh:

rashi: Meshuvat petayim. et asher libbam shovav:
Veshalvat kesilim teabbedem. lefi sheroim harshaim shehem matzlichim, nidbakim beraatam veenam chozrin:
targum: Metul denehpechanuta deshavre tiktol inun vetue desichle tovdinun:

rashi: Veach et dimchem. aappi shehittarti lachem netilat neshama babbehema, et dimchem edrosh mehashshofech dam atzmo:
Lenafshotechem. af hachonek atzmo, af al pi shello yatza mimmennu dam:
Miyyad kol chayya. lefi shechatu dor hammabbul vehufkeru lemaachal chayyot raot lishlot bahen, shenneemar nimshal kabbehemot nidmu (tehillim 49), lefichach hutzrach lehazehir alehen et hachayyot:
Umiyyad haadam. miyyad hahoreg bemezid veen edim, ani edrosh:

Miyyad ish achiv. shehu ohev lo cheach veharag shogeg, ani edrosh im lo yigle vivakkesh al avono limmachel, sheaf hashshogeg tzarich kappara, veim en edim lechayyevo galut vehu eno nichna, hakkabba doresh mimmenu, kemo sheddarshu rabbotenu "vehaelohim inna leyado" – bemassechet makkot – hakkabba mezammenan lefundak echad vechulei:
Chatzarmavet. al shem mekomo, divre aggada (202):
Baadam damo yishshafech. im yesh edim hamituhu attem, lamma? ki vetzelem elohim vegomer:
Asa et haadam. ze mikra chaser, vetzarich lihyot asa haose et haadam vechen harebe bammikra:

Ben elohim uven kol nefesh chayya. ben middat haddin shel mala uvenechem, shehaya lo lichtov beni uven kol nefesh chayya, ella zehu midrasho keshettavo middat haddin lekatreg alechem lechayyev etchem, ani roe et haot venizkar:
Lachen. al asoto zot achallek lo nachala vegoral barabbim im haavot harishonim (sota yad 1):
Heera lammavet nafsho. leshon "vattear kaddah" (Bereshit 24:20):
Veet poshim nimna. saval yissurin keillu chata ufasha, vehu bishvil acherim nasa chet harabbim:
Velapposhim yafgia. al yede yissurin shebbat al yado tova laolam:
targum: Bechen afaleg leh bizat ammin sagiin veyat nichse kerakkin takifin yefaleg adaa chalaf dimsar lemota nafshe veyat merodaya shabad leorayta vehu al chovin sagiin yive velimrodaya yishtevek bedile:

rashi: Yattu. lemerachok
Metarayich. hem chavalim dakkim hatteluyim beshule ohalim, vekoshrim bitedot, shekkorin 442 109, vetokin baaretz:
targum: Afti atar bet meshrach umikirve arich yatve la timnein asga am mashiryatich veshiltonayich takifi:

rashi: Hotze. hotze ketiv, hayetze keri, hayetze – emor lahem sheyyetzu; hotze – im enam rotzim latzet hotziem atta:
Veshartzu vaaretz. velo batteva, maggid sheaf habbehema vehaof neesru vetashmish:
Vayyimach. leshon vayyifal hu veeno lashon vayippael, vehu miggizrat vayyifen vayyiven kol teva shessofah hei, kegon bana, macha, kana, keshehu noten vav yod beroshah, nakud bechirik tachat hayyod:
Ach noach. levad noach, zehu peshuto; umia goneach vechohe dam mittorach habbehemot vehachayyot. veyeo sheicher mezonot laari vehikkisho, vealav neemar hen tzaddik baaretz yeshullam (Mishlei 11):
ohc: Vayyimach et kol hayekum. perush: millevad haggevia harmuza bappasuk shellifne ze, gam nimcha kol ma shehaya omed mehem (sanhedrin kach:) beemtzaut ribbuy hammayim chom vekor, venimcha kol havayatan venaasu kemayim vehayu kelo hayu baolam. uvaze naskil divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (berachot 61:) veze leshonam: amar rabbi ame (tehillim kayit): "achor vakedem tzartani", achor lemaase vereshit vekedem lappuranut, dichtiv "meadam ad behema" vegomer ad kan. vekashe, vahalo mikra male dibber hakkatuv hakkodem laze "vayyigva kol basar haromes vegomer vechol haadam", hare sheachar shessidder kol hannivraim zachar geviat haadam. velidvarenu yechuvvan lomar al perat tzurat haggeviyya, ki hagguf nivra achar kol, ucheshemmacha Adonai lechol hayekum, golem tzurato haya rishon uchemo shekkatavnu. vediyyek gam ken tevat "tzartani" shechozer al hagguf, dichtiv "vayyitzer Adonai vegomer afar min haadama". aval beinyan haggevia shehi yetziat hannefesh mehagguf, lo haya chen, ki lo yatzta nafsho shel adam ella meuchar lakkol, kammuvan mehakkatuv.

rashi: Alumayich. neurayich:
targum: La tidchalin are la tivhatin vela titkanin are la titkalmin are vahatat ulemutich titneshin vechisude armelutich la tidkerin od:

rashi: Meish medabber tahpuchot. hem haeppikorsin shemmatin et yisrael meemunatan umehappechin et hattora leraa:
targum: Di titpetze min archa visha umin gavra dimmalel mefarcheyata:

rashi: Beanni anan. keshettaale vemachashava lefanay lehavi choshech vaavaddon laolam:

Ase lecha tevat. harebe revach vehatztzala lefanav, velamma hitricho bevinyan ze? kede sheyyiruhu anshe dor hammabbul osek bah 120 shana, veshoalin oto ma zot lecha, vehu omer lahem atid hakkabba lehavi mabbul laolam, ulay yashuvu:
Atze gavepar. kach shemo. velamma mimmin ze? al shem gafrit shennigzar alehem limmachot bo:
Kinnim. medorim medorim lechol behema vechayya:

Bakkofer. zefet velashon arammi, umatzinu battalmud kufera betevato shel moshe, al yede shehayu hammayim tashim dayyah bechomer mibbifnim vezefet mibbachutz; veod, kede shello yariach oto tzaddik reach ra shel zefet, aval kan mippene chozek hammayim zippetah mibbayit umichutz:
ohc: Ase lecha vegomer. yitbaer al derech maamar hannavi yechezkel (Yechezkel 14:14): "vehayu sheloshet haanashim haelle betochah noach daniyyel veiyyov hemma vetzidkatam yenatztzelu et nafsham". perush: davka shelosha yesh koach bizchutam lemallet atzmam shello yaggia alehem haraa, aval shenayim veen tzarich lomar echad mehashelosha lo yimna hammashchit mimmennu. veyesh mikkadmonenu shehikshu, vahalo matzinu shebbachurban nehergu tzaddikim vachasidim, dichtiv (tehillim 79:2): "natnu et nivlat avadecha". vetertzu veze leshonam: efshar shehaya chasid yachid ben rabbim beet hahereg, veneemar (tehillim 94:15): "ad tzedek yashuv mishpat", aval keshehem shelosha o yoter yetzarfu zechutam veyatztzilu atzman afillu toch haraa, ad kan. ze hu ma sheddiyyek Adonai benoam devarav keshetztzivvahu laasot teva lehinnatzel betochah, amar elav ki hattaam shehu tzarich lehimmalet batteva velo yagen baado zechuto bal kerov elav haraa, letzad sheen immo tzaddikim vehu levaddo nimtza, vehu amro ase lecha leshon yachid, velaze yesh lo lachush lead tzedek yashuv mishpat". umikkan atta lamed ki banav lo hayu tzaddikim kemoto, sheim hayu tzaddikim hem betzidkatam yemalletu atzman mibbeli miflat ki hem lemala mishshelosha. vetzarich leyashshev divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheheveti bappasuk shellifne ze ki avraham lo bikkesh al pachot measara lefi shellamad minnoach shehayu pachot measara vechulei ad kan, vekashe, noach lo haya ella yachid bedoro. veyesh lomar shetztzarich sheyyihyu tzaddikim gemurim kenoach veaz yemalletu atzman achar yetziat hakketzef baolam velo yitten hammashchit lavo el battehem lingof, aval lehagen shello yetze hammashchit hagam sheyyihyu tzaddikim lematta minnoach yoilu vaafillu lehagen al acherim. velaze perat bakkatuv bichezkel noach daniyyel veiyyov velo amar shelosha tzaddikim setam. veyesh lecha ladaat ki achar shennittan reshut lamchabbel mi hu ze veeze hu sheyyachol lehimmalet mimmennu.

rashi: Ish el reehu. umma leumma, mitzrayim lechush, vechush lefut ufut lichnaan:
Hava. hazeminu atzmechem. kol hava leshon hazemana hu, shemmechinim atzman umitchabberim limlacha o leetza o lemassa. hava hazeminu, aperaleyyr 109:
Levenim. sheen avanim bevavel, shehi bika:
Venisrefa lisrefa. kach osin hallevenim shekkorin 361 32, sorfim otan bechivshan:
Lachomer. latuach hakkir:
Baruch Adonai elohe shem. sheatid lishmor havetachato lezaro, latet lahem et eretz kenaan:
Vihi. lahem kenaan lemas oved:
Beshetzef ketzef. menachem patar: 'chori af, vedonash amar: 'bimat ketzef, kemo berega katon azavtich, vechen tirgem yonatan:
Uvechesed olam. sheyyitkayyem ad olam:
targum: Birgaz zeer salkit afe shechinti zeman zeera minich uvetavvat alam dela fesakan arachem alach amar parkich Adonai:

rashi: Mipperi darkam. happerot sheochlim bechayyehem batztzarot hammotzot otam, vehakkeren shemura lahem baggehinnom:
targum: Vaachalu min pere dearchathon umimilkehon yisbaun:

rashi: Miktze chamishshim umeat yom. hitchilu lachasor vehu echad besivan. ketzad? bechz bechislev pasku haggeshamim, hare 3 mikkislev vecht mittevet hare 32, ushevat vaadar venisan veiyyar 118, hare 150:
ohc: Vayyashuvu hammayim vegomer. perush: nimshachim veshavim hammayim shehayu bannimtza leyam okyaynos, veamro vayyachseru hammayim perush: shehayu nechsarim meatzman kederech mayim bolim mayim (Bereshit Rabba 13), veamro miktze chamishshim vegomer perush: inyan ze sheshshavu hammayim vechasru haya besof 150 yom liridat hammabbul.

rashi: Vayshallach et hayyona. lesof 7 yamim shehare chetiv vayyachel od 7 yamim acherim, mikkelal ze atta lamed sheaf barishona hochil 7 yamim:
Vayshallach. en ze leshon shelichut ella leshon shilluch, shillechah lalechet ledarka, uvezo yire im kallu hammayim, sheim timtza manoach lo tashuv elav:
Tifrotzi. tigberu:
targum: Are ledaroma uletzippuna titkefin uvenach ammin yertun vekirvin detzadyan yetvun:

rashi: Vayhi haggeshem al haaretz. ulehallan hu omer vayhi hammabbul? ella keshehoridan horidan berachamim, sheim yachzeru yihyu gishme veracha; keshello chazru hayu lemabbul:

Arbaim yom vegomer. en yom rishon min hamminyan, lefi sheen lelo immo shehare chetiv bayyom hazze nivkeu kol mayenot, nimtzeu arbaim yom kalim bechch bechislev lerabbi eliezer, shehachodashim nimnin kesidran echad male veechad chaser, hare 12 mimmarcheshvan vechch mikkislev:
Vayyiyyachel. hu leshon vayyachel, ella shezze leshon vayyifal veze leshon vayyitpael, vayyachel – vayyamten; vayyiyyachel – vayyitmatten:
Hinne yaskil avdi. hinne beacharit hayyamim yatzliach avdi yaakov, tzaddikim shebbo:
targum: Ha yatzlach avdi meshicha yerum veyisge veyitkof lachada:

rashi: Niggas vehu naane. niggas hinne benogsim vedochakim:
Vehu naane. beonaat devarim, 1076 109:
Lo yiftach piv. sovel haya veshotek, kemo hase asher lattevach yuval, ucherachel asher lifne gozzeha neelama:
Lo yiftach piv. musav al se lattevach yuval:
targum: Bee vehu mittetav vead la petach pumeh mitkabbel takife ammaya keimra lenichseta yimsar vechirchela dekadam gazzaha shatka velet lekivle depatach pume memalel mila:

rashi: Vayyachel. asa atzmo chullin, shehaya lo laasok techilla bintia acheret (202):
Ish haadama. adone haadama kemo ish noomi (Rut 1):
Vayyitta karem. keshennichnas latteva hichnis immo zemorot veyichure teenim (202):
Mikketz arbaim yom. mishshenniru rashe heharim:
Et challon hatteva asher asa. letzohar, velo ze petach hatteva heasuy levia vitzia:
ohc: Vayhi mikketz vegomer. tzarich ladaat minnayin yada zeman sheyyachol liftoach challon hatteva, velo chash litvia bammayim pen yikraennu ason. veulay shehuvtach sheen yoter mishshenem asar chodesh. od mimma shehechin tzarche achila, umin hassetam hechin lizman mugbal, umizze yada shiur asher yihye shamur batteva.

rashi: Vayyigberu. meelehen:
Laleshavenavetam baaratzevatem. aappi shennechleku lilshonot vaaratzot, kullam bene cham hem:

Meishsha zara. mikkenesiyya shel afikorsut vehi hamminut. velo yittachen lomar, shello dibber ella al hamenaefet mammash, ki ma shivchah shel tora sheamar kan lehatztzilcha meishsha zara velo meavera acheret? ella zo minut, shehu perikat ol shel kol hammitzvot:
targum: Detitpetze min itteta chilonita minuchereta demilaha chalyan:

rashi: Vayyaas noach. ze binyan hatteva:

ohc: Vayyoled noach vegomer. kashe: 1, lamma hutzrach lachzor paam 2 lomar "vayyoled"? vahalo ketavo bapparasha hakkodemet (Bereshit 5:32)! 2, lamma hutzrach lehazekir shem noach velo samach al hazekarato besamuch? 3, lamma hutzrach lomar tzeruf cheshbonam "shelosha"? 4, lo haya tzarich lomar "banim", halo meamro "vayyoled" haddavar muvan ki habbanim banav? Adonai, lamma katav 3 etin?

Achen hakkavvana hi, leheyot sheamar hakkatuv "elle toldot noach" vegomer, lehodia ma shepperashnu bo shehakkatuv mesadder kol perate maasav hattovim asher mitztziddam matza noach chen beene Adonai, im lo haya chozer hakkatuv lomar "vayyoled noach" vegomer, tavo hassevara lomar ki va lifsol 3 habbanim letzad sheen lo bahem shevach velo zechut mehem, vedavar ze yihye beechad mishshene sibbot: o letzad shehayu bene mavet reshaim, o letzad shello asaam noach leshem mitzva. asher al ken chazar hakkatuv uchetavam beseder toldotav hattovim, ki gam et ze asa letzad tzidkuto lekayyem mitzvat boro. umatzati bammidrash sheamar (yalkut Bereshit 43) veze leshonam: histakkel noach shehem machisim lehakkadosh baruch hu, amar ma li lehishtaddel bifriyya ureviyya ad 500 shana, amar yamut haish belo vanim, vaAdonai amar peru urevu, miyyad nizkak lifriyya ureviyya. hare ki holidam letzad kiyyum hammin levad. veraiti ledakdek hakkatuv ledivre hammidrash al ze hadderech: et haelohim hithallech noach, perush sheraa shehaya karov lalechet bederech kol haaretz, laze techef nasa vayyoled 3 banim. o al ze hadderech et haelohim, perush leshon dayyanut, halach bivchinat haddin veraa sheyyeanesh im lo yekayyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya, velaze "vayyoled" vegomer. od yirtze al pi divrehem zichrono livracha (Bereshit Rabba 26:2) shennitkavven sheyyihye habbechor adayin lo higgia leonesh ben mea shana. kefi ze, yirtze amro et haelohim, shafat baddin sheyyihyu peturim banav kefi haddin, veaz yeladam, shello yeanshu behaggia hammabbul ki adayin enam bene onashim.

Vetaam shehutzrach lehazekir shemo paam achar paam lidvarenu yavo al nachon, ki yechavven lomar sheholid menucha shel 3 banim bema shennitchakkem leholidam beseder ze shello yihyu bene onashim bevo mabbul. veod achar haemet lo millevad shello hayu bene onesh, af al pi chen tzerichin hayu lizchut haav uveemtzauto nimletu, vetze ulemad mikkol ketanne dor hammabbul shello hayu bene onesh veaf al pi chen neevdu yachad. veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Bereshit 7:1) "ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay". vehem yalad lahem avihem tova noach meoyve nafsham mashchite olam, velo lahem levad holid tolada zo ella gam lig neshehem harmuzim beg etin, vechen hu omer "usheloshet neshe vanav" sheggam hem nitztzolu.

Vetaam shehutzrach lomar "shelosha vanim" yitbaer al derech ma sheamru besanhedrin daf 69, veze leshonam: teda dikra ka chashiv lehu derech chachmatan, dichtiv (Bereshit 5:32) "vayhi noach ben 500 shana vayyoled et shem" vegomer, uchetiv (Bereshit 11:10) "elle toldot shem, shem ben meat shana vayyoled vegomer shenatayim achar hammabbul", bar 102 shana hu, ella derech chachmatan ka chashiv lehu, ad kan. uchefi ze nitchakkem hakkatuv lomar "shelosha vanim" lehafesik ben zichron halleda lesidduram, sheim haya omer "vayyoled et shem" vegomer haya benishma ki derech ledatam chashiv, lo ken meamro "vayyoled shelosha banim" hare gamar hodaat halleda, veachar kach ba hakkatuv lesadderam kasseder asher reuyim lihyot nisdarim keseder chachmatan.

rashi: Ki heharim yamushu. af im tichle zechut avot veimmahot, chasdi meittech lo yamush (yerushalmi sanhedrin 10 1):
targum: Are turaya yedun veramata yitparkun vetuvi minich yerushelem la yede ukeyam shelami la yitrechak amar deatid lerachama alach Adonai:

rashi: Vahakimoti. eese kiyyum livriti. umahu kiyyumo? ot hakkeshet kemo shemmesayyem veholech:
ohc: Vahakimoti vegomer velo yikkaret kol basar vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lichpol lomar lo yikkaret vegomer velo yihye vegomer. veim lekayyem haddavar bishvua, halo matzinu ki rabbotenu zichronam livracha lo hotziu haddavar ella mippasuk ze ufasuk shelleacharav (Bereshit 9:15) sheamar "velo yihye [od] hammayim" vegomer, uchemo sheheveti divrehem befasuk (Bereshit 8:21) "lo osif", hareta ladaat ki kefel "velo yikkaret" velo yihye" haamur befasuk ze hutzrach legufo.

Venire lomar al pi divrehem besota daf 11 veze leshonam: "hava nitchakkema" vegomer, amar rabbi chama bar chanina: bou venitchakkema lemoshian vechulei, bou unedunem bammayim shekkevar nishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheeno mevi mabbul laolam, shenneemar (Yeshayahu 54:9) "ki me noach zot li" vegomer, vehen enam yodim sheal kol haolam kullo eno mevi, aval al umma achat mevi. i nammi, hu eno mevi aval hen bain venoflin betochan, vechen hu omer "umitzrayim nasim" vegomer, ad kan leshono. hinne lefi chilluk rishon, shiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: velo yikkaret kol basar od mimme hammabbul, perush: lo yavi Adonai mabbul lehacherit hakkol, aval miktzat im yitchayyev yavi Adonai alav raat mabbul. vechazar lomar velo yihye, perush: veim yihye mabbul al hammiktzat, amar Adonai shello yihye leshachet haaretz kederech sheasa bammabbul shehishchit guf haaretz. velo haya maspik lomar "velo yihye" vegomer, ki en ze ella havetacha laaretz lo laadam, laze amar "velo yikkaret". uchefi ze shene lavin sheanu lomdim mehem hashshevua: 1 hi "lo yikkaret" vehav "lo yihye" shebbappasuk sheachar ze, veen kefeda beshinnuy hallashon im hamechuvvan echad veamar alav bappasuk lo yihye haddavar.

Ulederech i nammi shechillek ben im yavi hammabbul o yeviem letoch hammayim kaasher asa lemitzrayim, hinne yesh lehistappek bedaat hattalmud im lo chazar bo mechilluk shechillek ben kol lemiktzat, uchefi ze gam lisvarat i nammi yihye yishshuv hakkatuv sheyyishshavnu yated bal yimmot. o efshar shehashshas chazar bo mechilluk rishon umechallek bechilluk acher, veen hefresh ben kol basar lemiktzatan. ulefi derech ze yitbaer hakkatuv al derech amram besanhedrin (81:) veze leshonam: amar rabbi akiva ella meatta "al tittammeu bechol elle" hachi nammi bechullehu lo bachada? in, ella beachat mikkol elle vechulei ad kan. kefi ze yitbaer amro velo yikkaret kol basar perush echad mikkol basar mimme hammabbul. veamro velo yihye vegomer lomar afillu belo hashechatat baale chayyim amar Adonai shello yashchit haaretz afillu chelek mimmenna mimme hammabbul. vehinne ben lederech rishon ben lederech sheni shene lavin ellu tzerichin leatzman veen kan yittur lav shete peamim, velaze hutzrach rava lehametzi shene lavin mishshene pesukim.

Veraiti leharif zichrono livracha shekkatav behilchotav, veze leshono: vehu deamar "lav lav" tere zimne, dichtiv "velo yihye od mabbul" vegomer "velo yihye od hammayim lemabbul" ad kan. mashma desover harif ki maamar Adonai "velo yihye mabbul leshachet haaretz" kalal haaretz veyoshveha, uvaze mana shene lavin, shehem "lo yihye vegomer leshachet haaretz" velo yihye [od] hammayim vegomer leshachet kol basar" shehem inyan echad. velidvarav zichrono livracha nachzor lehasekil lamma kafal lomar "velo yikkaret" velo yihye" befasuk echad? gam lamma lo nomar ki shene hallavin hem "lo yikkaret" velo yihye" shebbefasuk 1? venire lomar shessover perush hakkatuv al ze hadderech: shennishba Adonai shello yikkaret kol basar beshum min raa baolam, lo baesh velo bammayim velo kayyotze baze. veamro mimme hammabbul perush: mizzeman me hammabbul. vechazar lomar velo yihye od mabbul afillu perat echad. vehalach lederech sheniyya sheamar hattalmud. i nammi shello nishba ella shello lahavio velo lahaviam elav, uleolam berit hammabbul hu afillu lifrat echad. vekashe al ze, im ken minnayin mochiach shehayu bifrat ze shete peamim lav? velo chen hu, ki lav "lo yihye [od] hammayim lemabbul" amar beferush "leshachet kol basar". veulay nuchal lomar sheachar sheggilla Adonai dato shello yavi mabbul afillu lechelek mehaolam, kemo shemmuvan mippasuk "velo yikkaret vegomer velo yihye", nachzor lefaresh amro "velo yihye mabbul leshachet kol basar" al derech amro "al tittammeu bechol elle", shehakkavvana hi beachat meelle. ella shedderech ze dochak, yittur amro "mimme hammabbul" lelo tzorech, ki haddavar muvan shemmimme hammabbul hu omer.

Veraiti leharosh shekkatav sham veze leshono: veen nire li lo kegirsat harif vechulei, ella hane tere kerae sheamar Adonai lenoach vegomer "vayyomer Adonai el libbo lo osif vegomer velo osif" vegomer, teda ditlata lave ketive: "lo yikkaret" velo yihye" velo yihye", veim ken libbae 3, vei metzaraft lehu lihvu Adonai, ella vadday delo chashiv ella "vayyomer Adonai el libbo" vegomer vedumeya dehane deamar ze achar ze vechulei, ad kan. udevarav zichrono livracha rechokim etzli mishshemoa, ki Adonai dibber el libbo kivyachol az baharicho reach hannichoach, veachar kach dibber Adonai et asher chashav letova vehodia lenoach machashavto, uma mochiach mippasuk "lo osif"? veod, lo neemru shene hallavin beferek echad uchemo shekkatavti bimkomo. uma shettama shehem shelosha uvetzeruf yihyu chamishsha, mechila mikkevodo, ki shenayim rishonim kevar peresh mashmautam bimkomo taam shekkafal hashshem haddevarim, veotam lo lemedin mehem afilu lav echad, mippene shehem devarim sheamar bedato el libbo kivyachol. veim nashgiach bisode haddin, hagam shehayu shene lavin beferek echad, en lemedin mehem, ki amira ballev enah amira, ki en neder ushevua ella bevittuy sefatayim, veen lehochiach ella mimmaamar Adonai asher amar lenoach shehu pasuk "velo yikkaret" vegomer, velaze lo hochiach hashshas ella mippasuk sheamar Adonai. vechi metzarfinan et hallavin hanneemarim enam ella shenayim kemo sheyyishshavnu lemala, ki mippasuk "lo yikkaret" en hochachat shete peamim lav. al karchacha divre harif ikkar o kegirsatenu uchemo shepperashnuha lemala.

Vehinne missugeyat sota gilla hattalmud dato ki mesuppak beme mabbul im karat Adonai alehem berit leval yavo al chelek mehannivraim, vehechlit hattalmud shehammabbul lo nechlat ella mehavaato al hannivraim, aval lo havaat baale chayyim, ella "ki va sus vegomer bayyam".
Venishar laamod al hochachat berur haddavar, im habberit hu gam al shear pureaniyyot shello yavou lehacherit kol basar, o davka beme hammabbul hu shennishba.

Uvomidrash rabbot (Bereshit Rabba 49,9) amru veze leshonam: "chalila lecha" vegomer, nishbata veamarta sheen atta mevi mabbul laolam, ma atta maarim al hashshevua? mabbul [shel mayim] en atta mevi veshel esh atta mevi? im ken lo yatzata yede hashshevua! "hashofet vegomer lo yaase" vegomer, im olam atta mevakkesh – en din, veim din vechulei – en olam, veamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: "ahavta tzedek" vegomer, ad kan. mimmaamar ze muchach sheal kol pureaniyyot nishba, ben al shel mayim ben al shel esh. vechen muchach mizzevachim (zevachim 116.) sheamar lahem bilam shello yavi Adonai lo shel mayim velo shel esh. vetzarich ladaat ma kocho shel avraham battaana "im ken lo yatzata yede chovat hashshevua", im Adonai lo nishba ella al hammayim velo al haesh, kesheyyavi shel esh – shevuato kayyemet.

Achen hakkavvana hi, kelum shevua sheasa lamma? kede sheyyihye haolam batuach, gam hannivraim yifru veyirbu ki lo yigu larik, vezulat ze yeldu labbehala. veod, ma nachat ruach naasa laolam bishvuat mabbul im yihye hakkillayon bedavar acher? veim ken chovat hashshevua, perush davar shehitzricho lishshava bishvilo, lo kiyyemo Adonai. vehochiach avraham et avimelech al odot habberit sheyyeshnah ben lemabbul ben vechulei, hagam shello hizkir ella me hammabbul. vetaam shello hochiach avraham mippasuk "lo osif" vegomer, ki sham lo neemra shevua, uchemo shehochachnu beferushenu hefech divre harosh. vegam ledivre harosh yesh latet taam ki gam sham neemar "kaasher asiti" venichnas bechaf haddimmuy im hammayim.

Ella kashe bedivre avraham, halo hashshevua hayta al hakkol velo al chelek mehaolam. vaafillu lema shepperashnu sheggam al chelek hayta hashshevua, ze davka beme hammabbul, aval bishar puraniyyot lo matzinu remez lah. ulefi ma shepperashnu taam avraham sheeno mechallek ben mayim leesh, eno tzodek ella bechilyon hakkol, aval bifrat echad yesh elohim shoftim baaretz.

Od – roe ani ki hoda hakkadosh baruch hu letaanat avraham velo amad bah, shehare himtir esh vegomer "vayyahafoch Adonai" vegomer (Bereshit 19:25), veim hashshevua nitkayyema gam al hammiktzat vaafillu baesh, lamma asa Adonai bisdom ma sheasa?

Achen amittut divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha hu al ze hadderech, ki avraham taan taanat chachma, vehi ki ma taam nishba Adonai mehavi mabbul laolam? mimma nafshach: im hannivraim enam chayyavim, peshita shello yeavvel hael mishpat, ella shehagam sheyyitchayyevu lechallotam kemo shennitchayyevu dor hammabbul, af al pi chen yichbosh Adonai et haddin velo yaase mishpat mavet. zo hi kavvanat hashshevua. ha lamadta shekkavvanatcha shello taamid hammishpat al tillo, veim ken gam bema shellefanenu lo yaamid Adonai hammishpat kefi hamechayyev, vaavakkesh rachamim, kemo shebbikkesh. veim kavvanatcha bishvuat hammabbul davka bifrat ze shel mayim aval shel esh vechulei, vehaamadat kav haddin yeshnah belo migraat, veim ken kan gam ken taamid hammishpat veen makom litfillati – chalila lecha vegomer lehaarim vechulei, kemo shepperashnu lemala, ki hannivraim sheshshamu hashshevua sevaratam hi shello taamid mishpete haddin ad sof, veze arma chas veshalom, vechullin hu lo lehaarim al beriyyotav shehem yavinu davar vehu yechavven beofen acher. vetimtza shessiyyem hammaamar bedivre avraham veze leshono: im olam atta mevakkesh – en din, veim din vechulei – en olam vechulei, i at la tevatter tzivchar let alma yachel kayyaym, ad kan. hare shekkavvanat avraham hi lehochiach ki en hechreach sheyyaase hammishpat bishlemut. vehoda lo hakkadosh baruch hu al haddavar, venichnas avraham uvikkesh sheyyaase lemaan hatztzaddikim velo yeabbed harshaim sheimmahem, veze hu tzivchar mehaddin, venitratztza Adonai al haddavar. ucheshello matza tzad lehattot mishpat, nechtam alehem leabbedam. veen perat ze nichlal bishvuat Adonai, vehimtir al reshaim esh vegafrit. veet ze rau hammitzrim vechashvu ki vaesh Adonai vegomer (yeshaya 66:16) lehitchakkem shello yavou bemishpat haesh lihyotam perat baolam.

rashi: Lihyot gibbor. lehamerid kol haolam al hakkabba baatzat dor happallaga:
Patrusim veet kasluchim asher yatzu mishsham pelishtim. mishshenehem yatzu, shehayu patrusim vechasluchim machalifin mishkav neshotehem ellu laellu veyatzu mehem pelishtim:
Pen nafutz. shello yavi alenu shum makka lahafitzenu mikkan:

Vayyizkor elohim. ze hashshem middat haddin hu, venehefcha lemiddat rachamim al yede tefillat hatztzaddikim; verishatan shel reshaim hofechet middat rachamim lemiddat haddin, sheneemar vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam, vayyomer Adonai emche, (203 6) vehu shem middat rachamim:
Vayyizkor elohim et noach vegomer. ma zachar lahem labbehemot? zechut, shello hishchitu darkam kodem lachen veshello shimmeshu batteva:
Vayyaaver elohim ruach. ruach tanchumin vahanacha avra lefanav:
Al haaretz. al iske haaretz:
Vayyashokku. kemo keshoch chamat hammelech (Ester 2) leshon hannachat chema:
ohc: Vayyizkor elohim et noach vegomer. taam shello hispik zichrono shel noach vehosif lomar veet kol hachayya, ulay ki lehodia ba gam ki letzad hachayya vehabbehema asher itto levad yaspik lizkor, uferush haddevarim bederech lo zo af zo.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vayyizkor elohim et noach – gam zachar kol hattorach vehaol asher alav mehabbehema vehachayya vegomer asher itto batteva vechamal alav. gam baze kalal remez latztzara shemmetzaattu lenoach (tanchuma) meari asher hikkisho venistakken batteva lerov tosefet tirdato vechulei. gam meniat refua lemachalato, nimtzeta omer ki ikkar hazzikkaron hu lenoach.

Vayyaaver elohim ruach vegomer. hakkavvana hi lehodia ki Adonai tzivva al hammayim lehitgabber kaasher tzivva alehem besheshet yeme vereshit (Bereshit 1:20) "yishretzu hammayim", kemo chen tzivva lahem kan linhog betigboret. velaze timtza sheachar shennimcha kol hayekum amar hakkatuv vayyigberu hammayim vegomer, vehu lelo tzorech, ki kevar nimcha afillu galme hannivraim. vehattaam hu ki hammayim hayu asukim bemitzvatam asher gazar alehem Adonai, veen lahem lidrosh derashot limnoa hattigboret achar shennimcha kol hayekum, ad shezzachar Adonai lenoach veaz tzivva lammayim lihyot nachim mittigbortam. vehu amro vayyaaver elohim ruach chesed verachamim venimteku gevurot hammayim, vehu shettirgem uneklos "vayyashokku hammayim" – "venachu mayya" shello hitgabberu od.

rashi: Vechittechem. veematchem, kemo tiru chatat (Iyov 6) veaggada leshon chayyut shekkol zeman shettinok ben yomo chay en atta tzarich leshamro min haachbarim; og melech habbashan met, tzarich leshamro min haachbarim, shenneemar umoraachem vechittechem yihye, ematay yihye moraachem al hachayyot? kol zeman sheattem chayyim (shabbat 151):
Safa echat. leshon hakkodesh:

Udevarim achadim. bau veetza achat veamru lo kol hemennu sheyyavor lo et haelyonim, naale larakia venaase immo milchama. davar acher al yechido shel olam. davar acher udevarim achadim – amru achat leelef 662 shanim harakia mitmotet keshem sheasa bime hammabbul, bou venaase lo semichot (202):
ohc: Vayhi chol haaretz safa echat vegomer. yesh latet lev latur beinyan dor happallaga ma hi datam bivnot hair vehammigdal, sheim tamam hu bifrat mipperate hakkefira lo noda ofen hakkefira, gam lo haya Adonai maspik lehaanisham behafitz otam levad, veod tzarich ladaat amro lo yibbatzer mehem ki chas veshalom kimat yavo hattoe litot bah, veod ma hu kavvanat hakkatuv shekkatav lanu inyan binyan hair bapperatim hamegunnim, vahalo amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha ki mertzon Adonai haya sheyyitasseku bevinyan haolam.

Veefshar ki leheyot shekkaasher bara hakkadosh baruch hu olamo berao sheyyihye shelish yishshuv ushelish midbar, vetimtza hen hayyom kamma mekomot shel yishshuv sheim tismoch otam achat el achat lo yihye afillu chelek mimmea bishlish yishshuv hannizkar veyihye hakkol midbar. ella leheyot shehaayarot vehakkerakkim ben ir leir chelek karov uvene haolam ovrim veshavim mizzo lazo, baze yechashev hakkol, ben haayarot ben ma shebbenehem – yishshuv, uvetzeruf hakkol timtza shelish yishshuv. velaze neemar hayta chol haaretz safa echat udevarim achadim, ratzu sheyyihyu kullam mekubbatzim bemakom echad velo yitpazzeru ane vaana, vesheyyihye makom echad yishshuv davka. velaze banu hair lahem, perush: ir achat lechullam. velachashashat shemma yitpazzeru beorech haolam veyelech echad mehem ane vaana, asu hammigdal lihyot lahem lesiman shezzehu mekomam asher nikra shemam alav, vegam lehakkir hammakom merachok asher yihye sham uvo yavo leot hammigdal. vezehu amro pen nafutz al pene chol haaretz, shello ratzu lihyotam nifzarim vechalim zeer sham zeer sham. velaze amar Adonai ki haddavar hazze enennu nachon beenav, vehu davar sheyyecholim lehassigo leheyotam baale bechira veratzon bammaase haggashmi. velaze gazar omer lehafer atzatam ulevalbel sefatam, sheaz behechreach yihyu nifradim vechol echad yevakkesh lo makom. veze shehakkatuv omer umishsham hefitzam Adonai al pene kol haaretz. veze hu ed neeman leferushenu shekkavvanat Adonai sheyyihyu memalleim kol haolam, uvaze naasa shelish haolam yishshuv lesibba nodaat lo yitbarach shemo. veyesh baze sod kayyadua leyode chen, vechimat yihye dome limkatztzetz bannetiot umefannim hashepaa mimmakom lemakom. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu derashot harebe veen hammikra yotze mide peshuto.

rashi: Ketz kol basar. kol makom sheatta motze zenut vaaza anderolomuseya baa leolam vehoreget tovim veraim.
Ki mala haaretz chamas. lo nechtam gezar dinam ella al haggezel (115 108):

Et haaretz. kemo min haaretz, vedome lo ketzeti et hair (340 9), min hair; chala et raglav (41 15), min raglav. davar acher et haaretz – im haaretz, sheaf 3 tefachim shel omek hammacharesha nimmochu venittashteshu:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim vegomer ki mala haaretz chamas vegomer. veim tomar, bishlama im nefaresh amro chamas kemo sheamru merabbotenu (Bereshit Rabba 111) shehu avoda zara vegilluy arayot vechulei, yesh taam baddavar, aval lehaomer shehu chamas mammash shehu haggezel, lamma neenshu hannigzalim kaggozlim? hagam sheyyesh lomar shekkullan hayu gozlim, kol echad kefi sheyyesh yechalto mimmeshullal yecholet.

Im kol ze yitbaer haddavar al pi divrehem (Vayikra Rabba 23:9) sheamru veze leshonam: bemakom sheatta motze zenut vechulei vehoreget tovim veraim, ad kan. ulefi haddevarim yechavven hakkatuv letaretz kushyatenu, shehagam shennechtam gezar din al haggezel, im kol ze kevan shebbeotan averot shenniddonu alehem haya zenut, nehergu gam otan shello hayu gozlim. veim tomar velamma lo machalu ze laze velo yechatem dinam? veulay ki Adonai lo ratza legallot sod ze ella lenoach velo livne doro, venoach eno yachol lomar haddavar ki chol ma sheeno beemor hu beval tomar (yoma 4:). vetaam ki hakkadosh baruch hu haya yodea shello yachushu al haddavar, o efshar sheyyadu velo chashu lo, veze dochak ketzat ki lamma lo yetakkenu takkana sheen bah chesron davar. vehaikkar hu shehagam sheyyimchalu lo yoilu, kevan shehaya bahem din gezel vechayyavim mita hem alav, veeno bedin mechila beshum ofen. velo yikshe lecha maamaram zichronam livracha shekkatavnu lemala lema shepperashnu shello haya chiyyuv mita, en kavvanatam zichronam livracha shello hayu osim mehaggezel zulat ze, ella shehayu osim kol afne chamas ucheshehaya mizdammen leyadam metziut shello yachlu ligzol haya merammim kasseder haamur, vehayu mitkabbetzim alafim mehem ligzol kuppa shel turemusim.
Vetaam hodaat kol davar ze lenoach, hu letzauoto laasot teva lishmirat kiyyum hammin.

Veyesh latet lev maddua heelim ayin measot tzedaka bivne doro levakkesh rachamim alehem millifne Adonai. veod tigdal hakkushya sherainu ki avinu haggadol hu avraham lamad mimmennu, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 49) shello bikkesh rachamim al pachot measara mimma sheraa shennoach lo bikkesh vechulei, vekashe ki mi amar lo sheim haya mevakkesh lo haya mitkabbel?

Achen middivre Adonai asher dibber lenoach gilla dato lenoach ki haddavar muchlat beene Adonai lehashechit velo natan makom lenoach lehitpallel, keamro "ketz kol basar" vegomer "vehinni mashchitam" behechlet, ma makom lo lehitpallel. ma sheen ken kesheddibber devarav leavraham lo metzanuhu sheddibber kaddevarim haelle, ella natan lo makom lehitpallel, dichtiv (Bereshit 18:21): "erda na veere hakketzaakatah" vegomer. vahagam sheachar haemet gam sham alta lahem haggezera, af al pi chen asa Adonai asher zamam lehareot leavraham hanehagato, uchemo shepperashnuhu bimkomo, veamar devarim sheyyishma mehem avraham sheyyesh lo reshut levakkesh rachamim. vechen timtza bedabbero lemoshe betochachot al avon yisrael lo hechlit haggezera, uvaze matza makom lehitpallel, uchemo shepperashnuhu bimkomo (Bamidbar 14:11), ma sheen ken noach satam Adonai tefillato.

Veod lo, ki lo matza petach keavraham umoshe, shettaamam venimmukam immam, leheyot shello haya tzad hechreach baddavar lehodiam hashshem, vahare ze more beetzba ki shoel mehem sheyyitpallelu, ma sheen ken noach sheen makom lomar lamma hodia hashshem, ki yesh taam baddavar shehu lehachin teva vetzarkah, venosaf shehechlit haggezera, laze lo hitpallel. umehammaase lamad avraham kevan shehashshem lo natan lo makom lehitpallel, emor meatta ki pachot measara lo yaspiku.

rashi: Vayyitgal. leshon vayyitpael:
Oholo. oholo ketiv, remez ley shevatim shennikreu al shem shomron, shennikret ohola sheggalu al iske hayyayin shenneemar hashshotim bemizreke yayin (Amos 6):
Musar shelomenu alav. bau alav yissure hashshalom shehaya lanu, shehu haya meyussar lihyot shalom lechol haolam:
targum: Vehu yivne bet makdesha deittechal bechovana itmesar baavayatana uveulefne shelama yisge alana vechadnatzet lefitgamohi chovana yishtabbekun lana:

rashi: Od kol yeme haaretz vegomer lo yishbotu. 6 ittim hallalu shene chodashim lechol echad veechad, kemo sheshshaninu chatzi tishre umarcheshvan vachatzi chislev zera, chatzi chislev vetevet vachatzi shevat kor (choref) (42 106):
Kor. kashe mechoref:
Cheref. et zera seorim vekitnit hacharifin lehitbashshel maher, vehu chatzi shevat vaadar vachatzi nisan:
Katzir. chatzi nisan veiyyar vachatzi sivan:
Kayitz. chatzi sivan tammuz vachatzi av, hu zeman lekitat teenim uzeman shemmeyabbeshim otan bassadot, ushemo kayitz, kemo hallechem vehakkayitz leechol hannearim (302 16):
Chum. hu sof yemot hachamma, chatzi av veelul vachatzi tishre, shehaolam cham beyoter; kemo sheshshaninu bemassechet yoma shilhe kayyta kashe mikkayyta:
Veyom valayla lo yishbotu. mikkelal sheshshavtu kol yemot hammabbul, shello shimmeshu hammazzalot, velo nikkar ben yom uven layla (202 105 86 34):
Lo yishbotu. lo yifseku kol ele millehitnaheg kesidran:
Beni im tikkach amaray. beni tihye im tikkach amaray:
targum: Beri in tekavel milay ufukedani titshe gabbayich:

rashi: Nishmat ruach chayyim. neshama shel ruach chayyim:
Asher becharava. velo dagim shebbayyam (115 108):
Gibbor tzayid. tzad datan shel beriot befiv, umatan limrod bammakom:
Lifne Adonai. mitkaven lehakenito al panav:
Al ken yeamar. al kol adam marshia beazzut panim, yode ribbono umitkavven limrod bo, yeamer ze kenimrod gibbor tzayid:
Lehavim. sheppenehem domim lelahav:
Ki me noach zot li. shevua beyadi, veholech umefaresh devaro: kaasher nishbati meavor me noach vegomer:
targum: Keyome noach da kodamay dekaymet bememri dela yedun me tufana dahavo beyome noach od al ara ken kaymit bememri dela yechol rugezi alach vela ezof bich:

rashi: Lemishpechotehem. kibbelu alehem al menat liddavek beminan:
Yaft elohim leyefet. meturgam yafte, yarchiv:

Veyishkon beohole shem. yashre shechinato beyisrael. umidrash chachamim aappi sheyyaft elohim leyefet – shebbana koresh, shehaya mibbene yefet, bayit sheni – lo sharta bo shechina; vehechan sharta? bemikdash rishon shebbana shelomo shehaya mibbene shem:
Vihi chenaan eved lamo. af mishsheyyiglu vene shem yimmachru lahem avadim mibbene kenaan:
Mikkol habbehema hattehora. amar lo tzivva li hakkabba lehachenis meellu 7 7 ella kede lehakeriv karban mehem:
Meamal nafsho. haya ochel vesavea, velo haya gozel vechomes:
Bedato yatzdik tzaddik. haya shofet avdi mishpat emet lechol habbaim ledin lefanav:
Vaavonotam. haya sovel kederech kol hatztzaddikim, shenneemar "atta uvanecha tisu et avon hammikdash" (Bamidbar 18:1):
targum: Mishibud ammaya yeshezev nafshehon yechezun bepureanut sanehon yisbeun mibbizat malchehon bechuchemte yezakke zakkain bedil leshabada sagiin leorayta veal chovehon hu yive:

rashi: Vaani hinni mevi. hinni muchan lehasekim im otam shezzerzuni veamru lefanay kevar ma enosh ki tizkerennu (405 8):

Mabbul. shebbilla et hakkol, shebbilbel et hakkol, shehovil et hakkol min haggavoah lannamuch; vezehu leshon unkelos shettirgem tofana, shehetzif et hakkol, veheviah levavel shehi amukka, lechach nikret shinar, shenninaru sham kol mete mabbul:
ohc: Vaani hinni mevi vegomer. tevat "vaani" rechoka mishshemoa. verashi peresh: hinni muchan lehasekim im otam vechulei "ma enosh" vegomer ad kan. ulefi ma shepperashti lemala (Bereshit 6:11) ki hammashchitim milu haaretz vehuchenu lehashechit, hodia Adonai ki hu maskim lehareshotam ligmor haddavar. vahagam sheen kan ella hametarat haggeshem, tze ulemad ma sheamru bazzohar hakkadosh al hafelagat hammashchitim asher sham hayu venimtzeu.

rashi: Vayyered Adonai lirot. lo hutzrach lechach, ella va lelammed ledayyanim shello yarshiu hanniddon ad sheyyiru veyavinu, midrash rabbi tanchuma:

Bene haadam. ella vene mi? shemma vene chamorim ugemallim? ella vene adam harishon shekkafa et hattova veamar haishsha asher natatta immadi, af ellu chafu battova limrod bemi shehishpiam tova, umilletam min hammabbul:
Mezimma tishmor alecha. hattora tishmor alecha:
targum: Tarita tintor alach beyuneta tintzerach:

rashi: Ranni akara. yerushalayim, asher hayta kelo yalada:
Lo chala. leshon leda hu, shehayyoledet al yede chil vachavalim yoledet:
Mibbene veula. bat edom:
targum: Shabbachi yerushelem dahavat keitta akara dela yeledat bui tushebachta vedutzi dahavat keitta dela adiat are sagiin yehon bene yerushelem tzedita mibbene cherakka yetivta amar Adonai:

rashi: Beshiva veesrim. yeridatan bachodesh hashsheni veyz bachodesh, ellu 11 yamim shehachamma yetera al hallevana, shemmishpat dor hammabbul shana temima haya:
Yavsha. naasa garid kehilchatah:
Veattem peru urevu. lefi peshuto harishona livracha vechan letziuuy. ulefi midrasho lehakkish mi sheeno osek bifriyya ureviyya leshofech damim (yevamot 63):
ohc: Peru urevu. hutzrach lomar lahem ken, hagam sheamar lahem bitziatam "tze vegomer atta veishtecha" vegomer (Bereshit 8:16), en ze ella reshut velo mitzva, uvaa hammitzva kan meet habbore lifrot velirbot. vetzarich latet lev lamma chazar paam sheniyya letzauot velomar besamuch "veattem peru urevu" (Bereshit 9:7) velo hispik befaam achat, venire ki pasuk echad ba lemitzva ufasuk sheni ba lechova.

Vedikdek lomar veattem betosefet vav, lomar letzad shennishbati lachem shello yikkaret od kol basar, gam attem tekabbelu lifrot velirbot. umeatta tenay hu haddavar, ulefi ze yeduyyak al nachon maamaram zichronam livracha (nidda 13.) sheamru: kol haochez baamma umashtin keillu mevi mabbul laolam, ad kan. perush, kevan sheshshevuat Adonai shello yikkaret vegomer hayta bitnay sheyyekabbelu lifrot vechulei, kefi ze hammashchit zaro bittel hattenay ucheillu mevi mabbul vechulei, vehaven:

rashi: Achen cholayenu hu nasa. achen leshon 'aval bechol makom. aval atta anu roim shello mechamat shifluto ba lo, ella meyussar haya beyissurin:
Vaanachnu chashavnuhu. anu hayinu sevurim shehu senauy lammakom, vehu lo haya ken, ella mecholal haya mippeshaenu umedukka meavonotenu:
targum: Bechen al chovana hu yive vaavayatana bedile yishtavkun vaanachna chashivin ketishin machan min kodam Adonai umeanan:

rashi: Umikkol hachay. afillu shedim (202):
Shenayim mikkol. min happachut shebbahem lo pachot mishshenayim, echad zachar veechad nekeva:
Hava nerda. bevet dino nimlach meanvetanuto yetera:
Hava. midda cheneged midda – hem amru hava nivne, vehu chenegeddam madad veamar hava nerda:
Venavla. unevalbel; nun meshammesh bilshon rabbim, vehe acharona yetera, chehe shel nerda:
Lo yishmeu. ze shoel levena veze mevi tit, veze omed alav ufotzea et mocho:
Lachem yihye leochla. shello hirsheti leadam harishon basar ella yerek esev; velachem – keyerek esev shehifkarti leadam harishon, natatti lachem et kol (115 59):
ohc: Kol remes asher hu chay vegomer. yesh ladaat lamma lo huttar habbasar leadam ella lenoach. venire ki noach mishshello natnu lo leshalosh sibbot: ha, shebbeemtzauto matza Adonai lekayyem hammin vezulato lo haya mekayyem min haremes belo adam, uvaze zacha hu bahem. 2, shehu tarach bahem veyaga batteva, vetze ulemad kamma yegiot yaga bahem, vealav neemar (Tehillim 128:2) "yegia kappecha" vegomer. 3, sheggaram beemtzaut karbano shennitratztza Adonai venishba shello yikkaret kol basar vegomer, laze hittir lo Adonai leechol mipperi darko.

rashi: Vattishshachet. leshon erva vaaza (115 57) kemo pen tashchitun (6 4), ki hishchit kol basar vegomer:
Vattimmale haaretz chamas. gezel:
ohc: Vattishshachet haaretz vegomer. kol hakkatuv lo haya tzarich leamro, ki kevar katav bapparasha hakkodemet (Bereshit 6:5): "vayyar Adonai ki rabba" vegomer. veim lefaret hachet nitkavven, yoter meforeshet bapparasha hakkodemet, dichtiv: "rabba raat haadam vechol yetzer" vegomer. veim letzad shello hizkir sham hechamas, haya lo lehazekiro. veod, lamma bapparasha hakkodemet amar shem harachamim vechan amar shem elohim? od, lamma hutzrach lomar tevat "lifne haelohim"? od, lamma chazar od lomar vayyar elohim vegomer? im lehodia ba ki Adonai yodea kol hove, davar ze yadua hu.

Achen yitbaer hainyan al derech amram beavot (avot 4:11) veze leshonam: haose avera achat kone lo kattegor, perush malach mashchit. ach tzarich atta ladaat ki en hammashchit yachol asot davar kodem sheyyishpot shofet kol haaretz, she monam measot ra, vehu sod perush (Shemot 34:7) "nose avon". veachar sheyyishpot haelohim az yeshallechem beyad pisham shehem kattegorim shennivraim bemaasehem haraim, keamro (Yirmeyahu 2:19): "teyasserech raatech". veyesh lecha ladaat, ki hagam sheyyimna Adonai hamekatreg mehazzik leosehu, im kol ze kesheyyarbe – yikbol shello yisbol od, veyidchok lemaher maasehu leabbed bealav kodem sheyyiggamer dino, ki mishpato meforash, vehu amro vattishshachet haaretz lifne haelohim, perush kodem sheyyigmor dinam nishchata haaretz, perush mashlu bah mashchitim letzad maasehem. vedikdek lomar haaretz hakkavvana sheggam guf haaretz letzad hafelagat hachataim tekullal chelkatam baaretz, ki yashkinu bah hattiuv hannotzar mimmaasehem. veamro vattimmale haaretz min harauy haya lehakedim hassibba veachar kach hammesubbav shehu yetzirat hammashchit, ella nitkavven lehodia sheachar shehiggiu legeder ze od hosifu lehateiv yoter mehakkodem.

Chamas, perush: chamas hu kelalut haresha – bo gazel, bo gilluy arayot, bo shefichut damim, bo avoda zara, uchemo shehochichu razal (Bereshit Rabba lo) mehakketuvim, yeuyyan sham divrehem. vahagam shemmiddato yitbarach lihyot nose avon ad et bo devar mishpat, haddor hahu gadol avonam minneso bemiddat nose avon, al derech amro (Bereshit 4:13) kayin: "gadol avoni minneso". o yomar vattishshachet haaretz – hem maasehem haraim, umitztzad ze nitmallea haaretz mekatregim hammityachasim beshem chamas, vehu shehodia hakkatuv lenoach beamro "ketz kol basar ba lefanay", perush: otam hamekatregim shennivreu miyyoshve haaretz shennikra ketz, kemo shemmeforash bedivre hazzohar (chelek 1 63), ba lefanay vekovel lemaher leabbedam. vetaam hodaat kol hakketuvim hu lomar ki zulat ze haya Adonai maarich appo zeman ma, vahagam sheamar bapparasha hakkodemet (Bereshit 6:7) "vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam" vegomer, im kol ze yinnachem Adonai al haraa vehaya maarich appo, ella letzad hafelagat hammashchit, vehu amro vayyar elohim vegomer vehinne nishchata behafelaga, letaam ze miher Adonai lomar lenoach "ase lecha" vegomer. vetaam shehizkir befarasha zo shem elohim – hera ki gam middat rachamim nithappecha lemiddat haddin letzad maase harshaim.

Haaretz chamas. bammidrash (Bereshit Rabba lo) veze leshonam: haya mevi kuppa turemusim, vechol echad lokeach turemus echad veeno yachol lehotzio bedayyanim, ad kan. kevar kadmu rishonim vehikshu divne noach nehergu al pachot mishshave peruta. veli nire ki hammidrash megalle ki millevad shebbittelu ikkar torat 7 mitzvot, od lahem shehayu chomsim mittorat haadam hassichliyyit, ki haggozel peruta hu davar shehayu tovim oto velo pachot mishshave peruta, vehayu mitchakkemim ligzol beofen shello yitbeu otam. gam kefi haddin nire li ki lo chiyyeva tora livne noach ella al mamon habba leyadam bederech gezela, aval behakkafa lo yitchayyevu. vahagam sheharambam beferek 9 mehilchot melachim katav gam oshke sechar sachir yehargu alav bene noach, eno dome laze shebba leyado behalevaa sheyyomar "chayyav ani latet lecha lichsheyyavo zeman", vaanashim hahemma hayu notlim birtzono behakkafa lifroa achar kach, ucheshehaya mitratztze lehakkifam hayu notlin pachot mishshave peruta, uvehilchot halevaot lo hayu danim al pachot mishshave peruta im chayyav lo kesheyyiton "parati" o "yesh lecha kenegdo", vedavar ze eno begeder mitzvat gezela sheyyitchayyev mita, sheyyomar "savur hayiti sheen lecha beyadi kelum". od efshar lomar sheyyecholin liton betorat mattana ba leyadam litom liknot mimmennu.

rashi: Gevul hakkenaani. sof artzo. kol gevul leshon sof vekatze:
Boacha. shem davar. veli nire keadam haomer lachavero, gevul ze maggia ad asher tavo ligvul peloni:
Yitzpon laysharim tushiyya. genazah hakkadosh baruch hu etzlo (tanchuma, lecha lecha 11) esrim vashesh dorot ad shennetanah ledor hammidbar:
Magen leholche tom. (yitzpon magen leholche tom), kelomar: vehi tihye lecha lemagen:
targum: Yitshe litritze shivhor umesayea leilen dimhalchin bela mum:

rashi: Benosam mikkedem. shehayu yoshvim sham, kedichtiv lemala vayhi moshavam vegomer har hakkedem venasu mishsham latur lahem makom lehachazik et kullam velo matzu ella shinar:

ohc: Vayyishlach yado vegomer. perush: leheyotah ayefa vigea ki lo matza manoach vegomer, velaze chash aleha shemma en lah koach lauf yoter vetippol bammayim, veshalach yado chutz latteva veheviah el hatteva.

rashi: VaAdonai chafetz dakkeo hecheli. hakkadosh baruch hu chafetz ledakkeo ulehachaziro lemutav, lefichach hecheli oto:

Im tasim asham nafsho vegomer. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ere im tehe nafsho notenet venimseret bikdushati lahashivah li asham al kol asher maal, egmol lo gemulo, veyire zera vegomer. asham ze leshon 'kofer, shennoten adam lemi shechata lo, 106 109, keinyan shenneemar bappelishtim (Shmuel 1 6:3): "al tashivu oto rekam ki hashev tashivu lo asham":
targum: Umin kodam Adonai havat raava lemitzraf uledakkaa yat sheara deame bedil lenakaa mechovin nafshehon yechezun bemalchut meshichehon yisgun benin uvenan yorchun yomin veavde orayta dayya birute yitzlechun:

rashi: Vayyachel. leshon hametana, vechen li shamu veyichellu (Iyov 29), veharebe yesh bammikra:
Bachodesh hashshevii. sivan, vehu shevii lechislev shebbo pasku haggeshamim:

Beshiva asar yom. mikkan atta lamed shehayta hatteva meshukkaat bammayim 11 amma, shehare chetiv baasiri beechad lachodesh niru rashe heharim, ze av, shehi asiri lemarcheshvan liridat geshamim, vehem hayu gevohim al heharim chamesh esre amma, vechasru miyyom echad besivan ad echad beav chamesh esre amma leshshishshim yom, hare amma led yamim, nimtza, shebbeyv besivan lo chasru ella 4 ammot venacha hatteva leyom hammochorat; lamadta, shehayta meshukkaat 11 amma vammayim sheal rashe heharim:
Ken yazze goyim rabbim. ken atta gam hu tigbar yado veyazze et karnot haavovde kochavim umazzalot asher zeruhu (Zecharya 2:4):
Yikpetzu. yisgeru pihem merov timmahon, ki chavod asher lo suppar lahem al shum adam rau bo:
Hitbonanu. "istakkalu":
targum: Ken yevadar ammin sagiin alohi yishtekun malchin yeshavun yedehon al pumehon are dela ishtaiu lehon chazo udela shemau istakkelu:

rashi: Ki shacha el mavet betah. musav al lehatztzilcha vegomer, ki tavo el betah, yashach umachalik kemidron hayyored el mavet. vehattora tishmor alecha minnefila zo, hare davar gadol hu lecha:
Refaim. nirpim midderech hattov veneezavim meen somech, ad shennoflim baggehinnom:
targum: Divimka demota vetah ulegivaraya hilchata dishvilaha:

rashi: Vetiras. zo paras (202):
Vayyar cham avi chenaan. yesh merabbotenu omrim kenaan raa vehiggid leaviv, lechach huzkar al haddavar venitkallel (202):
Vayyar et ervat aviv. yesh omrim serso veyesh omrim revao (115 70):
Ledorot olam. nichtav chaser, sheyyesh dorot shello hutzrechu leot lefi shetztzaddikim gemurim hayu, kemo doro shel chizkiyyahu melech yehuda vedoro shel rabbi shimon ben yochay (202):

Kaasher shammu. kaasher tamhu alehem ammim rabbim birotam shiflutam, veamru ze el ze: kamma mishchat meish marehu (shel yisrael), reu ma tooram chashuch mishshear bene adam, ken kaasher anachnu roim beenenu:
targum: Kema disvaru leh bet yisrael yomin sagiin dahava chashich bene ammaya chezvehon vezivhon mibbene enasha:

rashi: Unelozim bemagelotam. kol leshon 'naloz leshon 'akmimut hu, shebbechol makom hu samuch leikkesh (Mishlei 4:24), veikkesh hu leshon 'akom, kemo shenneemar "umaakashshim lemishor" (yeshaya 42:16):
Unelozim bemagelotam. hem akumim bedarchehem hamekulkalim:
targum: Dearchathon meakman umippattelin shevilehon:

rashi: Mi heemin lishmuatenu. ken yomru haavovde kochavim umazzalot ish lereehu: illu hayinu shomim mippi acherim ma sheanu roim, en lehaamin:
Uzeroa Adonai. kazot bigdulla vehod, al mi niglata ad henna?
targum: Man hemin livsortana da utekof dera gevureta dayya kedun al man itgeliat:

rashi: Lehakeshiv lachachma. laasok battora:
targum: Vetatzle udnach lechachmeta vetafne libba livyuna:

rashi: Vayyikkach shem vayefet. en ketiv vayyikchu, ella vayyikkach – limmed al shem shennitammetz bammitzva yoter miyyefet, lechach zachu vanav letallit shel tzitzit, veyefet zacha likvura levanav, sheneemar etten legog mekom sham kever (Yechezkel 39), vecham shebbizza et aviv neemar bezaro ken yinhag melech ashshur et shevi mitzrayim veet galut kush nearim uzekenim arom veyachef vachasufay shet vegomer (Yeshayahu 20):
Ufenehem achorannit. lamma neemar paam sheniyya? melammed shekkeshekkarvu etzlo vehutzrechu lahafoch atzmam lechassoto hafchu fenehem achorannit:
Raiti tzaddik. velo neemar tzaddik tamim, mikkan sheomrim miktzat shivcho shel adam befanav vechullo shello befanav (202):
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai lenoach bo vegomer ki otcha raiti. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach letaam ze mechadash?

Venire ki chash Adonai al noach leval yite bemashmaut divre Adonai beamro bo atta vechol betcha el hatteva beechad mishshete derachim: o yachshov ki chullan tzaddikim hem velaze nimletu bizchutan, velisibba zo kashe ma shehikshenu bappasuk (Bereshit 6:14) "ase lecha". o yachshov ki banav uneshe vanav hatztzalatam hi letzad sheadayin lo higgiu lichlal haonesh, veyetze mizze sheyyachshov noach lehachenis lehatztzil mikketanne haddor kerovav umeyuddaav, veyadin bedato ki enam reuyim leonesh. velu yehi shello yaase chen, al kol panim tihye lo bedato ledavar zar lamma lo yinnatzlu mi sheeno ben onesh. laze amar Adonai elav ki otcha vegomer, netinat taam leamro "vechol betcha", lo letaam heyotam reuyim velo letaam heyotam kodem haggaat shene haonesh ella mittaam zechutecha ki otcha raiti vegomer, umeatta kol sheen aviv tzaddik yillached bammokesh. vechan hodio ki chol shello higgiu lichlal onesh neenashim baavon avihem, aririm yamutu kol haavot, lo chen noach.

Od yitbaer al derech amram bashshas (sanhedrin 110:) ketanne yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba, aval ketanne ummot haolam en lahem chelek laolam habba. uvedor hammabbul kullam din ummot haolam yesh lahem, shehagam shello higgiu leonesh yesh ladun bahem mishpat kemishpat rasha, ki maase avot yaasu banim, zera mereim banim mashchitim. venoach dan bo mishpat ketanne yisrael, veyinnatzlu bizchut avihem, gam bevo charon af laolam yagen Adonai baadam.

rashi: Mehaof leminehu. otan sheddavku veminehem velo hishchitu darkam, umeelehem bau, vechol shehatteva kolatto hichnis (202):
ohc: Mehaof leminehu vegomer. haya lo lehakedim habbehema im millemala lematta mesadderam, veim mimmatta lemala lamma sidder remes achar behema. veulay ki haof yesh bo tzad maala ki hu merubbe en ketz, vetze ulemad shehammuatim shebbaofot hem hattemeim vehem 24, veamru zichronam livracha (chullin 63:) shekch mine ofot behar habbayit vechullan min ayya, vetze ulemad lattehorim shehem harabbim kamma vechamma, vehabbehema hammuatim hem hattehorim asara veen beminam kol kach merubbe bechol min kaofot. asher al ken tzivvahu al haofot shehem rabbim techilla vetzarich lehavi mikkol min vamin shebbechol perat uferat, veachar kach hizkir habbehema shehi beminah muetet, veachar kach minim hashshortzim baaretz. uchefi ze sidderam hakkatuv derech tirchatam mimmala lematta.

rashi: Veachar nafotzu. meelle nafotzu mishpachot harebe:
Bachevadesh hashsheni. rabbi eliezer omer ze marcheshvan; rabbi yehoshua omer ze iyyar (205 11):
Nivkeu. lehotzi memehen:
Tehom rabba. midda cheneged midda, hem chatu berabba raat haadam velaku bithom rabba:
Soara. shellibbah soer berove tzarot:
Marbitz bappuch. rotzef ritzpatech meavne nofech:
targum: Chashivata mekabbela uleban karta deamrin ala ammaya la titnechem ha ana kavesh vitzdida avne ritzpatich vaashachlelinich beavnin tavin:

rashi: Hair haggedola. hi ninve shenne veninve hayta ir gedola lelohim (Yona 3):
Vayyetzu ittam. vayyetzu terach veavram im lot vesaray:
ohc: Vayyikkach terach vegomer. hakkavvana hi al derech sheamru zichronam livracha (bava metzia 75:) "man devish leh behay mata" vechulei ki shinnuy makom gorem, laze amar hakkatuv ki kaasher raa terach sheavram beno lo noldu lo vanim, asa shinnuy makom velakach et avram vesaray leholicham lemakom acher. vehodianu od hakkatuv baze shekkol kach haya chashuv avraham beenehem shebbishvilo nasu kol bet aviv leshannot hammakom bishvilo, vehu amro vayyetzu ittam:

rashi: Yatzo vashov. holech umakkif sevivot hatteva, velo halach bishlichuto, shehaya choshdo al bat zugo, kemo sheshshaninu beaggadat chelek (115 108):
Ad yevoshet hammayim. peshuto kemashmao. aval midrash aggada muchan haya haorev lishlichut acheret baatzirat geshamim bime eliyyahu, shenneemar vehaorvim meviim lo lechem uvasar (41 17):
ohc: Vayshallach et haorev vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma shelacho, veim lirot hakallu hammayim – haya lo lomar hakkatuv "hakallu hammayim" kemo sheamar bishlichut hayyona. veim lo hutzrach lomar, lamma hutzrach lomar bishlichut hayyona? od, ma hi kavvanat amro yatzo vashov ad yevoshet vegomer? im hakkavvana hi shello matza lanuach chutza vehaya chozer chalila, im ken lamma hutzrach noach lishloach hayyona velo haya lo haorev leot ulemofet sheadayin lo kallu hammayim? od, ma hi kavvanato behodaat "ad yevoshet"? od, lamma hutzrach latzet ad yevoshet kevan sheyyatzta hayyona bah haya maspik ladaat? od, lamma lo amar hakkatuv "vayyishlach yado vayyikkacheha" kaamur bayyona?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu al pi maamar razal (sanhedrin kach:) ki haorev shimmesh batteva, veyada bo noach, velaze kesheppatach challon hatteva gerash haorev mehatteva techef umiyyad. vehu amro vayshallach et haorev, velo hizkir "lirot hakallu hammayim" kemo sheamar achar kach bishlichut hayyona, vehu haorev haya yotze vashov, perush: noach megarsho vehu chozer, venishar bederech ze ad yevoshet hammayim. uleinyan shelichut lirot hakallu shalach hayyona, vehu amro vayshallach et hayyona meitto, perush: bishlichut lo lirot hakallu hammayim. vedavar ze lo yachol ledaennu mehaorev leheyot shehaya megorash velo bishlichut, ma sheen ken hayyona shehalcha bishlichut veheshiva oto ki lo matza manoach lechaf raglah, vetechef shalach yado ulekachah veheviah el hatteva, keamro vayyishlach yado vayyikkacheha vayyave otah elav el hatteva, perush: el makom hameyuchad lah lishmiratah, ma sheen ken haorev shemshullachat nisheret ucheshehaya chozer haya noach meshallecho paam acheret.

Veod yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kach:) veze leshonam: amar resh lakish, teshuva nitztzachat heshivattu orev lenoach. amar lo: rabbecha senaani veatta senetani, rabbecha senaani – "mikkol habbehema hattehora vegomer shiva shiva", veatta senetani – hinnachta min shiva veshalachta mimmin shenayim. ilmale pogea bi sar chamma o sar tzinna, lo nimtza haolam chaser beriyya achat, o shemma leishti atta tzarich? amar lo: rasha, bammuttar neesar li, banneesar li al achat kamma vechamma! ad kan leshono. hinne lefi midrash ze lo ratza harasha lalechet bishlichut shemma yifgeennu sar shel tzinna vechulei, o letzad shechashado lenoach bezugato, velaze hutzrach noach lishloach hayyona. veze shiur hakkatuv vayshallach et haorev velo ratza lalechet ella haya yotze vashov, umizze yada noach ki adayin hammayim al pene chol haaretz, aval lo yada im kallu o lo, sheen reaya meorev ki eno zaz mimmekomo. laze shalach et hayyona ladaat perat ze hakallu hammayim, velaze hutzrach lomar hakallu hammayim bishlichut hayyona, lomar ki lifrat ze hutzrach leshalchah, vehaven.

Uferush divre hammaamar hu al ze hadderech, ki haorev ba betaana al derech maamar hannavi (Tehillim 69:27): "asher hikkita radafu", perush ki min harauy lerachem al hammukke umeunne vehem hosifu lirdof, veze hu taanat haorev beamro: rabbecha senaani shehimit lekichat mini veatta hosafta lesina, sheim haya pogea vechulei nimtza haolam vechulei vahare atta mitnaheg beachzariyyut. o lichshennomar ki lo beachzariyyut asita, yesh ladun becha behechreach taam acher vehu shemma leishti vechulei, perush hagam shehi pechuta bemadrega, shemma letzad shenneesra alecha ishtecha chashavta ki lo neesra ella ishtecha velo zulatah vehutzrachta linkevati. veen kushya ma nishtannet ishto mikkullan, ki bechol achat yeshnah lishela zo.

O al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kach:) orev shimmesh batteva, uchefi ze taan ki lo nitavva ella laorev ki raa tashmisho, veamru zichronam livracha (avoda zara 20:) hahistakkelut baddavar molid hattaava veasru haddavar. veheshivo noach al ma sheamar "rabbecha" velo "rabbo" kerao rasha, veal ma sheddayyan ki leishto hu tzarich, ki kal vachomer hu: bammuttar li neesar, baasur mikkol shekken. im ken im yitztarech linkavav veyirtze bar minan laavor al haissur, hinne ishto lefanav sheen bah ella issur echad, millechet achar haorev sheyyesh lo bah 2 issurin.

Od nitkavven lomar lo "rasha" al derech amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin 70:) shekkol happosel bemumo hu posel, veleheyoto rasha chashado lenoach. aval letaanat "illu paga bi sar" vechulei lo heshivo davar, velaze amru zichronam livracha taana nitztzachat heshivo vechulei:

Od efshar lomar sheramaz lo beamro "rasha", teshuva leim yifga bi sar shel tzinna, ki kevar yada berishuto. vahagam sheyyifga bo sar shel vechulei, en haolam chaser mino ki hannekeva taana mimmennu, ma sheen ken shear ofot shello shimmeshu batteva.

rashi: Chayyat haaretz ittechem. hem hammithallechim im habberiyyot:
Mikkol yotze hatteva. lehavi shekatzim uremasim:
Chayyat haaretz. lehavi hammazzikin, sheenan bichlal hachayya asher ittechem, sheen hilluchan im habberiot:

Arur kenaan. atta garamta li shello olid ben revii acher leshammesheni, arur bincha revii lihyot meshammesh et zaram shel ellu haggedolim, shehutal alehem torach avodati meatta. uma raa cham shesserso? amar lahem leechav adam harishon shene vanim hayu lo, veharag ze et ze bishvil yerushshat haolam, veavinu yesh lo 3 banim veodennu mevakkesh ben revii:

Vecham hu avi chenaan. lamma hutzrach lomar kan? lefi shehapparasha asuka uvaa beshichruto shel noach shekkilkel ba cham veal yado nitkallel kenaan, vaadayin lo chatav toldot cham, velo yadanu shekkenaan beno – lefichach hutzrach lomar kan vecham hu avi chenaan:
Chamesh esre amma milmala. lemala shel gova kol heharim, leachar shehushvu hammayim lerashe heharim:
Avi kol bene ever. hannahar haya shem:

Achi yefet haggadol. eni yodea im yefet haggadol im shem, keshehu omer shem ben meat shana vegomer shenatayim achar hammabbul, heve omer yefet haggadol, shehare ben 500 shana haya noach keshehitchil leholid, vehammabbul haya bishnat shesh meot shana, nimtza shehaggadol bevanav haya ven mea shana, veshem lo higgi lemea ad shenatayim achar hammabbul:
Achi yefet. velo achi cham? sheellu shenehem kibbedu et avihem, veze bizzahu:

Nivze vachadal ishim. haya; ken derech hannavi hazze: mazkir kol yisrael keish echad, "al tira avdi yaakov" (Yeshayahu 44:2), veaf kan "hinne yaskil avdi" (Yeshayahu 52:13) bevet yaakov amar; veyaskil leshon hatzelacha hu, kemo "vayhi david lechol derachav maskil" (Shmuel 1 18:14):
Uchemaster panim mimmennu. merov bashtam veshiflutam hayu kemastir panim mimmennu, chavushe panim betamun, kede shello nire otam, keadam menugga shemmastir panav veyare mehabbit:
targum: Bechen yehe levuseran veyifsik yekar kol malkevata yehon chalashin vedavan ha keenash kevin umezuman lemarin uchema dahavat mesalka appe shechinta minana vesirin vela chashivin:

rashi: Keshoa. keanan haole pitom:
Kesufa. torbilon belaaz:
Yeete. yavo:
targum: Kad yete beshilya delucheychon utevarchon kealola yete kad tete alechon akta veshinoka:

rashi: Vayyitten et reshaim kivro masar et atzmo lehikkaver kechol asher yigzeru alav rishe haummot, shehayu konsin alehem hariga ukevurat chamorim bime hakkelavim:
Et reshaim. ledaat harshaim nitratztza likkaver, velo yichpor belohim chayyim:
Veet ashir bemotav. uledaat hammoshel masar atzmo bechol mine mavet sheggazar alav, al lo ratza lekabbel alav kefira, laasot raa velachmos chamas kechol haggoyim asher haya gar benehem:
Velo mirma befiv. lekabbel alav avodat kochavim umazzalot:
targum: Veyimsar yat rashiaya legehinam veyat attire nichsaya daanasu bemota deavadna bedil dela yitkaymun avde cheta vela yemallun nichlin befumehon:

rashi: Vayyamot terach becharan. leachar sheyyatza avram mecharan uva leeretz kenaan, vehaya sham yoter mishshishshim shana; shehare chatuv veavram ben chamesh shanim veshivim shana betzeto mecharan veterach ben shivim shana keshennolad avram, hare 145 leterach; kesheyyatza avram mecharan adayin nisharu mishshenotav harebe, velamma hikdim hakkatuv mitato shel terach litziato shel avram? shello yehe haddavar mefursam lakkol veyomru lo kiyyem avram et kevod aviv, shehinnicho zaken vehalach lo, lefichach kerao hakkatuv met, sheharshaim af bechayyehem keruyim metim, vehatztzaddikim af bemitatan keruyim chayyim, shenneemar uvenayahu ven yehoyada ben ish chay (shemuel 2 23):
(Becharan hannun hafucha lomar lecha, ad avram charon af shel makom):
ohc: Vayyihyu yeme terach vegomer. taam shello amar kasseder haamur bechol haddorot "vayyihyu kol yeme", yesh baze shete mashmaut: o lomar shechaya yoter miyyamav hacharutzim lo, o shello hishlim shenotav. vechan yisbol shete hadderachim, shechaya yoter mishshanim hakketzuvim lo bischar ma sheasa vetarach bishvil avram kaamur besamuch, chaya yoter. veharaya ki timtza shennachor avi terach hayu shenotav 148, veyater alav terach 57 shana, vehinne amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 65) kesheyyaggia adam lishne avotav yidag chamesh shanim kodem o chamesh achare chen, veterach chaya shanim aruchim yoter meaviv. laze hismich chayyut terach litziato im avram, lehodiacha mi garam lo arichut yamim hallalu – hu mitztzad "vayyetzu ittam" vegomer. ulefi ze im haya omer "kol yeme terach" haya nishma ki hem chayyav hakketzuvim lo meolam haelyon, veeno chen ella zacha vehosifu lo.

Vederech sheni hu, efshar sheyyoter shanim katzvu lo mimma shechaya im haya mashlim kavvanato lalechet artza kenaan, vetaam shello chaya shanav shelemim letzad sheyyatza im avram lalechet artza kenaan velo hishlim nidro uva ad charan vayyeshev sham, laze lo hishlim shenotav. velaze hodia hakkatuv inyan ze sheyyatzu lalechet artza kenaan uvau ad charan vayyeshvu sham, zo sibba shehayu yeme terach chamesh shanim umatayim shana.

Veraiti lifkoach ayin bifrat echad beavraham, ech azav et aviv asher yatza immo bishvilo vehalach lo, ki halo timtza ki terach haya ben 143 shana behippared avraham avinu mimmennu, ki ben 68 shana haya keshennolad avraham, uvelechet avraham artza kenaan haya avraham ben 75 shana, sheaz olim shene terach 143, vehu met ben 205 shana, veen rauy leavraham lehanniach terach aviv sheyyatza bishvilo veyelech lo. vahagam ki Adonai amar elav "lech lecha", kevar amru she amar elav "lech lecha" kedatecha lalechet, shehiskim al yado, hareta ki avraham meatzmo ratza lalechet.

Venire ki taam avraham hu, shechashav bedato sheshshalmu yeme aviv keshehiggia lishnat 143, hosif alehen Adonai shanim keamram zichronam livracha sheyyidag chamesh shanim kodem zeman chayye aviv, hare 148 shehem chayye nachor, uvazzeman hazze hinnicho vehalach lo. vehiskim Adonai al yado veamar lo lech lecha. vahagam shechaya yoter, af al pi chen kevan shello zacha lashshanim hannotarim ella bizchut avraham, lo yitchayyev avraham lehitakkev bishvilam. veulay shezze ramaz Adonai beamro lech lecha, perush: "lech" veencha choshesh lashshanim hannotarim ki "lecha" hem, perush: mishshellecha, umidrashim harebe yesh beinyan ze, vehappeshat lo yufshat.
Chassalat parashat noach

rashi: Taraf befiha. omer ani shezzachar haya, lechen koro feamim leshon zachar ufeamim leshon nekeva, lefi shekkol yona shebbammikra leshon nekeva, kemo keyonim al afike mayim rochatzot (Shir Adonai), keyone haggeayot kullam homot (25 7) uchemo keyona fota (Hoshea 7):
Taraf. chataf. umidrash aggada (280 18) leshon mazon; vedarshu befiha leshon maamar, amra yihyu mezonotay merorin kezayit beyado shel hakkabba velo metukin kidvash bide vasar vadam:
Yiska. zo sara, al shem shessocha beruach hakkodesh veshehakkol sochin veyafyah; veod yiska leshon nesichut, kemo sara leshon serara:
Barishon. lerabbi eliezer hu tishre ulerabbi yehoshua hu nisan (205 11):
Charvu. naasa chemin tit, shekkarmu faneha shel mala:

Ki leyamim od shiva. ellu 7 yeme evlo shel metushelach hatztzaddik shechas hakkabba al kevodo veikkev et happuranut. tze vachashov shenotav shel metushelach vetimtza shehem kalim bishnat 600 shana lechayye noach (115 108):
Ki leyamim od. mahu od? zeman achar zeman ze nosaf al 120 shana:
Arbaim yom. keneged yetzirat havvalad, shekkilkelu lehateriach leyotzram latzur tzurat mamzerim:

ohc: Vattehi saray akara en lah valad. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "en lah valad"? verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (yevamot sad:) aylonit hayta, shenneemar "en lah valad". venire lefaresh al derech ma sheamru sham bivamot daf 64 veze leshonam: amar rabbi ame, avraham vesara tumetumin hayu, shenneemar (Yeshayahu 51:1) "habbitu el tzur chutztzavtem veel makkevet bor nukkartem". uferesh Rashi: "chutztzavtem" – naasa lahem zachrut, "nukkartem" – shennaasa lahem nakvut vechulei ad kan. veamru od sham: nasa adam ishsha veshaha immah eser shanim velo yalda – yotzi veyitten ketubba vechulei, zecher laddavar (Bereshit 16:3) "mikketz eser shanim leshevet avram beeretz" vegomer. velelef miyyitzchak vegomer? yitzchak akar haya. i hachi avraham nammi akar haya? hahu mibbae leh vechulei ad kan. vechatvu hattosafot deakar sheamar kan hu tumetum sheamar rabbi ame, vahagam shemmin hassetam lo nasa ad shennikra alibba derabbi yehuda parich, sheamar tumetum shennikra en molid, veod afillu lerabbanan lo shechiach sheyyolid ad kan. hinne ledivre hattosafot hu haddin sheggam sara nikraat kodem shennisset. lefi ze yityashshev hakkatuv al nachon, ki leheyot shehayu shenehem tumetumin venikreu, uledaat rabbi yehuda enam yoldim, chash hakkatuv sheyyavin hashshomea ki ma sheamar "vattehi saray akara" hu letzad shehayta tumetumet, omer ken vehakkavvana hi shekkevan shehayta tumetumet mitztzad ze hu shemmuchzeket baakarut, asher al ken gilla veamar en lah valad, perush shennivdeka al yede zikka achar shennikrea velo yalda leavraham, ze hu amro "en lah valad", vedok.

Od nire ki lo amar rabbi yehuda tumetum shennikra eno molid ella hazzachar, aval hannekeva lo, veshachiach hi shetteled. ulefi ze shiur hakkatuv kach hu: vattehi saray akara, velo tomar shehaakarut sheomer hakkatuv hu letzad shehayta tumetemet keavraham, lo ken hu, ki hattumetum eno sibba meniat halleda ella baish velo baishsha, vechan haakarut hu shello yalda, vehu omer "en lah valad".

Uledivre haomer aylonit hayta, yitparesh hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vattehi saray akara – perush nimtzet shehi akara, vehakkavvana hi perush shennimtza bah davar shello haya nikkar bah mikkodem. hareta ladaat ki millevad heyotah tumetemet venikrea, hukkar bah heyotah akara, sheim al heyotah tumetemet lo yutzdak lomar "vattehi" havaya chadasha (shezze kodem shennasa haya yadua, ella shennivdeka venimtzet shello yalda), umeatta lamma hutzrach lomar "en lah valad" ella vadday lomar shehayta aylonit.

targum: Al disnoy yediata udechalteh deelaha la itreu:
Dechadyan lemebad bish veditzin behofcha devishta:
Beshaa zeera rechaktich uverachamin sagiin akarev galvatach:
Are marich deavdich Adonai tzevaot sheme ufarkich kadisha deyisrael elah kol ara yitkere:
Are teol chachmeta lelibbach vidiata lenafshach yivsam:
Vetive hech sima hech simata titzbeyah:
Veimma livyunenuta tikre velivyuna titten kolach:
Deshavka marbita detalyutaha ukeyama deelaha teat:
Deshavkin archata teritzata veazlin bearchata dachashocha:
Heden titbayen tzidketa vedina uteritzuta dechol shivle shappire:
La tzevu betariti veashliu li kol machsanuti:

bart: Umotzi et damo. dechelbo bilvad hu deshare. kidtanya betorat kohanim, keshehu omer chelev ushete kelayot baasham, sheen tzarich lomar demikkal vachomer hava yalfinan lah, uma shelamim sheen kol minan taun alya, hare hen teunim chelev ushete kelayot, asham shekkol mino taun alya, eno din sheyyitano chelev ushete kelayot, uma talmud lomar, ella lomar lach ma chelev ushete kelayot haamur baasham mutza mikkelal shelil, sheencha yachol lomar chelev shelil hannimtza baasham yakriv, shehare en asham ba nekeva, af kol afillu bekarbanot habbaim nekeva, chelev haamur bahen mutza mikkelal shelil. vechevan deen chelev shelil karev bechol hakkarbanot, share baachila. aval damo lo gara middam haevarim dekayma lan bemassechet keretot dam haevarim over belo taase:
Taun shechita. dochodashim garme leshavye behema beanpe nafshah velo itrabbe mikkol babbehema tochelu:
Vechayyav beoto veet beno. shello yishchatennu beyom sheshshachat et immo:
Vachachamim omrim shechitat immo metaharto. dochodashim veleda garme:

Rabbi shimon shezuri kulei. ledivre chachamim kevan shehalach al gabbe karka taun shechita midderabbanan, deate leichlofe leechol behema belo shechita. verabbi shimon shezuri mattir afillu leachar shehifris al gabbe karka. vahalacha kachachamim:
Keraah. labbehema belo shechita:
Rabbi meir mechayyev. desavar shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita:
Vachachamim potrim. desavre lav shemah shechita. vahalacha kachachamim:
Min shiva. chitta useora vegefen uteena verimmon zayit utemarim, dahane adife hoil venishtabbecha bahen eretz yisrael:
Mevarech al eze mehem sheyyirtze. dechaviv adif. vahalacha kachachamim:
