Bet shammay omrim mechabbedin et habbayit. makom sheachlu sham mechabbedim oto mishshiyyure ocholim shennitparru alav veachar kach notlim layyadayim mayim acharonim. difamim shehashshammash am haaretz umanniach happerurim sheyyesh bahem kazzayit, veim atta omer notlim layyadayim techilla nimtza atta mafsid et haocholim, shemmayim acharonim nittazim alehem venimasim. uvet hillel savre asur lehishtammesh beshammash am haaretz, veshammash talmid chacham eno manniach perurim sheyyesh bahen kazzayit ella mesir otam, veim nittazim hammayim al gabbe perurim sheen bahem kazzayit en bechach kelum, deferurim sheen bahem kazzayit muttar leabbedan bayyad. vahalacha kevet shammay baze, shemmuttar lehishtammesh beshammash am haaretz:

Shachat chayya yechassenna veachar kach yishchot et haof. dichtiv (Vayikra 17) chayya o of, hifsik ze mizze, lehatein kissuy lechol echad veechad. verabbanan savre, hay o mibbae leh lechallek, dei lav o hava amena en tzarich kissuy ella im ken shachat shenehem. vehakkol modim dilinyan beracha eno mevarech ella beracha achat. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veraahu acher chayyav lechassot. dichtiv befarashat kissuy haddam, vaomar livne yisrael, mitzva zo tehe al kol bene yisrael:
Kissahu haruach chayyav lechassot. velo shanu ella shechazar venitgalla, aval lo chazar venitgalla patur millechassot:
Dam hannittaz. al gabbe hakkotel:
Ematay. leferushe ka ate velo leifloge:
Maliach. kol davar maluach:

Shehappat tefela lo. mi sheachal achila gassa mipperot metukim beyoter ochel acharav davar maliach lechattech hallechot hannidbakot begufo mechamat rov happerot, umippene sheeno yachol leechol hammaliach levaddo ochel min happat immo. aval hammaliach levaddo ikkar vehappat tefela lo:
Ketzad mevarchin. chutz min hayyayin. shemmittoch chashivuto kavu lo beracha leatzmo. vechen happat:

Bore mine deshaim. lefi sheyyesh bichlal peri haadama deshe, uzeraim kegon kitniyyot, verabbi yehuda bae hekker beracha lechol min vamin. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda. veha ditnan al hayerakot omer bore peri haadama, hanne mile yerakot sheddarkan leachlan chayyin vaachalan chayyin o sheddarkan leachlan mevushshalim vaachalan mevushshalim, aval otan sheddarkan leachlan chayyin vaachalan mevushshalim o sheddarkan leachlan mevushshalim vaachalan chayyin eno mevarech alehen ella shehakkol. virakot sheochlin otam ben chayyin ben mevushshalim mevarchin alehen bore peri haadama, ben chayyin ben mevushshalim:
Gid hannashe. uvemukdashim. afillu ola shekkullah kalil, motzi et haggid umashlicho al haefer hatztzavur bammizbeach hakkaruy tappuach, veeno makrivo im habbasar:
Sheen lo chaf. en lo kaf yarech doma leshel adam shehu agol, ella habbasar sheal hakkulit shel of barochav hu. veim nimtza of sheyyesh lo kaf agol, gid hannashe shello asur:
Venoheg beshalil. ben tisha chay hannimtza bivhema:
Rabbi yehuda omer eno noheg beshalil. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Vechelbo. shel shalil muttar. perush acher vechelbo, shel gid. kelomar shummano shel gid muttar ledivre hakkol, ella sheyyisrael kedoshim nahagu vo issur:
Veen hattabbachim neemanim. lomar netalnuhu. mippene shettorach hu lahem lechattet acharav. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Behema shennechtechu ragleha. haacharonim:

Min haarkubba ulematta. shalosh atzamot bayyarech, hattachton hu etzem hannechtach im happerasot keshemmafshitin habbehema veotah rechuva nikret arkubba hannimkeret im harosh, uvilshon laaz korin oto perek 212, uvaaravi 113. ulemala hemenna etzem haemtzai vetzomet haggidim betachtito samuch leferek arkubba hannimkeret im harosh. vehaelyon hi kulit hattechuva baalya. vehapperek shebben sof hakkulit lerosh haetzem haemtzai nikkar venire baggamal keshehu rovetz yoter mibbishar baale chayyim. umin haarkubba ulematta dekatane bematnitin shehi cheshera hayenu mittechillat haarkubba hannimkeret im harosh ulematta. umin haarkubba ulemala dehaynu missof haetzem haemtzai shehu mekom tzomet haggidim, bechol makom shennechtach haregel mishsham ulemala terefa:

Vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin. afillu lo nechtach haregel shello nishbar haetzem ella shennittal tzomet haggidim, terefa. kach pershu ketzat amoraim mishna zo baggemara. veshita zo tafsu rabbotay ikkar vehoru shebbechol makom shettechatech haregel lemala mehaarkubba hattachtona shekkorin belaaz 202, ben bimkom tzomet haggidin ben lemala mitztzomet haggidin, terefa. aval rambam verav alfas rabbo tafsu ikkar happerush haacher, shemmefaresh min haarkubba ulematta keshera min haarkubba ulemala pesula, dehachi kaamar, lematta mearkubba haelyona shehu hakkulit hattechuva baalya, velo lematta miyyad hassamuch lo ella lematta meetzem haemtzai kullo dehaynu baetzem hattachton, vadday keshera. lemala min haarkubba dehaynu bakkulit, vadday terefa kol makom sheyyechatech. vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin, kelomar, uvaetzem haemtzai yesh makom shehi terefa kegon betzomet haggidin, veyesh makom shehi cheshera kegon lemala min hatztzomet. veal titma heach i pasek lah lemala min hatztzomet baetzem haemtzai keshera, ucheshettashpil lechatchah batztzomet terefa, sheen omrim bitrefot zo doma lazo, shehare chotchah mikkan umeta chotchah mikkan vechayta, velo neesra behema zo mippene shehi chatuchat regel mimmakom ze, ella mippene shennechtechu haggidin, shechatichatan hi mikkelal hatterefiyyot. umekom tzomet haggidin hu matchil min hammakom shehen nirim kashin ulevanim ad hammakom sheyyatchilu lehitrakkech ulehitaddem:

Tzomet haggidim. hem shelosha chutim levanim babbehema tzemutim umechubbarim yachad, echad ave ushenayim dakkim. veim nittal haechad heave levaddo en ze nittal tzomet haggidim, shehare nisharu shenayim. veim nittelu shenayim haddakkim mimmekomam mutteret, shehare haechad haav gadol mishshenehem vahare lo nittal kol hatztzomet ella miutam. veim nechtach rubbo shel kol echad mehen, terefa. veen tzarich lomar im nechtechu kullan o nittelu kullan. uvaof hem shishsha asar chutim levanim. afillu lo nechtach ella rubbo shel echad mehen, terefa:
Nishbar haetzem. lematta min haarkubba bemakom sheen ose otah terefa:

Im rov habbasar kayyam. dehaynu sheor uvasar chofim rov avyo verov hekkefo shel shever. dezimnin demashkachat leh ze belo ze kegon shemmarchiv mitztzad echad umetzer mitztzad acher, sheen haetzem agol, hilkach bae letarvayhu:
Shechitato metaharto. laevar hameduldal. umuttar afillu baachila:

Veim lav. sheen or uvasar chofim et rubbo, en shechitato metaharto. veaf al gav divhema mutteret have evar asur mishshum uvasar bassade terefa, kidamrinan [daf 73] lehavi evar uvasar hameduldalim. veim nishbar haetzem min haarkubba ulemala bemakom sheose otah terefa, im rov basar kayyam, evar uvehema muttar. veim lav, evar uvehema asur. vedin haof kedin behema ledavar ze:
Hare ellu feturot. dehoil ushenehen chershim o shetehen chershot, kekiddushe zo kach kiddushe zo, veatu kiddushin deishto af al pi sheenan gemurim, umafkee zikkat yevimto, shehare enah zikka gemura:
Yichnosu. sheen chalitza becheresh vechereshet, sheenan bivamar veamra. veachar kach im ratzu lehotzi yotzi beget, deate get birmiza umafka nissuin dideh vezikkat achiv dehavai birmiza:
Gid hannashe shennitbashshel im haggidim. shel hetter:
Bizman shemmakkiro. mashlicho lachutz veen kan ella pelitato:
Benoten taam. im yesh baggid shel issur benoten taam bechol ellu, kullan asurim:
Veim lav. sheeno makkiro: kullan asurim. divchol echad yesh lomar ze hu, velo batil berubba, dechivriyya hu chashuv uveriyya lo vetela:
Bizman shemmakkiran. lachatichot haissur, meshaarinan benoten taam, vei en bahen kede latet taam beshel hetter hare hashshear muttarot:
Veim en makkiran. kol hachatichot asurot. dechol achat yesh lachush velomar shemma zo hi. veenah betela verov, hoil ureuya lehitkabbed bah lifne haorchim:

Veharotev muttar. im en bachatichot haissur kede latet taam barotev uvakkippa uvachatichot. vahalacha lemaase beissur shennitarev behetter, min besheeno mino deikka lemekam attaama, im teruma hi shennitarva bechullin, yitamenna kohen, veim devar issur hu, yitamennu nachtom nachri, im omer sheen battaarovet taam hatteruma o taam haissur, hakkol muttar. vehemnuhu rabbanan lenachtom nachri, kevan dimlachto hu lo meshakker, shello yafsid ummanuto. veim nitarev min bemino delekka lemekam attaama, o min besheeno mino veen kan kohen o nachri shennuchal lismoch alav, im haissur hu mechelev vadam nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim uvehema veofot vedagim temein vechayyotze vaze, meshaarim oto beshishshim, im yesh shishshim shel hetter keneged haissur hakkol muttar, veim lav, hakkol asur. vechen shumman shel gid hannashe, meshaarim oto keneged shishshim shel hetter. aval kechal shennitbashshel im basar meshaarim oto beshishshim, uchechal min hamminyan, mippene sheissuro middivre sofrim. uvetza sheyyesh bah efroach shennitbashshela im shear betzim shel hetter, tzericha shishshim veachat kenegdah. veim haissur hu teruma vechalla uvikkurim, im hu min bemino o min besheeno mino, veen sham kohen [o nachri] sheyyitam, meshaarinan oto bemea shel chullin. veim arla vechile hakkerem, meshaarim otan bematayim. vechol hashshiurim hallalu meshaarim bechol ma shebbakdera, barotev uvachatichot uvattevalin uvakkippa, vehu haddak dak shebbeshule hakkedera. uchemo shehu va lefanenu meshaarinan leh, velo meshaarin bemay devala kedera min hahetter, lefi sheaf min haissur nivla venitmaet mikkemot shehaya, deattu dehettera bala deissura lo vala:

Berach al perot hailan vechulei. kol hecha dechi shakle pera iteh leanaf, veoto heanaf atzmo chozer umotzi peri lashshana haacheret, mikre ilan, umevarchin al perotav bore peri haetz, aval hecha dechi shaklat leh lapperi lo yishshaer anaf sheyyachazor veyotzi peri lashshana haacheret en mevarchin al happerot ella bore peri haadama:
Veal kullan im amar shehakkol yatza. vaafillu al happat veal hayyayin. umihu lechattechilla en leechol shum peri im eno yodea techilla sheyyevarech alav beracha haruya lo:
Shilya. kemin kis shehaubbar munnach betocho:
Nefesh hayyafa. sheen dato katza vah mechamat mius:
Tochlenna. velo amrinan evar min hachay hu, ella gam hi nitteret bishchitat haem:
Veenah metammea. dela chashiva ochel:
Velo tumat nevelot. im meta habbehema:
Metammea tumat ochalin. im naga battuma, demachashava meshavya leh ochel. aval tumat nevelot lo, delav basar hu ella kishar ochel bealma hu:
Asura vaachila. veaf al gav delo nafak ella pureta ufeshita dechol michuy havvalad lo haya sham, mikkol makom chayshinan shemma beoto miktzat yatza rosh havvalad vahare hu cheyalud:
[Hachi garsinan] siman valad baishsha, vesiman valad babbehema: hamevakkeret. zehu peter rechem shellah:
Yashlichenna lichlavim. sheen kedushsha bah. deaf al gav deen shilya belo valad, hacha rubba lav bat mekaddesha hi, dedilma nekeva havat o nidme hava velo kaddish:
Uvammukdashin. kegon behemat shelamim shehippila shilya:
Tikkaver. dechevan deen shilya belo valad, kaddesha, deven zachar uven nekeva denafek mibbehemat hekdesh, kaddish:
Befarashat derachim. makom shehadderachim mitparshim lishnayim, vederech hamenachashim lekavrah sham kede shello tappil od:
Darche haemori. nichush. uchetiv lo taase chemaasehem:
Tetze mishshum achot ishsha. ufetura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum:
Met balah shel gedola. venafla lifne baal hakketanna, zikkatah shel gedola shehi min hattora, oseret ketanna alav mishshum denissueha derabbanan, vehaveya lah achot zekukato, uma yaasu:
Rabbi eliezer omer melammedim hakketanna shettemaen bo. vetaakor nissueha, vihe meyabbem et haggedola. vehilchata kevateh:

Rabban gamliel omer. en zikkat gedola oseret et hakketanna, desavar rabban gamliel delo allima zikka leesor et ishto alav, hilkach im meana mutav vetityabbem haggedola, veim lav, tamtin hakketanna etzlo ad shettagdil veyihyu nissueha deorayta veachar kach tetze haggedola mishshum achot ishsha. aval lachalotz laggedola lo, defasal et harishona alav mishshum achot chalutza:
I lo. oy lo. shemmotzi et ishto beget, veen melammedin otah lemaen, deamrinan sheyyitrachek adam min hammeunim:
Mashchitin et hattabbach beal karcho. sheim kibbel dinar millokeach litten lo bedinar basar:

Afillu shor shave elef. zuz, shochato beal karcho, af al pi sheen lo lokchim lishar habbasar. lefi sheddevar tora maot konot umeet shekkibbel hammocher haddinar kana hallokeach habbasar. velo tikkenu chachamim shemmeshicha kona velo maot ella gezera shemma yomar lo mocher lakkone nisrefu chittecha baaliyya. dei mokmat lehu lefere beachrayut hallokeach mishshennatan hammaot, i mitreme deleka bevet hammocher shehapperot sham lo tarach leatzolinhu. aval leachar shemmashach missetama mamte lehu leveteh. uvearbaa ferakim ellu heemidu chachamim divrehem al din tora shehammaot konot:
Lefichach im met met lallokeach. umafsid laddinar, shehare birshuto met:
Eno chen. devainan meshicha vechol zeman shello mashach chozer bo hattabbach:
Cheresh. keshem shekkones birmiza. kelomar kekiddushin kach gerushin. vechen pikkeach bechereshet birmiza kanas, sheramaz lah ad shennitratztzet lo, uvirmiza yotzi im ratza lehotzi:
Venitcharsha. af al pi shekkiddushin gemurim hayu, sheppikkachat hayta beoto zeman:
Im ratza lehotzi yotzi. delo bainan daat haishsha:
Nishtattet lo yotzi. veaf al pi sheyyodaat lishmor gittah umitgareshet min hattora, tikkenu chachamim shello yegarshenna kede shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker:
Nitcharesh hu. leachar kiddushin, hoil vehayu kiddushav kiddushin gemurim lo yotzi olamit, sheen gerushin sheenan gemurim mafkiin kiddushin gemurim:
Leacher umeana vo. kelomar chazra venisset lashshelishi umeana bo:
Kol sheyyatzta mimmennu veget asura lachazor lo. af al gav sheyyatzta mishshel acharav bemeun, lo batleh legitta dideh:

Lo fasal et harishona. shehare biatan shava. vei rishona kenuya hi, hare hi ishto uviat haacharona beilat zenut. vei lav kenuya hi, hare shetehen nachriyyot etzlo shello hayu kenuyot leachiv, umekayyem et harishona shello nifsela alav, aval acharona lo, dilma kenuyot havu umishshebba al harishona kayma hiach aleh beissur shene vattim:

Pasal et hachereshet. deshemma ketanna kenuya kullah vekinyan hachereshet meshuyyar, vahava leh shene vattim, dehachi maskinan baggemara diktanna safek im hi kenuya legamre hoil ureuya levia leachar zeman, safek im enah kenuya kelal. vechereshet kenuya umeshuyyeret, kelomar kenuya bemiktzat veenah kenuya kinyan gamur. vaafillu hachi im ba al hachereshet achar shebba al hakketanna lo pasal et hakketanna, mimma nafshach, i ketanna kenuya legamre hare kenaah uviat hachereshet sheachar ken lav kelum hi, vei enah kenuya kelal, af leachiv lo hayta kenuya venachrit hi. aval im ba techilla al hachereshet veachar kach al hakketanna, pasal et hachereshet, deshemma kinyan hakketanna kinyan gamur hu, ufasal kinyan hachereshet shehu kinyan meshuyyar. veit sefarim degarse, im ba al hakketanna vechazar uva al hachereshet pasal et hakketanna, degazrinan atu keshebba al hachereshet vechazar uva al hakketanna:
Kol habbasar asur levashshel bechalav. yesh mehen middivre tora, kegon besar behema. veyesh mehen middivre sofrim, kegon besar of:
Chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim. sheenan lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim:

Veasur lehaalotan im haggevina al hashshulchan. vaafillu besar of deissur achilato middivre sofrim asur lehaaloto im haggevina al hashshulchan. gezera shemma yaale gevina im besar habbehema beilfas roteach shehu asur min hattora, dehaynu mevashshel:
Hannoder min habbasar. bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam, ulechol min basar adam kore basar, chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim:

Uvet hillel omrim lo ole velo neechol. veen lehakeshot bet hillel hayenu tanna kamma deamar leel veasur lehaalotan im haggevina al hashshulchan, deyesh lomar dehachi kaamar, davar ze machaloket bet shammay uvet hillel. veen ze setam veachar kach machaloket, devet shammay bimkom bet hillel enah mishna:

Amar rabbi yose kulei. ha kamashma lan detanna kamma rabbi yose hi. umippene sheshshachach velo hizkir shemo battechilla, hizkir shemo bassof, vahare hu keillu amar hay dehaof ole veeno neechol divre vet shammay, uvet hillel omrim lo ole velo neechol, rabbi yose amarah, sherabbi yose omer zo mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel:
Bashshulchan sheochel alav. deayde demimmeshammeshe beh yada ate leitnoche ze al gav ze:
Haishsha. shalom beno levenah. sheim hayta ketata beno levenah dilma mechamat sina mechavvenah leesor atzmah alav:

Veshalom baolam. sheim haya sheat cherum dilma kesheraata sheshshaha harebe zeman velo chazar amra vadday listim haraguhu. i nammi, raata oto mukke bammilchama vesavra vadday yamut. aval kesheshshalom baolam i lo chaziteh demit vadday chaysha lekilkula, shemma yavo leachar shettinnase utehe mekulkelet:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. velet hilchata kevateh:
Amru lo. lerabbi yehuda, pikkachat tinnase shota lo tinnase, ella achat zo veachat zo tinnase:

Mekanneach yadav bammappa. minnetilat mayim rishonim, umannichah al hashshulchan umekanneach bah yadav tamid mizzohamat hattavshil, velo yannichenna al hakkeset shehu yoshev bah, gezera shemma yihye hakkeset rishon letuma veyihye mashke tofeach bammappa mechamat nigguv hayyadayim, veoto mashke keshennogea bakkeset naasa rishon dilolam hammashkim naasot techilla, vechozer umetamme et hayyadayim keshemmekanneach bah tamid betoch hasseudda. aval bashshulchan lekka lemigzar hachi, sheasur lehishtammesh beshulchan shehu sheni letuma. uvet hillel savre muttar lehishtammesh beshulchan shehu sheni letuma, hilkach lo yanniach hammappa al hashshulchan shemma yittammeu hammashkim shebbammappa mechamat hashshulchan veyachzeruytammeu et haocholim, veim yannichenna al hakkeset en lachush ki im shemma yittammeu yadav, mutav sheyyittammeu yadayim sheen lahem ikkar min hattora, deen netilat yadayim lechullin min hattora, velo yittammeu ocholim sheyyesh lahem ikkar min hattora, derishon ose sheni bechullin min hattora:
Achalo veen bo chazzayit chayyav. mishshum divriyya hu, chayyav bechol shehu, keochel nemala kol shehu shechayyav:
Mizze chazzayit. miyyarech shel yamin kazzayit, vechen miyyarech shel semol:
Eno sofeg ella arbaim. desavar rabbi yehuda eno noheg ella beshel yamin, dedaresh hayyarech, hameyummenet shebbayyarech. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
En tefillat hammusafim ella bechever ir. bachavurat hair, kelomar betzibbur velo beyachid:
Bechever ir veshello vechever ir. ben betzibbur ben beyachid:

Rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo. shel rabbi elazar ben azarya. veikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi yehuda yachid haddar beir sheen sham asara, letanna kamma allibba derabbi elazar deamar lo tikkenuha ella bechever ir yachid ze patur, ulerabbi yehuda en yachid patur ella keshehu bimkom asara, sheshsheliach tzibbur potro. vahalacha kachachamim:
Tippat chalav shennafla. betoch hakkedera al achat min hachatichot shekkullah chutz larotev, velo hegis et hakkedera velo chissa otah, hare lo nechlak taam hattippa ella leotah chaticha bilvad:

Im yesh bah benoten taam beotah chaticha. kelomar im en beotah chaticha levaddah shishshim levattel hattippa, miyyad neeseret hachaticha, veoseret chavroteha vetzarich shishshim keneged kol hachaticha:
Nier et hakkedera. shehegis bah miyyad kodem shekkibbela hachaticha taam min hattippa, dehashta nitarva hattippa bechullan:
Im yesh benoten taam beotah kedera. kelomar en koach battippa leesor kullan ella im ken yesh bah taam litten bechol hakkedera:
Hakkechal. dad habbehema:
Koro umotzi et chalavo. koro sheti vaerev vetacho bakkotel. umuttar achar kach levashshelo im basar bakkedera:

Lo kerao eno over alav. im bishshelo levaddo bakkedera. umuttar laasot ken afillu lechattechilla, ella ayde devae lemitne sefa gabbe lev lo kerao eno over alav aval issura miha ikka, tane nammi resha eno over alav. veim bishshelo im basar belo keria, meshaarim oto veshishshim uchechal atzmo min hamminyan, vehakkechal nishar leolam asur:

Hallev koro umotzi et damo. lo kerao eno over alav. lihyot becharet. uvemassechet keretot [daf 22] moke la belev of, sheen bedamo kazzayit. aval belev behema chayyav karet im achalo velo kerao leachar bishshulo. aval besar hallev eno neesar, shehallev chalak hu veeno volea:
Eno over belo taase. eno yachol lavo lide lo taase. kelomar en lachush shemma yochlennu veyaavor alav, dei nammi achel leh eno over belo taase:

Sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav. kol zeman sheeno raev mechamat otah haachila hu siman shello nitakkel hammazon. vedavka beshachach amre vet hillel deeno chozer, aval bemezid divre hakkol yachazor limkomo vivarech:

Mazkirin gevurot geshamim. mashshiv haruach sheeno leshon bakkasha ella leshon hazekara vashevach. umippene shehaggeshamim achat miggevurotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv (Iyov 5) ose gedolot veen cheker, hannoten matar al pene aretz, mishshum hachi kare lehu gevurot geshamim:
Veshoalin. veten tal umatar leshon bakkasha:
Bevirkat hashshanim. mittoch shehen parnasa kavu sheelatan bevirkat parnasa:
Vehavedala. bemotzae shabbat:
Bechonen haddaat. shehi beracha rishona shel chol. uvayrushalmi amru mippene ma tikkenu havedala bechonen haddaat, sheim en dea havedala minnayin. vechen halacha:

Yom echad haamur beoto veet beno kulei. lefi shepparashat oto veet beno semucha lekadashim, dichtiv yeratze lekarban ishshe, vesamich leh oto veet beno. uvekadashim layla holech achar hayyom, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) beyom karbano yeachel lo yanniach mimmennu ad boker, alma layla shelleacharav karuy yom karbano ad habboker. yachol af ze ken [neemar kan yom echad] veneemar bemaase vereshit yom echad vechulei:

Lo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel ovde kochavim. ner mishshum delo shavat, shehaoved kochavim asa melacha leoro, vekayma lan or shello shavat en mevarchin alav hoil veneevda vo avera. uvesamim shel ovde kochavim, bivsamim shehem bimsibba sheovde kochavim mesubbim bah lisudda mayre. veha ditnan besefa velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel avodat kochavim, ma taam kaamar, ma taam en mevarchin al besamim shel ovde kochavim, lefi shessetam mesibbat ovde kochavim laavodat kochavim veen mevarchin al besamim shel avodat kochavim:
Velo al hanner shel metim. delo itaved leora ella lechavod bealma:
Velo al besamim shel metim. delaavure recha avide:
Velo al ner uvesamim. daavodat kochavim, lefi sheasurin bahanaa:
Ad sheyyeotu leoro. sheyyehanu meoro, velo sheyyehanu mammash ella shekkarov lo kol kach sheyyuchal lehanot im yirtze:
Etza hahogenet lo. im hu yeled vehi zekena, hu zaken vehi yalda, omrim lo ma lecha etzel yalda ma lecha etzel zekena kallech etzel shekkemotcha:

Kora meen yevami. vekore, lo chafatzti lekachtah. choletzet verokeket vekora, kacha yease laish. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda deamar mitzva al kol haomdim sham lomar chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal:
Rabbi eliezer omer bechullan melammedin. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Uvilvad shello yihyu nogim ze vaze. dei nage, af al gav detzonen betzonen hu, bae hadacha:
Shene achsenain ochlim al shulchan echad. davka sheen makkirin ze et ze. aval makkirin ze et ze, asur, shemma yittol echad mehen mishshel chavero veyochal. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Shelosha sheachlu. lezammen. lehizdammen yachad levarech bilshon rabbim nevarech sheachalnu mishshello:

Demay. perot amme haaretz keruyim demay, kelomar da may meussarin hen o lo, lefi shehem chashudim al hammaasrot veasru chachamim leechol mipperotehen ad sheyyeasser. veim achal velo isser mevarech alav velo have mitzva habbaa baavera, derov amme haaretz measserim hem:

Shennittela terumato. veaf al pi shello nittela mimmennu teruma gedola, kegon ben levi shehikdim et hakkohen velakach hammaaser bashshibbolim kodem shennatal hakkohen teruma gedola, vehakkohen haya lo littol teruma gedola techilla echad mechamishshim, derachamana karyeh reshit, nimtza teruma gedola shel kohen betoch hammaaser hazze echad mechamishshim shebbo, levad mitterumat maaser sheal hallevi lehaferish teruma mimmaasro. veashmeinan matnitin dehacha defatur hallevi millehafrish mimmennu teruma gedola dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) vaharemmotem mimmennu terumat Adonai‏ maaser min hammaaser, maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha velo teruma gedola uterumat maaser min hammaaser:
Umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu. kegon shennatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh, shehabbealim mosifim chomesh. vekamashma lan tana deen chomesh meakkev:

Vehashshammash sheachal kazzayit. demahu detema kevan shehashshammash en lo keviut ella holech uva en mezammenin alav, ka mashma lan. uvechol hanne ashmeinan deaf al gav dedamu leissur en kan beracha baavera:

Vehakkuti. min haovde kochavim shehevi melech ashshur mikkuta umishshear aratzot vayyoshev otam beare shomron, venitgayyeru meemat haarayot shehayu ochlim bahem kammeforash besefer melachim (2 17), vehayu shomrim tora shebbichtav, vechol mitzva shehecheziku vah medakdekim bah yoter miyyisrael, lefichach hayu maaminim bahem biktzat hammitzvot, ad shebbadku acharehem umatzu lahem demut yona berosh har gerizim shehayu ovdim otah, umeaz asaum keovde kochavim gemurim lechol divrehem, hilkach haidna en mezammenin al hakkuti:

Achal tevel. dagan shello nittela mimmennu teruma umaasrot karuy tevel. uferush tevel tav lo, veen tzarich lomar tevel deorayta, ella afillu tevel derabbanan kegon dagan shetztzamach beatzitz [sheeno nakuv] sheeno tevel ella midderabbanan, en mezammenin alav:

Umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato. lav terumat maaser kaamar dehay tevel gamur hu, ella kegon shehikdim levi et hakkohen bakkeri leachar shennitmarach vehukba litruma min hattora venatal maaser rishon techilla, veechad mechamishshim shebbo hi reuya litruma gedola lakkohen, vechol zeman shello natan mimmennu teruma gedola zo af al pi shehifrish terumat maaser en mezammenin alav, veim haya makdimo bashshibbolim kodem shettitmarach lo haya tzarich lehaferish teruma gedola kidchatvinan leel:

Umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. en tzarich lomar shello nifdu kelal deha milleta difshita hi, ella shennifdu velo nifdu kehilchatan, kegon sheppada maaser sheni bigrutaot shel kesef o vematbea sheen alav tzura, verachamana amar (Devarim 14) vetzarta hakkesef bedavar sheyyesh bo tzura. vehekdesh shechillelo al gabbe karka velo fedao bechesef, verachamana amar venatan et hakkesef:
Vehashshammash sheachal pachot mikkezayit. mishna sheenah tzericha hi, ella aydi dahadar lerubba letzorech hadar nammi leha:
Veoved kochavim. beger shemmal velo taval mayre. veashmeinan dechol kamma delo taval oved kochavim hu, uleolam eno ger ad sheyyimmol veyitbol:
Shehissiah aviha. bekatnutah, vekibbel kiddusheha, vehayu kiddushin gemurim af al pi shehi chereshet, sheal daat aviha nitkaddesha velo al datah:
Yotza veget. afillu leachar sheggadla ufaka koach av mekabbelet hi et gittah:
Af zo. pikkachat shennitcharsha, kayyotze vah:

Muttar levashshel umuttar bahanaa. deen bo mishshum basar bechalav. ditlata gedi ketive gabbe issur basar bechalav, vechad minnayhu lehotzi et hattemea, sheim bishshel besar behema temea afillu bachalev behema tehora, muttar. uvaachila miha asur, mishshum basar tame. vechen nammi telata bachalev immo ketive, vechad minnayhu lemiute chalev temea, vaafillu habbasar tahor:

Perat lechayya uleof velivhema temea. gedi perat leof sheeno vehema. gedi perat lachayya, deaf al gav dechayya bichlal behema, ata kera yetera veappekeh. gedi velo vehema temea, venafka lan middichtiv (Bereshit 27) veet orot gedaye haizzim, vayyishlach yehuda et gedi haizzim (sham 38), kan peresh lecha hakkatuv digdi ze meizzim hu, ha im lo feresh, yesh bemashma af shear behema, middeitzterich beh leferushe:

Neemar lo tochlu chol nevela. veneemar beoto pasuk atzmo lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo, demashma kol shennoheg bo issur nevela yesh bo mishshum basar bechalav. veikka ben rabbi yose haggelili uven rabbi akiva, derabbi yose haggelili savar chayya deorayta, dechol shehu asur mishshum nevela yesh bo mishshum basar bechalav, chutz min haof sheen lo chalev em. verabbi akiva savar, chayya lav deorayta. i nammi, of midderabbanan ikka benayhu, rabbi akiva defaresh eno min hattora, mashma ha midderabbanan yesh bo issur. aval rabbi yose haggelili delo faresh hay lishana, share leh legamre. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Veim lav ellu mezammenin leatzman. uvizman sheshshammash echad meshammesh lishte hachavurot, af al pi sheen roim ellu et ellu, hashshammash metzarfan:
En mevarchin al hayyayin. bore peri haggafen:

Ad sheyyitten letocho mayim. lefi shehaya yenam chazak meod velo haya rauy lishtiyya belo mayim, hilkach akkatti lo ishtene lemaalyuta velo zaz mibbirchato harishona, umevarchin alav bore peri haetz kaanavim. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Oto veet beno. haem vehabben, o haem vehabbat. aval haav im habben o im habbat eno asur, deoto veet beno mashma mi shebbeno karuch acharav, yatza zachar sheen beno karuch acharav:

Ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. ayde devae lemitne ben bechullin ben bemukdashim, tana nammi baaretz uvechutza laaretz, af al gav delo itzterich, dechovat hagguf hi vechovat hagguf noheg ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz:
Bifne habbayit. bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam:
Veshello vifne habbayit. desalka datach amena hoil uveinyana dekadashim ketiv, bifne habbayit ninhog shello vifne habbayit lo ninhog, kamashma lan:

Bechullin uvemukdashim. ben sheshshenehem chullin o shenehem mukdashim, ben sheechad mehen chullin vehashsheni mukdashim. umenalan denoheg bemukdashim, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) shor o cheves o ez ki yivvaled vegomer‏ yeratze lekarban ishshe, uchetiv batreh veshor o se oto veet beno vegomer‏:
Bachutz. chutz laazara:
Shenehem kesherim. mishshum devae lemitne sefa shenehem pesulim tana resha shenehem kesherim:
Vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. mishshum lav deoto veet beno. velo shena shachat et haem techilla, velo shena shachat et habben techilla. lo shena shechatinhu chad gavra, velo shena tere gavre:

Harishon chayyav karet. mishshum shechute chutz. aval hashsheni patur min hakkaret dechevan denishchata immo shuv eno rauy habben lishshachet hayyom bifnim, defasul mishshum mechussar zeman, sheeno rauy leshachato ulehakrivo hayyom, veen chayyav mishshum shochet bachutz ella im ken rauy lifnim, dichtiv (Vayikra 17) veel petach ohel moed lo hevio, harauy lefetach ohel moed chayyavin alav bachutz, vei lo lo:
Ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim. harishon mishshum shochet bachutz, dechol chayyave cheretot lokin. vehashsheni mishshum lav deoto veet beno:
Chullin bifnim shenehem pesulin. mishshum chullin shennishchatu vaazara:

Vehashsheni sofeg. mishshum oto veet beno. aval mishshum chullin baazara, azharat ase hi (Devarim 12) ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom vezavachta, berichuk makom atta zoveach vei atta zoveach bekeruv makom:
Kadashim bifnim kulei‏ hashsheni sofeg. mishshum oto veet beno:
Ufasul. mishshum mechussar zeman:
Lo yaane achar hakkohanim amen. besof kol beracha kemo sheshshear hatztzibbur onim:

Mippene hatteruf. shello titrof dato veyite, lefi sheshsheliach tzibbur hu tzarich lehatechil beracha sheniyya ulehakrot lahen milla bemilla, veim yaane amen lo yuchal lechavven velachazor litfillato maher ulehatchil habberacha karauy sheyyatchil:
Lo yissa et kappav. shemma lo yuchal lechavven velachazor litfillato lehatechil sim shalom, shettehe dato metorefet meemata detzibbura:
Veim havetachato. kelomar im batuach hu shello tehe dato metorefet meemat hatztzibbur:
En omdin. mittoch koved rosh. hachenaa umora, dichtiv (tehillim 2) ivdu et Adonai‏ beyira, vaavoda zo tefilla hi:
Shohim shaa achat. bammakom shebbau lehitpallel:
Afillu hammelech shoel bishlomo. vedavka melech yisrael, aval melech oved kochavim posek shello yahargennu:
Afillu nachash karuch al akevo. davka nachash sherov peamim eno noshech, aval akrav o efe min haddevarim shevvadday noshchim umemitim, posek:

Sholeach adam yarech lenachri vechulei. veen choshshim shemma yirenna yisrael kesheshsholchah lo veyachazor veyikne otah min hannachri veyochlenna vegidah. kevan dishlema hi, mekomo shel gid hannashe haya nikkar im nechtat hemenna, vehallokeach mevin shello nittal venotlo:
Sheyyittol et kullo. yechattet acharav:
Lekayyem bo mitzvat netila. gommo millemala vedayyo:

Kevasar belafet. roin keillu hayyarech lefatot vehaggid basar, veillu haya noten taam basar keshiur haggid, bilfatot [keshiur] hayyarech, asur. deshiurim halacha lemoshe missinay, ugemire divhachi meshaarim, af al pi sheillu haya keruv o kaflot haya tzarich pachot o yoter. veha matnitin iddachya la veena halacha. dekayma lan en baggidin benoten taam, deven nitbashshel uven nimlach uven nitzla, mashlicho umuttar. vedavka bo, aval shummano yesh bo benoten taam, veim lo nittal shummano oser. venoten taam haamur bemin bemino sheen adam yachol lehavechino, meshaarin oto beshishshim:

Veeno noheg bitmea. sheim achal gid hannashe shel temea, leman deamar yesh baggidim benoten taam, loke mishshum temea velo mishshum gid. uleman deamar en baggidim benoten taam, patur mikkelum, devithora etz hu vehattora chiyyeva alav, aval bitmea eno noheg:
Mibbene yaakov neesar. vaadayin temea mutteret lahen ad mattan tora:
Amru lo. pasuk ze shehizhir alav besinay neemar, vead sinay lo huzharu:

Ella shennichtav bimkomo. leachar shenneemar besinay, keshebba lesadder moshe et hattora katav hammikra hazze al hammaase, al ken huzharu vene yisrael achare ken shello yochlu gid hannashe [leda meeze taam neesar lahem]. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

En maase ketanna ella chimfutta. dichmi shello nisset dame. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer, vahalacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos. ufechuta mibbat shesh bechezkat sheenah yodaat lishmor kiddusheha veenah tzericha lemaen. veyoter mibbat eser bechezkat sheyyodaat lishmor kiddusheha, veaf al pi shehi sechala beyoter. umibbat shesh vead bat eser tzericha bedika im yodaat lishmor kiddusheha im lav. umemaenet habbat veholechet ad shettehe bat shetem esre shana veyom echad vetavi simanim. leachar mikkan enah memaenet, afillu lo ba aleha. veim ba aleha leachar shetem esre shana veyom echad, af al pi shello hevia simanim, chayshinan shemma nashru hassimanim ukenaah:

Bet shammay omrim notlin layyadayim veachar kach mozgin et hakkos. sheim atta omer mozgin et hakkos techilla, gezera shemma yittamu mashkim shennaflu baachore hakkos mechamat hayyadayim, shehayyadayim kodem netila torat sheni letuma yesh lahen umetammeim et hammashkim lihyot techilla, veyachzeru hammashkim vitammeu et achore hakkos, shehammashkim shennitmeu metammeim kelim midderabbanan, ella shehekellu betuma zo shekkeli shennitmeu achorav bemashkim temeim lo nitma tocho velo yadav velo agno, vesavre vet shammay asur lehishtammesh bechos sheachorav temeot af al pi shello nitma tocho, gezera shemma yinnatzu nitztzotzot mittocho al achore hakkos vikabbelu hammashkin tuma mechamat achorav vitammeu et hayyadayim. vechevan deasur lehishtammesh bichli sheachorav temeot notlin layyadayim techilla veachar kach mozgin et hakkos, kede shello yekabbelu hammashkim sheachore hakkeli tuma mechamat yadayim venimtzeu achore hakkeli temeim mechamat otan mashkim umishtammesh bo beissur. uvet hillel savre en issur lehishtammesh bichli sheachorav temeot, hilkach mozgim et hakkos techilla veshotim oto veachar kach notlin layyadayim, sheim atta omer notlin layyadayim techilla veachar kach mozgim et hakkos gezera shemma yihyu achore hakkos temeim, shemmuttar lehishtammesh bichli sheachorav temeim, velo yihyu yadav neguvot yafe vitammeu achore hakkeli hammashkin shebbeyadav, veotan mashkin shennaasu techilla yachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim, venimtza ochel beyadayim mesoavot:
Hayu yoshvim. belo haseva, vesiman hu shello nitvaadu leechol yachad. shergilim hayu keshemmitvaadim chavurot anashim leechol shehayu mesubbim al hammittot veochlim veshotim bahasevat semol:

Kol echad mevarech leatzmo. shello haya lahem keva seudda belo haseva. umihu im amru nezil nechol nahama beducheta pelan, af al pi shello hesebbu kehesebbu dami, veechad mevarech lechullam, umitztarfin nammi lezimmun:

Ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon kol echad mevarech leatzmo. hoil veen bet habbelia panuy veen lev hammesubbim pone el hamevarech ella livloa ma shebbefihem. i nammi chayshinan shemma yechanek keshebba laanot amen:
Vehu omer al hammugmar. hamevarech birkat hammazon hu mevarech al hammugmar bore atze vesamim. veaf al gav deikka deadif minneh afillu hachi kevan deatchil bachada aved leidach:
Leachar hasseudda. leachar birkat hammazon, dehashta lav mitztzarche hasseudda hu, afillu hachi kevan shehitchil bivrachot acharonot gomran:
Mugmar. regilin hayu lehavi achar hasseudda atze vesamim bemachta al haesh lereach tov:
Novlot. perot shennaflu min hailan kodem shennitbashshelu kol tzarkan:
Govay. chagavim tehorim:
Min kelala. novlot vegovay al yede kelala hen baim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha. kemo shehiggiu rachamecha al tzippor vegazarta lo tikkach haem al habbanim ken chus verachem alenu:
Veal tov yizzacher shemecha. mashma al tovatcha node lecha veal hara lo node, vahare anu chayyavin levarech al haraa keshem shemmevarchin al hattova:
Modim modim. demechaze kimkabbel alav shete elohot. umefaresh bayrushalmi hada detema betzibbur, aval beyachid tachanunim hem:
Meshattekin oto. sheose middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu rachamim vehen enan ella gezerot melech al avadav:
Velo yehe sarvan beotah shaa. kederech shear yordim lifne hatteva shetztzarich lesarev paam rishona, aval ze lo yesarev kesheomrim lo lech red lefi sheggenay hu shettehe hattefilla mufseket kol kach:
Lishte yetomot. nachriyyot:
O chalitzatah. leachar shettagdil:
Vechen shete chershot. kelomar keshem sheshshete ketannot biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah, kach bishte chershot. aval chalitza lekka lememar bechereshet, delav bat chalitza hi:
Achat ketanna veachat chereshet. af al gav dishtehen en nissuehen nissuin gemurin, mikkol makom lo yadinan behe minnayhu nicha leh vehi chashiva ishto tefe:
Biat haggedola poteret et hakketanna. deviat mi shennissueha nissuin gemurin poteret otah sheen nissueha gemurin. aval ippecha lo:
Uvechol haddak. kol sheen hayyotzer tzarich lechatsho:
Charsit. shechikat charasin:
Umegufa. kissuy shel cheres sheal pi hechavit:

Davar sheen megaddel bo tzemachim en mechassim bo. vesid vecharsit ulevena umegufa shekketashan ditnan leel shemmechassin bahen, af al gav deen megaddelim tzemachin, hoil umeikkara kodem shennaaset bahen melacha hayu megaddelim tzemachim, mechassin bahen. vehay kelala derabban shimon ben gamliel lav davka, deha nesoret shel charashim dakka uneoret shel pishtan amrinan babberayta dimchassin bahen, af al gav deenan megaddelin tzemachin. veefer mechassim bo mishshum deikkere afar dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) meafar serefat hachattat. vechen mechassim bishchikat hazzahav dichtiv (Iyov 28) veafrot zahav lo:

Uketannim en mezammenin alehem. davka ketannim sheen yodim lemi mevarchin, aval katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin mezammenin alav. veikka meravvata deamre delo amru katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin mezammenin alav ella beven shelosh esre shana veyom echad shello hevi shete searot, vehu hannikra katan porech, aval bevatzir mehachi en mezammenin alav, vaafillu yodea lemi mevarchin. uvayrushalmi mayte halacha lemaase deen mezammenin al hakkatan kelal ad sheyyigdal veyavi shete searot. venashim mezammenot leatzman vaavadim mezammenin leatzman, aval nashim im avadim lo mishshum peritzuta:
Ad kazzayit. vechen halacha, velo cherabbi yehuda deamar ad kabbetza:
Bet shammay omrim en memaanin ella arusot. yetoma shehissiuha immah veacheha, enah memaenet ella min haerusin:
Babbaal. aval im met velo meana bo venafla lifne yavam, enah yotza bemeun, ella tamtin ad shettagdil vetachlotz:
En benot yisrael hefker. vaafillu min haerusin lo temaen veteares leacher vetachzor utemaen. ella memaenet beze vetamtin milleares leacher ad shettagdil:

Temaen vetinnase. lav lemahdar ulemaen zimna achariti, ella hachi kaamar, memaenet umamtenet milleares leacher ad shettagdil, o im rotza lehinnase memaenet bevaalah vetinnase miyyad, detu lo memaenet levet shammay, dinsua hi:
Kissuy haddam kulei. mishshum devae lemitne bechullin aval lo vemukdashin, nakat lechullehu:
Bemukdashin. chattat haof veolat haof. vechen kadshe vedek habbayit im avar ushechatan en teunim kissuy:

Venoheg bechayya uveof. lemiute behema. delo tema behema bichlal chayya. venafka lan middichtiv bivchor baal mum (Devarim 15) al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim, ma mayim enan teunin kissuy af dam behema eno taun kissuy:
Bimzumman. of haggadel babbayit:
Venoheg bechoy. beriyya bifne atzmah hi velo hichriu vah chachamim im chayya hi uteuna kissuy im behema veenah teuna kissuy:
Veen shochatim oto veyom tov. mishshum dilma bae kissuy, umissefeka lo mechallinan yom tov:
Veim shechato veyom tov en mechassin et damo. vaafillu haya lo afar muchan o efer. shemma yomar haroe, chayya vadday hu ulefichach kissa damo beyom tov, veyavo lehattir chelbo:

Kol akkava shehi min haish. natan lah get, zo hi akkava shehi min haish, dechevan delo meana gilleta datah shekkol ma shehayta mitakkevet etzlo haya bishvilo. meana bo, zo hi akkava sheenah min haish, shello nitakkeva etzlo mishshum ishut. umatnitin mefaresh lah veazel:

Ner umazon. mi sheachal beshabbat bemincha vechashcha lo vaadayin lo gamar seuddato veen lo yayin ella shiur [kos] echad. bet shammay omrim ner umazon besamim vehavedala. dechulle alma havedala bassof, daafuke yoma meacharinan leh ki hechi delo leheve aleh kemasseoy. lo nechleku ella al hanner veal habbesamim, devet shammay omrim ner umazon veachar kach besamim, uvet hillel omrim ner uvesamim ki hadade, divrachot sheanu yecholim laasotam delo mechaze kemasseoy kegon ner uvesamim mekadminan lehu levirkat hammazon:
Bet shammay omrim shebbara meor haesh. shebbara demashma lesheavar velo bore demashma lehabba.
Meor haesh velo meore haesh, dachada nehora ikka benura:
Uvet hillel omrim bore. nammi mashma lesheavar:
Meore haesh. sheharebe gevanim yesh beshalhevet, aduma levana virakroket:
Vaacherim roin otam. devichhay gavna shechitatan keshera:
Chayyavim lechassot. otan acherim sheroim chayyavim lechassot. keditnan lekamman, shachat velo chissa veraahu acher chayyav lechassot:

Patur millechassot. rabbi meir kaamar la, desavar shechitat cheresh shote vekatan benan leven atzman nevela gemura hi hoil verov maasehen mekulkalim. verabbanan pelige aleh derabbi meir ben aresha ben assefa, ella denatre leh ad deassik lemilleteh vahadar pelige aleh, vesavre rabbanan disfek nevela hi, lo nevela vaddait, hilkach leinyan kissuy chayyavim lechassot, veen shochatim acharehen oto veet beno deshemma shechita maalyata hi. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
Im shegura tefillati. sedura befi bimrutza veeni nichshal bah:

Shehu metoraf. shehachole metoraf, kemo ach tarof toraf (Bereshit 44). perush acher leshon torfim lo tefillato befanav (baggemara daf 5), kelomar hattefilla shehitpallelu alav metorefet uteruda mimmennu veenah mekubbelet:
Parat chattat. para adumma. delav laachila hi:
Veshor hanniskal. leachar shennigmar dino. dekayma lan deasur bahanaa afillu shechato:

Veegla arufa. disvira leh deneeseret mechayyim, vaafillu shechatah asura. uvaggemara massik defarat chattat veegla arufa enah mishna, dishnehen haveya shechitatan shechita reuya, vetzarich lahasiran min hammishna, delo fatar behu rabbi shimon:

Vachachamim mechayyevin. hay dimchayyeve chachamim beshochet laavoda zara, lo shanu ella sheshshachat rishon laavoda zara uva sheni veshachat leshulchano leechol, aval rishon leshulchano vesheni laavoda zara, divhach shechita batrayta demichayyav alah mishshum oto veet beno ate nammi din ketala alohi, patur mimmalkot, dekam leh bidrabba minneh, detarte lo avdinan beh. ufeamim sheafillu shachat rishon leshulchano vesheni laavoda zara chayyav, kegon deatteru veh mishshum oto veet beno velo atteru veh mishshum avoda zara, dechevan delo atteru veh mishshum avoda zara lo miktal, veloke mishshum oto veet beno. vahalacha kachachamim:
Venitnabbela veyado. shello middaat:
Vehannocher. shettochev hassakkin binchirav vechotech:
Vehameakker. sheoker hassimanim mimmekom chibburan veeno shochatan:
Patur. vaafillu lerabbanan. velo damya lashshechita dilel, dehatam shechita mealleya ikka vedavar acher gorem lah lippasel, aval hacha lekka shechita kelal:

Eze shellakach rishon yishchot rishon. im bau levet din, shebba haechad lishchot vachavero meakkev alav veomer ani tzarich yoter mimmecha, anu omrim lahem hallokeach rishon yishchat, sheal menat ken lakach, sheillu lo mecharah baal habbayit lashsheni veikkevah leatzmo haya hallokeach shochet. shekkach shaninu battosefta, hallokeach mibbaal habbayit hu kodem levaal habbayit, sheal menat ken lakach:
Veim kadam hashsheni zacha. shehikdim beatzmo kede shello yavo lide issur, veyesh lo revach sheochel hayyom basar:
Sofeg shemonim. deal kol ben sheshshochet over belav:
Sofeg et haarbaim. deen kan shechitat issur ella achat:
Shechatah veet bittah veachar kach et bat bittah. yesh kan shene oto veet beno:

Shechatah veet bat bittah. en kan adayin issur. veachar kach shachat et bittah. veyesh bishchita zo shene issurim, oto veet beno mishshum immah, uveno veoto mishshum bittah shel zo shekkevar nishchata:
Sofeg arbaim. dechad lav hu vachada hateraa vechad maase:

Sumechos omer sofeg shemonim. disvira leh lesumechos demichayyav behateraa achat uvelav echad shete malkuyyot. vehu haddin leresha dekatane shachat shene vaneha veachar kach shechatah sofeg arbaim, lesumechos sofeg shemonim. vechach hi battosefta, shachat chamishsha vaneha veachar kach shechatah, sumechos omer mishshum rabbi meir chayyav mishshum chamishsha lavin:

Bearbaa ferakim bashshana. derech yisrael laasot seuddot bearbaa ferakim hallalu, usetam hallokeach behema eno lokeach ella lishchot miyyad, lefichach hammocher behema lachavero umachar techilla immah o vittah bo bayyom, tzarich sheyyomar lashsheni da lecha shehayyom macharti immah lishchot o vittah macharti lishchot, shemma kevar nishchata:

Beyom tov haacharon shel chag. hayu marbim besimcha mippene sheregel bifne atzmo hu vechaviv alehen. vehay dela chashiv erev yom tov rishon shel chag, mishshum dechulle alma teride besukka velulav veen lahem penay leharebot bishchita:
Af erev yom hakkippurim baggalil. velo vihuda uvishar aratzot, shello hayu ochlim erev yom hakkippurim ella besar of vedagim kidmuchach bivreshit rabba gabbe hahu chayyata dizvan nuna:
Bizman sheen lo revach. hefsek bentayim, shemmachar haem hayyom:
Aval yesh lo revach. shemmachar et harishona etmol vehashsheniyya hayyom:

En tzarich lehodio. sheani omer etmol shechatah harishon. perush acher, bizman sheen lo revach shehu nechpaz umahir liknot shemmare sherotze lishchot hayyom. aval yesh lo revach sheeno nechpaz bikniyyato, eno chayyav lehodio, deshemma letzorech yom acher hu kone. verabbi yehuda leferushe milleteh detanna kamma ate velo leifloge aleh:
Umode rabbi yehuda. af al pi shellakach ze hayyom veze lemachar. velapperush hashsheni, af al pi sheeno nechpaz umahir liknot:
Et haem lechatan veet habbat lakkalla. orcha demilleta nakat, deorach ara laasot seudda tefe bevet hechatan mibbevet hakkalla, hilkach haem lechatan shehi gedola, vehabbat shehi ketanna lakkalla:

Bevaa min hakkatzir. kemaase shehaya shehalchu bene adam liktzor chittin uneshacho nachash leechad mehem umet, uvaa vehodia bevet din veshalchu umatzu kidvareha. velo hittiru chachamim ella dugmato, sheyyehe haddavar karov, aval mimmedinat hayyam enah neemenet:
Ella vahove. maase shehaya kach haya, vehu haddin lishar mekomot:

Patar et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon. hanne mile beshabbatot veyamim tovim shergilim likboa al hayyayin leachar hammazon, ucheshebberach al hayyayin lifne hammazon addata dehachi berach, aval bishar yamim sheen regilim likboa atzman al hayyayin shelleachar hammazon en hayyayin shellifne hammazon poter hayyayin shelleachar hammazon. vechol leachar hammazon ditnan bematnitin hayenu leachar shessilleku yedehem min happat kodem sheyyevarchu birkat hammazon:

Parperet. kol davar shemmelappetim bo et happat kegon basar uvetzim vedagim keruyim parperet. ufeamim shehayu meviim parperaot kodem seudda lehameshich haachila, vechozrim umeviim parperaot acherot leachar hasseudda achar shemmashchu yedehem min happat:

Maase kedera. kegon harifot vegeres karmel vekemach shennitbashshel bemayim kegon hallevivot vechayyotze bahen. veit dimfarshe parperet dematnitin pat hatztzenuma bikara sheen bah mare lechem dimvarchim ala bore mine mezonot. vehasheta nicha deitzterich leashmeinan berach al happarperet lo fatar et happat af al gav dehi nammi min pat, aval maase kedera patar. uvet shammay savre keshem sheim berach al happarperet lo fatar et happat kach lo fatar maase kedera. veen halacha kevet shammay:

Mevarech acharehen shalosh berachot. dechol shehu mishshivat hamminim mevarech acharav shalosh berachot, disvira leh lerabban gamliel divachalta vesavata uverachta lav allechem bilvad kae ella akkol shivat hamminin hammuzkarim leel bapparasha. uvehay kera shalosh berachot remize, uverachta zo birkat hazzan, al haaretz zo birkat haaretz, hattova zo bone yerushalayim, vechen hu omer (Devarim 3) hahar hattov hazze:

Vachachamim omrim beracha achat. meen shalosh berachot, im anavim teenim rimmonim zetim utemarim achal, mevarech al haetz veal peri haetz veal eretz chemda tova vechulei, vechotem al haaretz veal happerot. uveeretz yisrael chotem al haaretz veal peroteha. uveracha zo atzmah mevarech al hayyayin ella sheppoteach bah al haggefen veal peri haggefen. veal kol davar hannaase mechameshet mine dagan, bimkom al haetz veal peri haetz, omer al hammichya veal hakkalkala vechotem al haaretz veal hammichya:

Afillu achal shelek. shel yarak, vehu mezono, shessomech alav lemazon, mevarech shalosh berachot, divachalta vesavata akkol may deachal kae. vahalacha kachachamim sheen mevarchin shalosh berachot ella allechem, veal shivat hamminin beracha achat meen shalosh, veal kol shear devarim bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan. perush chesronan kemo lechem umayim shei efshar lehitkayyem belo hem, al kol ma shebbara lehachayot bahem nefesh kol chay, kelomar al kol ma shebbaolam sheggam im lo nivreu yecholin habberiyyot lehitkayyem, velo nivreu ki im letaanug uletosefet tova. umippene sheyyesh bivracha zo shene inyanim haveya beracha arukka ufotachat bevaruch vechotemet bevaruch, kidita bayrushalmi shechotmim bah baruch atta Adonai‏ che haolamim:
Hashshote mayim litzmao. davka, mevarech shehakkol. aval hashshote mayim livloa maachol shennitchav lo bigrono vechayyotze vaze eno mevarech:
Rabbi tarfon omer bore nefashot rabbot. mevarech lifne shetiyyat hammayim. veen halacha kerabbi tarfon, ella lifnehem mevarech shehakkol uleacharehem bore nefashot rabbot:
Motzi et ishto veget. dezikkat achotah habba mikkoach kiddushin gemurim osartah alav, veen koach bekiddushin dideh lidchot hayevama mishshum achot ishto:
Veeshet achiv asura leolam. decheresh lo chalitz. velichnos i efshar mishshum achot ishsha:
Chaltza vishnayim. kesherim:
O vishlosha. vehaya echad mehem karov o pasul, delo nishtayyeru ki im shenayim kesherim:
Chalitzatah pesula. vechen halacha sheen chalitza keshera befachot mishshelosha:
Kones veeno motzi leolam. delo ate get dideh umafka zikkat yibbume achiv harishon:
Chullin vekadashim bachutz. davka nakat harishon chullin vehashsheni kadashim. vechen kol hashshenuyin bammishna davka nakat lehu:
Vehashsheni sofeg. mishshum oto veet beno:
Kadashim. battechilla, veachar kach chullin bachutz:
Hashsheni chasher. baachila. veayde detana pasul, tana kasher:
Ushenehem sofgim. rishon mishshum shochet chutz, vesheni mishshum oto veet beno:
Chullin vekadashim bifnim shenehem pesulim. rishon mishshum chullin shennishchatu vaazara, vesheni mishshum mechussar zeman:
Vehashsheni sofeg. mishshum oto veet beno:
Chullin bachutz uvifnim. harishon bachutz vehashsheni bifnim:
Kadashim bachutz uvifnim harishon becharet. mishshum shochet bachutz:
Ushenehem pesulim. rishon mishshum shennishchat bachutz, vesheni mishshum mechussar zeman:
Ushenehem sofgim. rishon mishshum shochet chutz, vesheni mishshum oto veet beno:
Kadashim bifnim uvachutz. hashsheni sofeg mishshum oto veet beno. umishshum shochet chutz lo lake, dimchussar zeman hu veeno mitkabbel bifnim:
Habbasar tahor. besar haubbar tahor, sheen behema mekabbelet tuma mechayyim:
Habbasar magga nevela. besar haubbar magga evar min hachay, shehu metamme kinvela:
Magga terefa shechuta. shehashshechita af al pi sheenah matteret haevar baachila, metaharattu mide nevela. vehaveya kitrefa shechuta sheenah metammea min hattora ella midderabbanan bemukdashin:
Hachi garsinan, af shechitat behema tetaher et haevar. velo garsinan et haubbar:
Lo im tihara shechitat terefa otah. min haddin hu shehare davar sheggufah:

Uminnayin latterefa sheshshechitatah metahartah. deshemma enah metahartah umin haddin enah metahartah, shebbehema temea asura vaachila uterefa asura vaachila: uma temea en shechitatah metahartah. milletamme, dehachi tanya betorat kohanim, lechol habbehema asher hi mafreset parsa vegomer, kol hannogea bahem yitma, lehavi behema temea shello tetaharenna shechitatah:
Tomar bitrefa shehayta lah sheat hakkosher. dechevan dechal alah torat shechita, tu lo faka minna vehaveya bichlal shear tzon uvakar:
Tol lecha ma sheheveta. tol mikkan reaya zo sheheveta:
Hare shennolda terefa min habbeten minnayin. shettetaharenna:

Sheyyesh beminah shechita. hilkach lo nafka mikkelal tzon uvakar. aval ben shemona chay shennolad mibbehema chayya en lanu bema letaher afillu nishchat, lefi sheeno vichlal bakar vatzon. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ben shemona chay. im nolad ushechato:
En shechitato metaharto. mide nevela, sheen shechita moelet beven shemona, ella keshehu bime immo nittar bishchitat immo:
Mutteret layyavam. velo amrinan nissuin harishonim mappilin hayevama lifne hayyavam umishshaa sheggershah achiv kayma aleh beissur eshet ach dehavya la gerushat achiv:
Rabbi eliezer oser. degazar kol hane atu yetoma bechayye haav deamrinan lekamman bematnitin dilachar chazaratah hare hi kigrusha afillu lerabbanan. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Kitoma vechayye haav. af al pi shehaav chay hare hi kitoma leinyan kiddushin, deshuv en laav koach lekabbel kiddusheha. veim hechzirah bekatnutah, asura layyavam im met bekatnutah, dekiddushe chazara enan kelum hoil ufaka reshut av minnah vehi en lah yad, vehaveya kigrusha veomedet:

Ellu devarim. mevarech al hayyom. bitchilla kiddush hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin bore peri haggafen, shettechilla kadash hayyom veachar kach ba hayyayin al hashshulchan bishvil hayyom, ucheshem shekkadam lichnisa kach kodem livracha:
Mevarech al hayyayin. techilla, vehu haddin limkaddesh al happat, shehayyayin o happat gormim lekiddush hayyom, sheim en lo yayin o fat lo yekaddesh:
Yigdelu ze im ze. veeno yachol legarshah ad sheyyagdil, deget katan eno get:

Hayevama sheamra betoch sheloshim yom. shekkenasa hayyavam, lo nivalti layyavam, vehu omer bealtich vedayyech beget, kofin oto lachalotz, dehi neemenet, dead telatin yomin moke inish nafsheh velo bail:

Leachar sheloshim yom. hu neeman, delo moke inish nafsheh millivol yoter mishsheloshim yom. umihu ihi lo mishtarya, deshavvitah anafshah chaticha deissura, uvaya chalitza, umevakkeshim mimmennu sheyyachlotz, aval lo kofin, deha hu omer shebbaal. veha dechofin oto lachlotz toch sheloshim yom umevakkeshin oto lachlotz leachar sheloshim yom veen kofin umevakkeshim leyabbem, moke baggemara kegon shegget yotze mittachat yadah, shekkevan shennatan get lezikkato nifsela alav, umihu baya chalitza lemishsharyah lealma. vei amra hi nivalti vehu omer lo baalti, en choshshim lidvarav velo baya chalitza:
Nitarev beyayin. shehu adom veen mare haddam nikkar bo:
Roin oto. yayin: keillu hu mayim. veim haya marit dam nikkar bammayim keshiur ze, chayyav lechassot:
Nitarev bedam behema. delav bar kissuy hu, verubbo dam behema:
O vedam hachayya. bedam hekkez shel chayya:
Roin oto. sheeno taun kissuy: keillu hu mayim. veim haya haddam hazze shel shechitat chayya vaof nikkar bo, chayyav lechassot:
En dam mevattel dam. vaafillu en marit dam nikkeret bammayim kemot dam behema ze, en dam hachayya batel. dekasavar rabbi yehuda min bemino lo vatel. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Mutteret lachazor lo. af al gav deim lo hechezirah venisset leacher mittoch haggerushin venitarmela, asura larishon, afillu hachi ki hechezirah umeana bo ate meun vegalli alah diktanna hi uvatteleh legitta, velo have bachazara sheniyya kemachzir gerushato mishshennisset leacher:
Ze hakkelal. kelomar afillu peamim harebe gershah vehechezirah umeana bo, im nisset leacher mittoch get asura lachazor lo, umittoch meun mutteret lachazor lo:
Hannoderet hanaa miyvamah bechayye valah kofin oto sheyyachalotz lah. delo aska datah sheyyamut baalah vetippol lefanav leyibbum. venotelet ketubbatah:
Aval leachar mitat balah. haveya moredet, vekayma lan kotvin iggeret mered al shomeret yavam:
Mevakshim mimmennu lachalotz. veyitten ketubbatah im yirtze, veim lo ratza lachlotz vehi moredet bo uvaa lehafesid ketubbatah, kofin oto lachalotz:
Enan rashshaim lechalek. mikkevan shechala alehem chovat zimmun:
Vechen arbaa vechen chamishsha. en hashshelosha mezammenin leatzman vehayyachid yechalek mehen, deihu nammi ikba bechovat zimmun:

Shishsha nechlakim. kede zimmun lechan uchede zimmun lechan, ad asara, aval asara en nechlakim, deitchayyevu lehu bezimmun sheyyesh bo hazekarat hashshem, ad sheyyihyu esrim, veaz yechalku lishte chavurot im yirtzu:
Bishlosha vehu omer barchu. deha belav dideh ikka zimmun, vechen kullam:
Echad asara veechad asara ribbo. hach resha rabbi akiva hi, deamar ma matzinu bevet hakkeneset mishshehiggiu laasara en chilluk ben rabbim lemuatim, hacha nammi en chilluk:

Bemea omer nevarech laAdonai‏ elohenu. hach sefa kullah rabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar lefi rov hakkahal hen mevarchin shenneemar bemakhelot barchu elohim. ufesak halacha, mishshelosha vead asara, veen asara bichlal, hamevarech omer nevarech sheachalnu mishshello vechullan onim baruch sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. vaasara o measara ulemala hamevarech omer nevarech lelohenu sheachalnu mishshello, vechullan onim baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu:
